interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Water in a dream signifies Islam, knowledge, life, fertility, and prosperity, because all living things depend on it for life. If one sees himself drinking plenty of clear, fresh water, it indicates a long life and a pure livelihood. If he drinks it from a well easily, he will gain wealth through the cunning of a wicked man. Stagnant water indicates confinement and prison. Murky water signifies a miserable life, and salty water indicates distress and worry. Hot water represents torment and illness. Whoever sees himself giving water in a cup to another, it indicates a child. Water flowing in houses or markets indicates strife and calamities. Walking on water indicates strong faith and certainty.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Water indicates a good life, sustenance, and livelihood, and it can indicate marriage. Drinking clear, fresh water signifies recovery from illnesses and lawful sustenance. If the dreamer is a disbeliever, he will convert to Islam. Whoever sees himself in murky water or mud is in worry, grief, and illness. Whoever bathes with cold water indicates repentance, healing, release from prison, and payment of debt. Bathing with hot water in winter indicates benefit and profit, but in summer, it indicates worry and illness. Whoever sees water coming out of a wall, it signifies that worry will afflict him from a man or an in-law.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The vision of water is interpreted in several ways: it represents a good life, sustenance, livelihood, strength, and marriage. Clear water is better than murky, and flowing water is better than stagnant. Whoever sees himself drinking from a river's water will acquire wealth from a man of great stature, proportional to the amount he drank. Bitter water indicates a miserable life, and yellow water indicates illness. Whoever sees himself fall into water without reaching the bottom will get involved in worldly affairs and attain a blessing. If he reaches the bottom, severe grief will afflict him.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Fire in a dream is a warning, war, torment, authority, jinn, and prison. Whoever sees a fire with flames and smoke, it represents a great war and strife. As for fire with no smoke, it indicates closeness to the ruler and attaining benefits. Whoever sees himself eating fire is unjustly consuming orphans' property or unlawful wealth. Whoever sees fire in his heart, it is overwhelming love and passion. Lighting a fire among people indicates causing strife and enmity between them. A bright fire in the house indicates fertility and goodness for its household.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Fire indicates authority and kingship. Whoever sees a fire break out in a place and burn it, a war or strife will occur there, proportional to the burning. Fire that has a sound, thunder, and terror indicates a great strife in which many people will die. Whoever sees himself worshiping fire, he either loves war or obeys Satan in disobedience. Escaping from fire means escaping from strife. Sitting in the fire indicates accompanying the ruler and getting close to him.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Fire is interpreted as authority or a king. If it is burning and harmful, it represents an unjust ruler. If it is illuminating without harm, it is a benefit coming from a king. Whoever sees fire descending from the sky and burning what is on earth, it is an epidemic or death that will occur in that place. Whoever sees fire coming out of his house will attain a high position or a profitable trade. Whoever is afflicted by the heat of the fire will be subject to people's gossip.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Seeing gold in a dream is generally disliked and indicates financial loss and worry. Its name in Arabic (dhahab) suggests 'going away' (dhahab), and its yellow color indicates illness. Whoever sees that he has found an ingot of gold will lose his money or be afflicted with worry proportional to the ingot's size, or the ruler will be angry with him and punish him. Whoever sees himself melting gold will fall into a severe dispute, and people will speak ill of him. Men wearing gold indicates marrying into an incompetent family. For women, gold is adornment, joy, and happiness; what is worn on the neck indicates children, and what is worn on the hand indicates the husband.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Gold in a dream is not praiseworthy and indicates grief and evil, unless it is in the form of dinars (coins), which may indicate knowledge, guidance, or serving the ruler. Whoever sees himself wearing a necklace of gold, silver, or beads will assume a high position and fulfill a trust. Whoever sees his house made of gold, a fire will afflict it. Whoever sees his hands made of gold, they will stop working and become paralyzed. Wrought gold is adornment for women, but humiliation for men due to its association with women.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Gold is interpreted as worry, grief, hardship, and calamity for men. Whoever sees that he has obtained gold will be afflicted with hardship. For women, seeing gold is praiseworthy and indicates joy, adornment, and marriage. Sound dinars (coins) are interpreted as pure religion and a good son. Whoever sees himself casting gold, it indicates evil and destruction. Seeing one's eyes made of gold indicates blindness. In summary, the vision of gold for men is not praiseworthy unless it is a very small amount.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Snakes in a dream represent enemies, and the enmity of each snake is proportional to its harm, size, and venom. Whoever sees himself fighting or struggling with a snake is fighting an enemy. If he kills it, he will defeat his enemy. If it bites him, he will suffer harm from his enemy proportional to the bite's severity. Eating raw snake meat means gaining wealth from an enemy and experiencing joy. If it's cooked, he will gain his enemy's wealth lawfully. Whoever sees a snake entering his house and leaving without harm, his enemies are from his own household and relatives. A smooth snake that obeys the dreamer indicates a treasure or wealth he will acquire.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A serpent in a dream indicates an enemy, a state, life, or a flood. Whoever sees a dead snake, Allah will spare him the evil of his enemy and repel his cunning. Whoever owns a snake and does not fear it will gain power and authority. Snake eggs indicate the fiercest enemies, and small snakes indicate young enemies from his household. Whoever sees a snake coming out of his nose or back, it is a son who will be his enemy. Killing a white snake indicates the destruction of a hypocritical enemy.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A serpent is interpreted as a cunning enemy. Whoever sees that he owns a serpent will acquire great authority and be safe from enemies. Whoever sees that he killed a serpent on his bed, his wife will die. A serpent's bite indicates obtaining wealth from an enemy, but with hardship. If he sees the serpent speaking to him softly, it indicates he will receive goodness and benefit that will amaze people. A small serpent is interpreted as a son; if he kills it, his son will die.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The lion in a dream is interpreted as a powerful and tyrannical ruler, due to its great danger, boldness, fearsome appearance, and intense anger. Whoever sees himself fighting a lion is challenging an enemy or a ruler. Whoever rides it while it obeys him will gain control over a dangerous, unjust ruler. Eating a lion's flesh means acquiring wealth from a ruler and defeating an enemy. The lion's skin, hair, and bones represent wealth and inheritance. Whoever sees a lion in his house, if there is a sick person, it indicates his death; if not, it indicates hardship from a ruler. Fleeing from a lion signifies salvation, safety from fear, and achieving one's goals.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The lion in a dream indicates death and hardship, as it preys on souls. It might also indicate recovery for a sick person. Whoever sees a lion approach him without touching him will be frightened by a ruler but will not be harmed. Whoever flees from a lion without the lion chasing him will be saved from what he fears and dreads. Seeing a lioness indicates a wicked and domineering woman. A lion cub is interpreted as a brave son. Whoever is wrestled down by a lion without being killed will suffer a persistent fever, as the lion is always feverish.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The lion is interpreted as a ruler or a brave, strong man. Whoever sees that he got some of the lion's flesh will acquire wealth from a ruler or a great man. Whoever sees that he has turned into a lion will become an oppressor relative to his station. Whoever sees himself riding a lion and directing it as he wishes, his status will rise and he will conquer his enemies. Whoever sees a lion following him, it represents fear of the ruler. Whoever sees himself fighting a lion is disputing with a strong enemy.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The sea in a dream represents a powerful and just king, or the world with its horrors, trade, and dangers. Whoever sees the sea from afar will witness horror, strife, and tribulation. Whoever drinks all the sea's water will gain dominion over the world and have a long life. If it's salty, he will acquire unlawful wealth. Drowning in the sea indicates falling into strife, heresy, or the hands of the ruler. Swimming in it indicates delving into the king's affairs. Crossing from one side to the other signifies salvation from worry, grief, and hardship.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The sea represents anyone with authority over people, like kings, scholars, and masters. Whoever sees himself wading into the sea will enter the presence of a king. Whoever urinates in the sea is persisting in sin. Whoever sees the sea raging and dark, it is a great strife and tribulation. A calm, clear sea indicates a just king, goodness, and prosperity. Catching fish from the sea is blessed, lawful sustenance.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The sea is interpreted as a king. If it is clear and calm, the king is just and good. If it is murky and raging, he is unjust and oppressive. Whoever sees himself drowning in the sea without dying will be immersed in worldly affairs, then be saved from them and reform his religion. Whoever sees himself drinking sea water will receive wealth from the king. Whoever draws water from it into a container will gain abundant wealth or a long-lived son.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Death in a dream indicates returning trusts, recovery for the sick, or release for the captive. It may also indicate travel or marriage, as the deceased needs washing and perfume like a groom. Whoever sees himself die and be carried on men's shoulders will gain honor and authority, but his religion will be corrupted. Whoever sees himself die without the appearance of being dead, his house will be demolished. Whoever sees the Imam (leader) die, the town will fall into ruin. Whoever sees himself die and then come back to life, he will commit a sin and then repent.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Death in a dream indicates remorse for a great sin. Whoever sees himself die and has a funeral and mourning for him will gain control over his worldly affairs. Whoever sees that he will never die, he will die as a martyr. Sudden death indicates wealth for the poor and poverty for the rich, or attaining rest after hardship. The death of a father indicates weakness in one's situation. The death of a mother indicates corruption in the world and loss of virtue.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Whoever sees that he has died will have a long life, and the price of what he owns will decrease. If he sees that he died without illness or apparent cause, it indicates the ruin of his house. Whoever sees a known dead person die again, accompanied by crying, it indicates the death of one of his descendants or family members. Seeing death for an unmarried person indicates marriage, and for a married person, divorce. Death, in general, indicates a transition from one state to another.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Teeth in a dream represent the dreamer's household and relatives. The upper teeth are the men from his father's side, and the lower are the women from his mother's side. Their falling indicates the death, absence, or illness of the person they represent. If they fall into his hand or lap, it is wealth he will receive or a child. If they fall and he doesn't see them, one of his family members will die or be absent. Tooth decay indicates a calamity afflicting his household. The beauty and whiteness of teeth indicate the strength and prestige of his household.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Falling teeth indicate a long life for the dreamer himself. If all his teeth fall out and he doesn't see them, his family and relatives will die before him. If his teeth fall out and he has a debt, Allah will settle his debt. If they fall and he catches them in his hand, he will benefit from wealth from the person the tooth represents. Teeth falling out with blood indicates sin and severing family ties. Black or crooked teeth indicate a flaw in the household members.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The vision of falling teeth is interpreted in several ways: the death of a relative, payment of a debt, wealth that comes to him, or bad words he utters. Whoever sees his teeth fall into his palm without pain, it is wealth that will come to him. If they fall with pain and blood, it indicates the loss of something from his house with hardship and worry. Pulling out teeth indicates severing family ties or spending money reluctantly. Cleaning teeth indicates spending money to remove the worries of one's family.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Marriage in a dream indicates care from Allah Almighty. It might also indicate captivity, debt, worry, and grief. Whoever sees himself marrying an unknown woman may die or kill someone. If the dreamer is arranging someone's marriage to a woman, he will attain goodness and happiness. A woman marrying a dead man in a dream indicates the scattering of her family and her impoverishment. Whoever marries a woman who is already married in reality is seeking the world but will not obtain it.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Marriage in a dream indicates position, honor, and high status. Whoever marries a woman and she dies is pursuing a craft or work from which he will gain nothing but worry, hardship, and grief. The marriage of a sick woman indicates her death, and likewise, the marriage of a sick man indicates his death. Whoever sees himself marrying a Jewish woman is pursuing a craft through which he will commit sin and become bold in disobedience. Whoever marries an adulteress is an adulterer.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Marriage is interpreted as striving to obtain honor, prestige, and position. Whoever sees himself marrying a beautiful virgin woman will attain goodness, joy, benefit, and high status proportional to her beauty. If the woman is ugly, it is worry, grief, and calamity. Whoever sees himself marrying an old woman will gain much of this world, but it will be fleeting. Marriage for an unmarried person indicates achieving what he wishes for and fulfilling his desires.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Flying in a dream means travel, if it is straight. If one flies from one roof to another, he will replace his wife or maidservant. If he flies with two wings, it is honor, authority, and power. For a sick person, flying indicates death. Whoever flies from low to high without wings will achieve his wish and his status will rise. Whoever flies in the air while sitting or standing, it indicates many travels without fatigue. Whoever sees himself flying with birds will mix with foreign people.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Whoever sees himself flying will travel often. If he is a prisoner or a slave, he will be freed. If he flies from a known place to a known place, he will travel quickly and gain honor. For the worried person, flying is relief and joy. Whoever sees himself racing another in flying and beats him, he will overpower him and rise above him. Whoever sees himself flying in the sky and then landing on something, he will own that thing.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Flying is interpreted as travel if it is with wings. If it is without wings, it indicates a transition from one state to a better one. Whoever sees himself flying from his house to another house he knows, he will marry from that house. Whoever sees himself flying over a mountain will gain authority, and kings will submit to him. Whoever flies and lands on a roof will gain leadership and honor. Flying straight into the air indicates travel by sea or land.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The cat in a dream represents a servant who guards a person's wealth, or perhaps a thief from within the household or outside it. A female cat is a deceitful, hypocritical woman. Whoever sees a cat bite or scratch him will fall ill or suffer long-lasting worry and sadness. A pet cat indicates joy, happiness, and comfort, while a wild cat indicates trouble, fatigue, and worry. Whoever sells a cat will spend his money unwisely.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The cat in a dream indicates alienation from one's wife and children, and may indicate quarreling, theft, betrayal, and adultery. Killing a cat indicates capturing and overpowering a thief. Whoever sees himself turn into a cat lives off theft and espionage. A cat that enters a house and steals something indicates a thief will enter that house. Arguing with a cat indicates arguing with a thief or a traitor.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The cat is interpreted as a servant or a thief. Whoever sees himself fighting a cat will fall seriously ill and then recover. If he kills the cat, he will be cured of his illness. A pet cat is better than a wild one and indicates a trustworthy servant or a righteous woman. A white cat indicates a clean maidservant, and a black one indicates a gossiping maidservant. A cat's bite indicates betrayal by a servant.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Bread in a dream signifies knowledge, Islam, life, and the sustenance of the soul. Pure, white bread indicates a clear livelihood and pure knowledge. A loaf of bread for a scholar represents his knowledge, for a ruler his justice, and for an artisan his honesty. Dry bread indicates hardship in livelihood. Eating thin bread indicates abundant sustenance and a long life. Hot bread indicates hypocrisy and unlawful money.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Bread indicates the wealth that sustains the soul. Whoever sees himself taking a bite from a loaf is a greedy man. Bitter bread indicates a bitter life. Bread dough indicates honorable wealth from which much good and blessing will come. Seeing bread above the clouds indicates high prices. If it is in inappropriate places like filth, it indicates low prices and prosperity.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Bread is interpreted as livelihood and sustenance. Whoever sees himself eating good, pure bread, his life will be pleasant. If it is spoiled and black, his livelihood will be troubled. Whoever sees himself distributing bread to the poor will gain abundance in his sustenance, good praise, and his worries will disappear. A loaf of bread may be interpreted as a mother or a wet nurse. Making bread indicates striving to seek livelihood, proportional to the quality of the bread.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Clothes in a dream represent a man's religion or his worldly life, his piety, and his work. The best clothes are white, indicating righteousness in religion and worldly life. Black clothes represent leadership and wealth for one accustomed to wearing them in wakefulness, but for one not accustomed, they are worry and grief. Green clothes indicate religion, worship, and goodness for the living and the dead. Yellow clothes indicate sickness and weakness. A new garment for an unmarried person is marriage, for a married person a child, and for the poor, wealth.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Clothes represent a person's covering in his world and his religion. Whoever sees himself wearing a new, wide garment, it is abundance in his religion and his world. Torn clothes indicate a torn religion or situation, or poverty and need. Washing clothes indicates repentance from sins and the removal of worries. Silk clothes for men indicate high position and status but corruption in religion, while for women, they are marriage, high status, and joy.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A garment is interpreted as the man himself, and whatever good or bad or tearing is seen in it, its interpretation reflects on the dreamer's religion and worldly life. Whoever sees that he is wearing luxurious clothes, his status and honor will increase. Short clothes indicate shortcomings in religion. Whoever wears women's clothes will be afflicted with worry, humiliation, and fear. Whoever wears clothes that do not suit him will take on a matter he is not qualified for. A wet garment is a difficult journey.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The house in a dream represents a man's wife, to whom he returns and in whom he finds cover. It may also represent his body. Whatever good or bad happens in the house reflects on the wife or the dreamer's body. Building a house indicates marriage for the unmarried or intimacy with family. A spacious house indicates abundant sustenance and the good character of the wife. An unknown house is the abode of the Hereafter; if it is spacious and beautiful, it indicates his good state after death.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The house represents the world. Whoever sees himself building a house is building his world and establishing himself in it. Demolishing the house indicates the death of its owner or a great calamity befalling his family. Whoever sees his house wider than it was, it is an abundance in sustenance and an exit from distress. Moving from a narrow house to a wide one indicates relief after hardship and the removal of worry. Entering an unknown house indicates the approaching death of a sick person.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The house is interpreted as the wife. Whoever sees himself renovating his house is renewing his relationship with his wife or marrying another if he is eligible. Whoever sees his house is made of gold, a fire will afflict it. Whoever sees himself carrying his house and walking with it, he is supporting a poor woman. A dark house indicates a man of bad character or a woman of bad character. A bright house indicates the opposite.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Rain in a dream is mercy from Allah Almighty, goodness, sustenance, and relief, if it is general everywhere and causes no harm. If the rain is specific to a certain house or village, it indicates worry and tribulation for the people of that place. Heavy rain like a flood indicates strife or an epidemic. Bathing in rainwater is repentance from sins, healing from diseases, and removal of worries. Rain of blood indicates bloodshed and wars.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Rain indicates relief, fertility, prosperity, and payment of debts. If it is in its proper season, it is good and beneficial. If it is out of season, it is sickness and tribulation. Whoever sees himself drinking clear rainwater will attain goodness and knowledge. If it is murky, he will fall ill proportional to how much he drank. Rain that damages crops indicates the injustice of the ruler or a general affliction. Light rain is better than heavy.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Rain is interpreted as mercy, goodness, and blessing from Allah Almighty. If the rain is general and in its season, it is evidence of abundant sustenance and low prices. If the rain is very strong, destroying houses, it is a punishment from Allah or a great strife. Whoever sees the sky raining something other than water, if it is something beloved, it is good, and if it is disliked, it is evil and tribulation.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The sun in a dream is the greatest king, the caliph, or the father. Whoever sees the sun rising in his house, if he is a merchant, he will profit, and if he is unmarried, he will marry a noble and beautiful woman. The setting of the sun indicates the death or dismissal of whomever it represents. A solar eclipse indicates a calamity befalling the king or the father. Whoever sees that he possesses the sun will attain a great kingdom. The sun rising from the west indicates a great sign and the exposure of hidden matters.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The sun indicates the ruler, a beautiful wife, or a profitable trade. Whoever sees the sun clear and shining, it indicates the righteousness of the king and a pleasant life. If he sees it dark, it indicates the injustice of the king and corrupt conditions. Whoever sees the sun speaking to him will attain high status and a position from the ruler. Whoever sees the sun, moon, and stars gathered for him and obeying him, will attain a great kingdom and people will submit to him.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The sun is interpreted as the caliph, king, or a great leader. Whatever light, darkness, good, or evil is seen in it is attributed to him. Whoever sees the sun fall to the earth, it indicates the death of the king or leader. Whoever sees the sun's rays shining on him alone, he will attain prestige, authority, and health in his body. Whoever sees himself fleeing from the sun is fleeing from his wife or his ruler.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The moon in a dream is the vizier of the greatest king, a great scholar, or a jurist. Whoever sees the moon in his lap will marry a beautiful wife. If a pregnant woman sees it, she will be blessed with a beautiful baby boy. A lunar eclipse indicates a calamity befalling the vizier or scholar, or dismissal from a position. If he sees the moon become the sun, he will attain goodness, honor, and wealth from his mother or his wife. The crescent moon indicates a blessed son or a new position of authority.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The moon indicates the husband, the son, or a boss at work. Whoever sees the moon as a full moon, it indicates the completion of his affair and its perfection. If it is waning, it is a deficiency in the status of whomever it represents. Whoever sees himself hanging onto the moon will receive goodness and benefit from the king. The fall of the moon indicates the death of the scholar, the vizier, or the husband.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The moon is interpreted as a knowledgeable man, a just king, or a beautiful, beardless boy. The meeting of the sun and moon in a dream indicates goodness, blessing, and a blessed marriage. Whoever sees himself speaking to the moon will draw close to a scholar and gain knowledge from him. A dark moon indicates the betrayal of the vizier or the illness of the wife.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Stars in a dream are the scholars, jurists, and nobles among people. Whoever sees stars gathered in his house, noble people will gather at his place for good. The fall of a star from the sky indicates the death of a scholar or a nobleman in that region. Whoever eats stars is consuming the wealth of noble people. Small stars represent the common people.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Stars indicate the king's companions, his soldiers, and the scholar's students. Seeing stars in the daytime indicates scandals and the revealing of secrets. Whoever sees himself holding stars in his hand will gain high status and authority over people. Whoever sees a star fall on his head, if he is sick, he will die, and if he has a debt, his creditor will demand it.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Stars are interpreted as people. The large ones are the nobles and scholars, and the small ones are the commoners. Whoever sees himself herding the stars will gain authority over people. Whoever sees stars falling like rain, it is a general death that will occur in that place. Bright stars indicate good news.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The dog in a dream is a foolish man, a weak enemy with little chivalry. A female dog is a lowly woman. A dog's bark is ugly speech from an enemy. A dog's bite is receiving harm from an enemy or betrayal from a friend. Whoever sees a dog tearing his clothes, a foolish man is backbiting him. A domestic dog is an enemy from the household, and a hunting dog (Saluki) indicates attaining authority.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The dog indicates worldly people. A shepherd's dog indicates benefit and sustenance. Eating dog meat indicates victory over an enemy and taking his wealth. Whoever sees himself fleeing from a dog will escape an enemy, but with fear. Black dogs are enemies from the Arabs, and white dogs are enemies from non-Arabs.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The dog is interpreted as a weak enemy with no ambition. Whoever sees a dog bite him or tear his clothes will receive worry and harm from his enemy proportional to the pain. Befriending a dog indicates accompanying servants and relying on them. A female dog is interpreted as a worthless woman with no opinion. Whoever sees himself turn into a dog has learned knowledge but does not act upon it.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Blood in a dream is unlawful money or a great sin. Whoever sees himself stained with blood is wallowing in unlawful money or sin. Whoever drinks human blood will gain wealth and benefit from that person, or be saved from his evil. Spilled blood indicates strife and bloodshed. Blood exiting the body without a wound indicates a loss of wealth proportional to it if he is rich, or health if he is poor.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Blood in a dream indicates its owner's life, strength, and wealth. Whoever sees himself spitting blood will be afflicted with a calamity in his wealth or fall into a dispute. Whoever sees a river of blood will be afflicted with a great calamity in that place. Vomiting blood is repentance from a sin or returning a trust.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The vision of blood is interpreted in two ways: unlawful money or a false deed for which he sins. Whoever sees blood exiting his body, wealth will exit from him proportional to that blood. If it exits from the anus, it is unlawful money leaving him. Whoever sees himself fall into a well of blood will be afflicted with unlawful money or unlawful blood.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The sky in a dream indicates the king, ruler, or palace. Whoever sees himself ascending to the sky will gain authority and high status, but with danger and arrogance. If he does not return, he will die. The lowest heaven indicates the abode of scholars. Looking at the sky indicates high ambition and drawing closer to God. A clear sky indicates the king's justice, and an overcast sky his injustice.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The sky indicates one's country and dwelling. Whoever sees the sky split open and something good emerge from it, it indicates relief and goodness. If something frightening emerges, it indicates strife and tribulation. Whoever sees the sky is green, it indicates fertility and goodness in that year. If it is yellow, it indicates illness.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The vision of the sky is interpreted as the king. Whoever sees himself flying in the sky will travel far and gain honor. Whoever sees the gates of heaven open, the gates of sustenance and answered prayers will open for him. The sky falling on the earth indicates the death of the king or a general destruction.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The key in a dream is sustenance, help, victory, and knowledge. Whoever sees many keys in his hand will gain a great kingdom and authority, as Allah says, 'To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth.' A wooden key is a hypocritical man. Whoever opens a door with a key will achieve his need and triumph over his enemy.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The key in a dream is the opening and facilitation of matters. It may also indicate an answered prayer, a male child, or a spy. Whoever finds a key has found a treasure or useful knowledge. Losing a key indicates difficulty in matters and loss of knowledge or money.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The key is interpreted as a knowledgeable man, a ruler, or one who holds the solution to matters. Opening a locked door with a key indicates relief after hardship and achieving one's desire. A key made of iron is a strong, powerful man, and one of gold is a rich man.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Crying in a dream is joy and happiness if it is without screaming, slapping (the face), or wearing black. If it is with screaming and slapping, it is a calamity, worry, and sadness. Crying out of fear of Allah, hearing the Quran, or from remorse for a sin indicates relief, joy, and the removal of worries, and it is a sign of faith.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Crying indicates sadness if accompanied by screaming and wailing. If it is cold tears without shouting, it is relief from distress and worry. If the tears are hot, it is worry and sadness. Whoever sees himself crying over a known person who has died will fall into worry, and the deceased's family will share in it.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Whoever sees himself crying with flowing tears but without screaming, it is joy and happiness. If the crying is with blood, it is remorse for a missed opportunity and repentance. If the crying is with slapping (the face) and tearing clothes, it is sadness and a great calamity. Whoever sees the people of a place crying, relief from worry will come to them.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Hair on the head in a dream is wealth and long life. Whoever sees his hair long, his wealth and life will increase. Long hair for a worried person is an increase in his worry, and for a happy person, an increase in his joy. A woman's hair is her adornment, her covering, and her husband. Braiding hair indicates collecting money and perfecting matters. Beautiful hair indicates honor and nobility.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Hair indicates prestige and wealth. Whoever sees his hair long, his life will be long and his deeds good. Shaving hair during the Hajj season is security and payment of debt. Outside the Hajj season, it indicates poverty and dismissal from a position. Gray hair (Shayb) is dignity and reverence, and it may indicate long life or weakness.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Hair is interpreted as adornment, leadership, and wealth. The longer and more beautiful the hair, the more praiseworthy it is for a woman. It might be a worry for a man if it is excessively long. Whoever sees his hair become like pig's hair will be afflicted with hardships. Whoever sees himself combing his hair is removing worries from himself.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The road in a dream is the Sharia (Islamic law), religion, and profession. A straight, wide road indicates monotheism (Tawhid), the Sunnah, and abundance in sustenance. A narrow, crooked road indicates heresy, misguidance, and a difficult life. Whoever sees himself lost from the road is straying from the truth and falling into confusion.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The road indicates striving to seek sustenance. A blocked road indicates misguidance and difficulty. Whoever sees himself repairing a road is calling people to goodness. Whoever finds himself at a crossroads is falling into confusion in his affairs or heresy in his religion.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The road is interpreted as one's deeds. A straight one is a righteous deed, and a crooked one is a corrupt deed. Whoever sees two roads before him and chooses one, he is choosing between two matters, worldly or religious. An unknown road is a long journey or a matter involving risk.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Fruit in a dream is wealth for the poor, an increase in wealth for the rich, and security for the fearful. Fresh, moist fruit is sustenance that does not last. Dry fruit is lasting and continuous sustenance. Eating fruit out of season indicates illness, worry, or unlawful money. A fruit tree indicates a generous, beneficial man.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Fruit indicates marriage, children, wealth, or good deeds. Sweet fruit indicates lawful sustenance and benefit; sour fruit is the opposite. Whoever sees himself picking fruit from a tree that is not its own will marry into a family not of his lineage.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Fruit is interpreted as wealth and blessing. Whoever sees himself gathering fruit is gathering knowledge and good praise. A fruit tree is a rich and noble man. Fruit on a dining table indicates associating with generous people. Eating fruit with a dead person indicates the good state of the deceased in the Hereafter.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Prayer in a dream is praiseworthy in all cases. It indicates payment of debt, fulfillment of trusts, adherence to covenants, and salvation from worries. The obligatory prayer (Fardh) indicates fulfilling trusts and avoiding prohibitions. Whoever sees himself praying in a direction other than the Qibla is committing a great sin or straying from the truth.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Prayer in a dream indicates a position of authority, a high rank, or the fulfillment of a need. Whoever sees himself leading people in prayer (Imam) will gain authority and high status. Whoever abandons prayer in a dream out of disdain is disrespecting his religion and its laws. Sending blessings on the Prophet (PBUH) indicates strength in religion and victory over enemies.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Prayer is interpreted as prestige and status with God and people. Whoever sees himself performing a complete prayer, Allah has accepted his deed and fulfilled his need. Praying in an impure place indicates corruption in religion and falling into immoral acts. The prayer for rain (Istisqa) indicates fear of the ruler or high prices.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A young child in a dream is a worry, grief, and fatigue in raising and caring for him. Carrying a child indicates gaining a kingdom or authority for one who is worthy of it, or bearing a worry and responsibility. A baby boy is good news of imminent relief. A baby girl is a world approaching with goodness and abundance.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A child indicates a weak enemy who shows friendship then returns to enmity. A plump child indicates goodness and good news, while a thin one indicates worry and illness. Whoever sees himself become a child falls into ignorance or a worry that robs him of his mind and virtue.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A child is interpreted as worry, strife, and animosity. Whoever sees that he found a child will find a worry from where he does not expect. Whoever sees that he is buying a child has bought a worry. If he sees that he is selling a child, he will get rid of a worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Money in a dream indicates ugly speech and animosity. Whoever sees himself find money in the road will fall into a dispute with someone. A few dirhams (coins) indicate a small worry, and many indicate a great worry. Whoever gives money to another, his worry will be removed. Money in the house is a worry that enters it.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Money in a dream indicates judgment, testimony, and relief after hardship. Dirhams (coins) in a dream indicate speech and dispute. Whoever sees that he owes a dinar (gold coin) will be forced into something he dislikes by the ruler. Many dinars indicate authority, treasures, and knowledge.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Seeing money is interpreted as evil, strife, and worry. Whoever sees that he gave money will fall into a dispute with the one he gave it to. Finding money is worry and grief proportional to its amount. Money from an unknown source indicates strife from where he does not know.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The horse in a dream is honor, prestige, and authority. Riding a horse is attaining honor, prestige, and a high position. Whoever owns a horse will gain goodness, benefit, and abundance in sustenance. A wild, disobedient horse indicates a man who follows his desires and commits sins. The death of a horse indicates the death of its owner or the loss of his blessings.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The horse indicates travel, a partner, or prestige. A white (ash-hab) horse is a religious man of dignity. A black horse is a man of wealth and leadership. A red horse is a man of war and strife. Riding a horse without a saddle indicates marriage to a lowly woman or a journey filled with hardship.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The horse is interpreted as prestige, status, and honor. Riding it with full armor indicates overpowering enemies and achieving wishes. Whoever sees himself fall from a horse will lose his position or be weakened in his state. The horse's tail indicates the man's followers and supporters.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The cow indicates a year. A fat cow indicates a fertile year full of prosperity and goodness. A thin cow indicates a year of drought, barrenness, and hardship. Drinking cow's milk indicates wealth for the poor, health for the sick, and an increase in wealth for the rich. Being gored by a cow indicates loss or dismissal from a position.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The cow indicates a righteous woman, a trustworthy servant, or a blessed year. Whoever rides a cow will gain wealth and authority, and his worry will disappear. Whoever sees a cow speaking to him will receive great goodness that will amaze people. A black cow is a blessed lady, and a yellow one is a year with joy and goodness.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The cow is interpreted as the year. Whatever is seen in it of fatness, leanness, or color, its interpretation reflects on that year. Whoever sees that he owns many cows will gain authority and his wealth will increase. Eating cooked beef indicates lawful sustenance from a government employee.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: If the number of fish is known, they represent women. If their number is unknown, they represent wealth and spoils. Large, fresh fish are spoils and goodness. Small fish indicate worries and sorrows due to their many bones. Whoever sees himself catching a large fish will acquire benefit and goodness. Salted fish indicates worry and grief, or lasting wealth.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Fresh fish is quick, blessed sustenance. Grilled fish is the fulfillment of a need, an answered prayer, or travel in search of knowledge. Eating raw fish indicates attaining a kingdom or marrying a beautiful woman. A fish coming out of the dreamer's mouth indicates a false word and slander he speaks against a woman's honor.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Fish is interpreted as a vizier, soldiers, wealth, or women. Catching fish from clear water is lawful sustenance acquired easily. Catching it from murky water is worry and grief. Whoever sees a fish in his bed, if he is a fisherman, he will acquire good; if he is sick, his illness will worsen.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The scorpion is a gossiping enemy who harms some of his relatives, and no one is safe from him. Its sting is gaining wealth from an enemy, but that wealth will then be lost. Killing a scorpion is victory over the enemy. Whoever sees himself eating a raw scorpion is backbiting a corrupt enemy. A scorpion in one's trousers indicates an enemy from the wife's side.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The scorpion is worry and gossip from relatives. Whoever sees himself eating a cooked scorpion will receive an inheritance from his enemy. Whoever sees scorpions in his house, they are enemies from his relatives. Burning a scorpion indicates the death of an enemy. The scorpion's stinger is the tongue of the gossiping man.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The scorpion is interpreted as a weak, irreligious enemy who harms more with his tongue than his hand. Whoever sees that he killed a scorpion will triumph over an enemy and be rid of his evil. Whoever sees a scorpion in his hand, stinging people with it, is backbiting people and causing enmity between them.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The book in a dream indicates power, relief, and joy. A book in the right hand is a true testimony and a righteous deed. A book in the left hand is regret for an ugly deed. Whoever sees himself reading a book he doesn't understand will inherit a legacy. Tearing a book indicates the removal of worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The book indicates good news and sociability. A folded book indicates the approach of death or a hidden matter. Reading a book indicates gaining knowledge, guidance, and understanding. A book for a young boy in a dream indicates glad tidings and joy.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The book is interpreted as a believing man or a righteous woman. Tearing a book indicates the loss of knowledge, religion, or wealth. Whoever sees that he was given a book will gain a position or be entrusted with a trust. A sealed book indicates hidden good news that will soon be revealed.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The sword in a dream is authority, a son, a high position, or a brave man. A sword in its sheath is a woman. Drawing a sword from its sheath indicates seeking a position of authority or the birth of a baby boy. Striking with a sword indicates argument and proof. A broken sword indicates the death of a son or brother, or dismissal from a position.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The sword indicates decisive speech or a brave man who settles matters. Whoever girds himself with a sword will assume a position of authority. A sword made of wood means he will befriend a hypocritical man. Playing with a sword indicates skill in war or dispute. A rusty sword indicates a son with a bad reputation.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The sword is interpreted as a king, a judge, or a man of authority. Whoever sees his sword grow long, his authority will strengthen and his command will be executed. Whoever sees himself striking someone's neck with a sword will free a slave or release a prisoner. A broken sword indicates the weakness and feebleness of the authority.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The ring indicates what a person owns and has power over, such as a house, an animal, a wife, a child, or authority. Whoever is given a ring or buys one will gain authority or kingship. The stone (fess) of the ring is the prestige and adornment of the authority. Breaking or losing the ring indicates the loss of kingship, divorce of the wife, or death of the child.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The ring indicates a wife, a child, wealth, and security. A man wearing a gold ring is disliked and indicates betrayal or worry. For a woman, it is adornment and joy. A ring of iron is strong authority, and one of lead is weak authority. Whoever finds a ring will acquire wealth from non-Arabs or get married.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The ring is interpreted as kingship, leadership, a wife, or a house. Whoever sees his ring become tight, his world or his wife will become restrictive for him. Whoever sees himself sealing with a ring will gain authority and power. A ring with two stones indicates authority in both outward and inward matters.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The shoe in a dream indicates travel, a brother, a partner, or a wife. Wearing shoes indicates embarking on a journey. Taking them off is security and authority, referencing God's words to Moses, 'Take off your sandals.' Walking in one shoe indicates separating from a partner, wife, or brother. A new shoe is a journey with goodness in it.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The shoe indicates a woman, an animal, or travel. Losing one shoe indicates separating from a partner or divorcing half the number of wives for someone who has more than one. A tight shoe indicates worry, debt, and prison. A wide one indicates abundance in sustenance.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The shoe is interpreted as a woman. Whatever good or bad is seen in it reflects on her. Whoever sees his shoe was stolen, his wife is cheating on him or he will be afflicted with worry from her. Mending the shoe indicates mending the wife's affairs. A black shoe is a rich woman, and a green one is a religious woman.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The mountain in a dream is a king, a ruler, or a great man of high status and a hard heart. Climbing a mountain is attaining high status and position, but with fatigue and hardship. Descending from it is a decline and loss of position. Sitting on the summit of a mountain is empowerment and victory. Demolishing a mountain indicates the death of a king or the scattering of a group.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The mountain indicates a high position, knowledge, or a place of worship. Whoever sees himself living on a mountain is drawing close to a king or a scholar and gaining protection from him. Water flowing from a mountain indicates continuous goodness from a great man. An unknown mountain indicates worry and hardship.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The mountain is interpreted as a difficult, hard-hearted man. Whoever sees himself fleeing to a mountain will be saved from an enemy and will seek refuge with a strong man. Whoever sees a mountain burning, the king or a great man in that region will perish. Ascending to the summit of a mountain is achieving one's wishes.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The river in a dream is a man of high status and importance. Drinking from the river is gaining wealth from a man, proportional to what he drank. Crossing the river is salvation from worry and grief, and victory over an enemy. Clear water in the river indicates the ruler's justice, and murky water indicates his injustice and the corruption of the people.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The river indicates the ruler. A river flowing in the marketplace indicates the ruler's justice, low prices, and benefit for the public. Entering and exiting the river indicates emerging from worry. Drowning in it indicates strife or worry from the ruler.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The river is interpreted as a king or a great man. Whoever sees that he owns a river will gain authority and power. Whoever sees the river dry up, the king will die or his authority will cease. Bathing in the river is repentance, purification from sins, and removal of worries.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The grave in a dream indicates prison, and prison indicates the grave. Digging a grave indicates building a house in that place. Whoever sees himself being buried alive in a grave will be imprisoned or afflicted with worry and grief. Visiting graves indicates visiting prisoners. An unknown grave indicates mingling with hypocrites.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The grave indicates the abode of the Hereafter. It might also indicate marriage for the unmarried, because the grave brings people together just as marriage does. Whoever sees himself building a grave is building a house. Walking among graves indicates seeking a need from stingy people or striving for a false matter.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The grave is interpreted as prison and worry. Whoever sees himself being buried alive will be imprisoned or afflicted with great worry. Rain on graves is mercy from Allah for their occupants. Whoever sees himself digging his own grave will have a long life. An exhumed grave indicates the uncovering of a hidden matter.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Milk (laban) in a dream is lawful money and the natural disposition (Fitra) of Islam. Milk from livestock is good, lawful sustenance. Human milk indicates illness. Bird's milk indicates wealth from travel. Sour milk (buttermilk/ra'ib) is unlawful money or sustenance obtained with trouble and fatigue.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Milk indicates knowledge, religion, and lawful sustenance. Whoever sees himself drinking mare's milk will receive goodness from the ruler, who will love him. Milking a she-camel and drinking its milk indicates marrying a righteous woman and gaining lawful wealth. Milk overflowing from the breast is an increase in sustenance and blessing.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Milk is interpreted as wealth and sustenance. Drinking it for a scholar is an increase in his knowledge, for a ruler, justice in his rule, and for a merchant, profit in his trade. Milk mixed with blood is unlawful money. Bathing in milk indicates wealth, luxury, and adherence to the sound natural disposition.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Honey in a dream is spoils, lawful money, and a cure for diseases. It may also indicate worry, envy, and distress, because people swarm to it. Pure honey indicates knowledge, the Quran, and righteous deeds. Eating honey with bread indicates living with knowledge and strength. Whoever sees the sky raining honey, it indicates righteousness in religion and general blessing.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Honey indicates the Quran and knowledge. Eating it indicates the sweetness of faith and a small amount of sustenance that comes with fatigue. Whoever sees himself licking honey from a vessel, it indicates his marriage. Sealed honey indicates preserved wealth and mastered knowledge. Beeswax indicates lawful money in which there is some doubt.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Honey is interpreted as a lawful inheritance or money obtained without effort. Whoever sees himself eating honey will attain joy and benefit. Filtering honey indicates purifying money from doubts and worries. White honey indicates the dreamer's righteousness in his religion and worldly life.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Dates in a dream are lawful sustenance and rain for whoever sees them. Eating dates indicates reading the Quran and attaining the sweetness of faith. Whoever gathers dates from a palm tree out of season is learning knowledge from a hypocritical man but not acting upon it. Dry dates are lasting sustenance from travel.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Dates indicate saved money. Whoever gathers dates from a palm tree will marry a noble, wealthy, and blessed woman. Whoever sees himself burying dates is hoarding money or will receive a treasure from a ruler. Eating good dates indicates hearing good words and gaining benefit.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Dates are interpreted as wealth. Eating them indicates hearing good words and receiving sustenance. Whoever sees himself distributing dates to people is distributing his money for a good cause. A date pit indicates travel or the approach of death.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Grapes in a dream are abundant, lasting sustenance. White grapes in their season are goodness and healing. Out of season, it is wealth he will gain before he expects it. Black grapes in their season are worry. Out of season, they are illness and fear. Picking a bunch of grapes indicates gaining a large amount of collected wealth from a woman.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Grapes indicate goodness and sustenance. Grape juice indicates fertility and abundance in sustenance. Whoever sees himself eating white grapes will attain a righteous world. Eating black grapes indicates wealth that will disappear quickly. A grapevine indicates a generous, beneficial man.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Grapes are interpreted as wealth and blessing. Black grapes in their season are worry and sadness. Out of season, they are illness and hardship. White grapes in their season are good. Out of season, it is wealth from an unexpected source. Pressing grapes indicates serving the ruler and emerging from hardship.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Meat in a dream is wealth. Cooked meat is better than raw. Raw meat indicates backbiting, illness, and worry. Eating human flesh indicates backbiting that person. Bird meat is wealth from travel. Unknown, fresh meat indicates sudden death and calamity.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Cooked meat is blessed sustenance. Grilled meat indicates a baby boy. Whoever sees himself eating his own flesh is eating from his son's wealth. Buying meat from the butcher indicates a calamity. Salted meat indicates lasting wealth after worry.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Meat is interpreted as wealth and benefit. Lean meat indicates poverty and illness. Fat meat indicates wealth and health. Eating raw meat indicates loss. Distributing meat indicates distributing wealth or the occurrence of a calamity.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The Adhan in a dream indicates Hajj (pilgrimage) during its months. It may also indicate theft and gossip. The Adhan at an improper time indicates strife or the appearance of a strange matter. Whoever sees himself calling the Adhan from a minaret is calling people to the truth and will gain high status and authority.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The Adhan indicates a call to goodness, righteousness, and sustenance. Whoever calls the Adhan on his bed is disrespectful to his family. Whoever calls the Adhan in a well is calling people to a long journey. Whoever sees himself calling the Adhan and no one responds is among an unjust people.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The Adhan is interpreted as position, high status, and a word that is heard. Hearing it indicates acceptance of one's deeds and goodness. Whoever sees himself calling the Adhan with a beautiful voice, his reputation for good will spread. If his voice is ugly, he is calling to heresy.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Hajj in a dream indicates payment of debt, healing for the sick, marriage for the unmarried, repentance from sins, and meeting loved ones. Whoever sees himself setting out for Hajj is striving for a matter for which he will be rewarded. Performing Tawaf (circumambulating) around the Kaaba is serving the ruler or the Imam.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Hajj indicates righteousness in religion and visiting the pious. For a merchant, it is profit; for the sick, healing; and for the indebted, payment of debt. Whoever sees that he missed the Hajj will be dismissed from his position or lose in his trade.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Hajj is interpreted as goodness, blessing, and righteousness in religious and worldly life. Whoever sees himself performing Hajj will have a long life and good deeds. Whoever sees people bidding him farewell for Hajj, it indicates his death is near.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The Kaaba in a dream is the caliph, the Imam, or the leader of the faithful. Entering it indicates security, marriage, and drawing close to the ruler. Whoever sees himself praying on top of the Kaaba is apostatizing from his religion. Whoever sees one of its walls fall, it indicates the death of the caliph.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The Kaaba indicates the mosque, prayer, or following the Sunnah. Whoever sees the Kaaba in his house will gain honor, authority, and live in safety. Whoever steals something from the Kaaba is committing a great sin.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The Kaaba is interpreted as the king or the scholar. Praying inside it is an answered prayer and security from fear. Whoever sees himself performing Tawaf around it is undertaking a religious matter proportional to his circumambulation.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The Mus'haf in a dream is wisdom, knowledge, and truth. Reading it indicates enjoining good, forbidding evil, and high status. Whoever sees himself buying a Mus'haf will gain vast knowledge. Whoever sees himself burning a Mus'haf, his religion is corrupted.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The Mus'haf indicates a child, an inheritance, or a just judge. Whoever sees a Mus'haf in his hand will gain authority and knowledge. Eating the pages of the Mus'haf indicates memorizing the Quran and acting upon it. Tearing it indicates ingratitude for Allah's blessings.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The Mus'haf is interpreted as healing, mercy, and guidance. Carrying it indicates adherence to the truth and acting upon it. Whoever sees himself looking into the Mus'haf without reading will inherit a legacy.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Satan in a dream is an enemy in religion and worldly life. He is the unjust ruler, the heretic, and the thief. Whoever sees Satan following him, an enemy is deceiving and tempting him. Whoever wrestles with Satan and overpowers him will be saved from strife and conquer his enemy.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Satan indicates desire, heresy, and heedlessness. Whoever sees that Satan has touched him is consuming usury (Riba) or will be afflicted with worry from women. Whoever sees himself teaching Satan the Quran will gain authority and high status.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Satan is interpreted as a cunning enemy. Whoever sees that he killed Satan will outsmart his enemy and triumph over him. Whoever sees Satan happy and joyous is preoccupied with desires and sins.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Seeing angels in a dream indicates glad tidings, goodness, prosperity, and martyrdom. Speaking to them is gaining honor and prestige. Whoever sees angels in a place of war, Allah will grant victory to the believers. Whoever sees himself wrestling with an angel and is overpowered will be afflicted with worry and humiliation.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Angels indicate hardship and death for the sick. Seeing them in the form of women indicates lying against Allah. Whoever sees the angels prostrating to him will achieve his wishes and his status will be elevated.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Seeing angels is interpreted as glad tidings, relief, and victory. Whoever sees himself flying with them will attain martyrdom. Whoever sees the Angel of Death smiling died in a state of repentance.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Jinn in a dream represent deceitful and cunning people in worldly affairs. Whoever sees jinn standing at his house will suffer a loss or be demanded to pay a debt. Whoever sees himself teaching the jinn the Quran will gain authority and leadership.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Jinn indicate cunning enemies. Whoever becomes a king over the jinn will gain authority and prestige. Whoever sees jinn entering his house and wreaking havoc, thieves will enter his house.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Jinn are interpreted as enemies and tricksters. Befriending them indicates mingling with corrupt people and heretics. Whoever sees that a jinni abducted him will be subjected to magic or illness.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Magic in a dream is strife, disbelief, and delusion. Whoever sees that he has been bewitched is being tempted in his religion, or a separation will occur between him and his wife. Whoever sees himself bewitching people is causing division between them with lies and gossip.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Magic indicates separation between a man and his wife. The magician is a gossiping, strife-making man who spreads corruption. Whoever sees himself learning magic is learning knowledge that does not benefit him and will harm others with it.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Magic is interpreted as falsehood, lies, and strife. Breaking a spell in a dream indicates salvation from the cunning of enemies and guidance after misguidance. Whoever sees himself eating magic is consuming unlawful wealth.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A knife in a dream is a useful servant, a male child, or a proof and argument. Whoever is given a knife will be blessed with a baby boy or his argument will be strengthened. Slaughtering with a knife indicates injustice and undutifulness (to parents). Sharpening a knife indicates preparing for a matter involving dispute.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A knife indicates love and affection if it is in the dreamer's hand and he does not use it. Whoever sees a butcher's knife in his hand will gain authority and power. Whoever injures himself with a knife will fall into a matter that amazes people.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A knife is interpreted as a son, a brother, or a friend. Holding it indicates strength and victory. Whoever sees himself swallowing a knife is relying on his son's wealth.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A needle in a dream indicates a woman, a servant, or travel. Sewing with it indicates righteousness in one's affairs, uniting family, and repentance. Whoever's needle breaks, his affairs will be scattered and his world corrupted. Whoever finds a needle has found help for his affairs.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A needle indicates marriage for the unmarried, wealth for the poor, and covering (protection) for the modest. Whoever sees himself sticking a needle into his body is being slandered in his honor or will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A needle is interpreted as a righteous woman or a loyal friend. The thread in it indicates a small amount of sustenance. Whoever sees himself sewing people's clothes is advising them and striving for their betterment.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A ladder in a dream indicates the means of elevation in religion and worldly life. Climbing a ladder is gaining authority, a strong argument, or a blessed journey. Descending from it is dismissal from a position or a decline in status. An unknown ladder indicates a long life.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A ladder indicates travel, health for the sick, or drawing closer to Allah with righteous deeds. Whoever sees himself climbing a wooden ladder will gain authority from a hypocritical man. Whoever falls from a ladder will fail in his endeavor.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A ladder is interpreted as safety, victory, and high status. Ascending it is elevation, and descending it is a decline. A broken ladder indicates illness or death.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A rope in a dream is a covenant, a pact, and religion. Holding onto a rope is holding onto the religion of Allah. If it snaps, it is a breaking of covenants or abandoning religion. A rope twisted from sand indicates a difficult journey.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A rope indicates travel, partnership, or debt. A knotted rope indicates magic or a marriage contract. Whoever sees a rope descending from the sky, it is the Holy Quran.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A rope is interpreted as connection, kinship, and covenant. Dangling from a rope from a high place is gaining knowledge from a scholar or benefit from a ruler. A rope around the neck is a debt or a trust.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A ship in a dream is salvation for one who is in hardship or worry. Boarding it indicates following guidance and escaping strife. Its sinking is a calamity and destruction. Whoever sees that he owns a ship will get married or buy a maidservant.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A ship indicates the mother, father, wife, or an animal. Its sailing on land is heresy and strife. Boarding it with righteous people is salvation and blessing. Exiting it is safety and relief.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A ship is interpreted as salvation from worry, grief, and fear. Boarding it in a raging sea indicates entering a dangerous affair. A small boat indicates a son or a servant.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A well in a dream indicates a woman, knowledge, wealth, or travel. Digging a well indicates marriage. Clear water in it indicates a righteous wife, and murky water indicates a wife of bad character. Falling into a well indicates falling into cunning and deceit.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A well indicates prison, worry, and confinement. Exiting it is relief and salvation. Whoever sees himself drinking from a well's water will gain wealth through cunning. Whoever sees himself looking into a well is thinking about his marriage.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A well is interpreted as a woman. Whoever sees himself drawing water from a well will gain wealth from a woman. A dry well indicates a poor woman with no good in her. The collapse of a well indicates the death of the wife.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The bridge in a dream represents the world, the path to the Hereafter (Sirat), or a man who connects people. Crossing it indicates salvation from horrors and the removal of worry. Falling from it indicates falling into strife or a loss in worldly life.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The bridge represents a ruler or a scholar from whom people benefit. An unknown bridge represents the world. Whoever sees himself walking on a bridge will gain a high position or travel.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The bridge is interpreted as wealth, position, and prestige. Crossing it is achieving one's goal. A broken bridge indicates difficulty in matters and disappointment. Building a bridge indicates a good deed that benefits people.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The citadel in a dream represents Islam and fortification by it against enemies. Entering it indicates marrying a fortified virgin woman. It is security from fear.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The citadel represents an invincible man, a scholar, or a father. For the traveler, it is a return to his homeland; for the fearful, security; and for the poor, wealth.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The citadel is interpreted as the king or a fortified man. Entering it indicates security, high status, and marriage. Its demolition indicates the loss of position or the death of a great man.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
