interpretations.text: Prison in a dream indicates the grave, illness, worry, or debt. Getting out of it is relief, healing, and payment of debt. Choosing prison indicates protection from strife.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Prison indicates wellness for the sick, or travel, or the marital home for a woman. Entering an unknown prison indicates the grave. A known prison is worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Prison is interpreted as worry, grief, and hardship. Getting out of it is salvation from distress. Whoever sees himself building a prison will meet a misguided leader who calls people to heresy.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Laughter in a dream indicates sadness and regret in wakefulness if it is loud and boisterous. As for smiling, it indicates joy and good tidings of goodness and a righteous child. Laughing at people indicates belittling them.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Laughter in a dream is worry and grief in wakefulness. Smiling indicates righteousness in religion and the good tidings of a child. Whoever sees the earth laugh, it indicates fertility in that year. The laughter of a dead person indicates their bliss in the Hereafter.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Smiling is praiseworthy and indicates joy and happiness. Laughing out loud indicates crying, regret, and calamity. Whoever sees himself laughing with a smile is a righteous man.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Running in a dream indicates eagerness in seeking the world and salvation from fear. Whoever sees himself running away from an enemy will be saved and feel secure. Running on an animal is a quick journey.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Running is fleeing from a frightening matter or striving for an important matter. Running in a known place indicates a noble race. Whoever sees himself running and unable to stop will have a long life.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Running is interpreted as speed in fulfilling needs and salvation from perils. Whoever sees himself running on his feet is striving quickly to seek sustenance.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Drowning in clear water indicates drowning in abundant wealth or worldly affairs. Drowning in murky water indicates strife, heresy, and great worry. Surviving drowning is repentance, returning to God, and salvation from hardship.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Drowning indicates committing a great sin or falling into the hands of an unjust ruler. Whoever dies by drowning in a dream dies in a state of disbelief or heresy. Whoever sees himself drowning then surviving will reform his religion after its corruption.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Drowning is interpreted as ruin in religion or worldly life. Whoever sees a scholar drowning is drowning in his knowledge and heresy. Whoever sees himself helping a drowning person is helping someone in distress.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A gift in a dream indicates love, reconciliation, and marriage proposal. Whoever gives a gift to someone is proposing to his daughter or seeking reconciliation. Accepting a gift indicates acceptance and affection.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A gift indicates joy and happiness. Giving a gift to a deceased person indicates praying for him and giving charity on his behalf. A gift from an unknown person is sustenance that comes from an unexpected source.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A gift is interpreted as reconciliation between disputants and achieving one's goal. A disliked gift indicates ugly speech and gossip. Whoever sees himself sending a gift with a messenger is sending good news.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Sickness in a dream is hypocrisy and corruption in religion, as Allah says, 'In their hearts is a disease.' It may also indicate health, well-being, and long life, which is one of the opposites in interpretation. The sickness of a ruler indicates his injustice. The sickness of children indicates their disobedience. Whoever sees himself sick while healthy in reality will live in prosperity that year but will be negligent in his worship.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Sickness indicates victory over enemies, long life, and achieving wishes. It may also indicate unemployment and poverty. Whoever sees himself sick and dies in his sickness, it indicates the righteousness of his religion and a good end. Sickness in the family indicates a deficiency in religion or a worry that afflicts them. A light illness indicates joy coming from enemies.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Sickness is interpreted as worry, grief, and deficiency in religion. Recovery from it is repentance, relief, and removal of worry. Whoever sees himself visiting a sick person is seeking the world and will obtain it. Whoever sees that his wife is sick is physically healthy but hypocritical in her religion.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Healing from sickness in a dream indicates repentance from sins, relief after hardship, release from prison, and payment of debt. It is righteousness in religion and worldly life.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Healing indicates righteousness in religion and worldly life. For the poor, it is wealth; for the worried, relief; and for the captive, salvation. Whoever sees that he has been cured of his illness will be saved from strife or heresy.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Healing is interpreted as salvation from hardships, payment of debts, and emerging from worries. For the sinner, it is repentance, and for the believer, an increase in faith.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The head in a dream is one's capital, leader, and manager. A large head indicates honor, high status, and an increase in prestige. The head being cut off indicates freedom from slavery, payment of debt, removal of worry, or gaining great wealth.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The head indicates the father, the manager, or anyone who is a leader. A headache indicates a sin that requires repentance and charity. Whoever sees that he has many heads will have many children, followers, or abundant sustenance.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The head is interpreted as leadership and wealth. Whoever sees his head is cut off and he is carrying it will gain kingship and authority. Whoever eats a human head will gain wealth from a great leader.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The eye in a dream is a man's religion and his insight with which he sees the truth. The beauty and strength of the eye indicate the strength of religion and faith. Blindness of the eye is misguidance in religion. Whoever sees that he has many eyes, his religion and righteousness will increase.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The eye indicates a child and wealth. A blue eye is heresy in religion, and a green eye is a religion that opposes the religions of Muslims. Whoever sees that he is treating another's eye is guiding him to the right path.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The eye is interpreted as a child, a close friend, or wealth. Pain in the eye is worry and grief because of whom it represents. Gouging out an eye indicates a great calamity or the loss of a child.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The right hand indicates strength, sustenance, livelihood, and earnings. The left hand indicates a brother, a friend, or a wife. Long hands indicate generosity, strength, and victory. The cutting off of the right hand indicates a false oath or theft.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The hand indicates work and giving. The cutting off of the left hand indicates severing ties of kinship with his brothers or friends. Whoever sees his hands tied is a stingy man. Whoever sees his hand become a child's hand is doing a deed that involves play.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The hand is interpreted as a brother, a partner, or a son. Its shortness indicates stinginess and a short life. Whoever sees himself walking on his hands is relying on his brother or partner in his affairs.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The foot in a dream is a man's support in his world and his endeavor. The cutting off of the foot is a loss of wealth, a difficult journey, or the death of an animal. Walking barefoot indicates worry, fatigue, and deficiency in religion.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The foot indicates striving for good or evil. An increase in feet is an increase in travel, wealth, or strength. Whoever sees himself walking on one foot will lose half of his wealth or his partner.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The foot is interpreted as the parents. The right is the father, and the left is the mother. Whatever bad happens to them reflects on them. Washing the feet indicates the removal of worries and the righteousness of affairs.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The heart in a dream is the king of the body and its manager. It indicates a man's courage, generosity, and religion. Heart pain is hypocrisy. Whoever sees that he has no heart will be afflicted with severe fear.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The heart indicates what is in a person's inner self of secrets and faith. Eating a heart indicates gaining wealth from an enemy through cunning. The heart coming out of its place indicates righteousness in religion and piety.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The heart is interpreted as religion, the mind, and the secret. Its soundness is the soundness of religion, and its corruption is the corruption of religion. A hard heart indicates distance from God.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The tongue in a dream is its owner's interpreter, the manager of his affairs, and his argument. A long tongue indicates eloquence, talkativeness, and victory in disputes. The cutting off of the tongue indicates the invalidation of an argument or the death of an interpreter.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The tongue indicates authority. Whoever sees hair on his tongue, it is an increase in knowledge and poetry. Whoever sees that he has two tongues is blessed with double the knowledge and argument.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The tongue is interpreted as a son, a servant, or a consultant. Its being tied indicates poverty, incapacity, and corruption in religion. A tied tongue (in a knot) indicates eloquence and rhetoric.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The ear in a dream is a man's wife, his daughter, or his news. The beauty of the ear indicates the good reputation and obedience of the wife. Deafness indicates corruption in religion.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The ear indicates knowledge, news, hearing, and obedience. Whoever sees himself putting his fingers in his ears hears what he dislikes and will die upon heresy.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The ear is interpreted as prestige and reputation. Whoever sees that he has many ears will hear much news, and perhaps it indicates that he spies on people.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A thief in a dream indicates illness or a suitor who comes in secret. If he is black, it is an illness in the blood, and if he is red, it is an illness in the bile. Catching the thief indicates knowing the illness and its treatment.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A thief indicates a cunning, deceitful man, an adulterer, or a seeker of knowledge in the wrong way. His entry into the house indicates the entry of illness or a failed marriage proposal.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A thief is interpreted as an enemy or a predator. Wrestling with him is wrestling with an enemy. Whoever sees himself become a thief is lying, committing adultery, or falling into sin.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The doctor in a dream is a reformer in religion and worldly life, like a jurist or a ruler. His visit to a sick person indicates his recovery, and to a healthy person, his illness.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The doctor indicates a scholar or a ruler who reforms people's affairs. Whoever sees himself become a doctor will gain a high position, wisdom, and knowledge.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The doctor is interpreted as a man who reconciles people and removes their worries. Visiting him indicates the removal of worry and seeking a need from the right people.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Wine in a dream is unlawful money obtained without effort. Whoever drinks it and does not get drunk will gain lawful wealth. Drunkenness from it indicates fear, ignorance, and the loss of blessings. Whoever sees himself pressing wine is serving a ruler and gaining unlawful money from him.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Wine indicates strife, evil, enmity, and hatred. For a ruler, it may indicate dismissal. Drinking wine with a group indicates participation in strife and heresy.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Drinking wine is interpreted as committing a great sin. Whoever sees himself in a wine gathering is heedless of God's remembrance and falls into diversion and falsehood. The river of wine in Paradise indicates lawful sustenance and marriage to the Houris (maidens of Paradise).

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Onions in a dream indicate the appearance of hidden matters and the revealing of secrets. For a healthy dreamer, it is sickness and fatigue, and for the sick, recovery. Eating it indicates evil, worry, and unlawful money.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Onions indicate unlawful money, gossip, and ugly speech. Eating it cooked indicates repentance and returning to God. A few onions indicate seeking good that is followed by evil.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Onions are interpreted as worry, grief, and crying. Eating them indicates hearing disliked words from relatives. Peeling them indicates flattering a lowly man.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Garlic in a dream is ugly unlawful money and ugly praise. Eating it cooked indicates repentance from sins. Eating it raw indicates consuming unlawful money or backbiting and gossip.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Garlic indicates worry, grief, sadness, and crying. Uprooting it from the ground indicates harm afflicting the dreamer from his relatives. For the sick, it is recovery.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Garlic is interpreted as unlawful money and bad speech. Whoever sees himself eating garlic, people will insult and blame him because of his greed.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The dove indicates a beloved, righteous woman, a trustworthy messenger, or good news. Its cooing indicates wailing, crying, and longing. Whoever catches a dove will marry a righteous woman.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The dove is a woman who is impressed with herself and has a beautiful voice. Slaughtering it is marriage to a virgin. Its feathers are wealth from a woman. Whoever sees a dove on his head or shoulder, it indicates his righteous work.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The dove is interpreted as a woman, a maidservant, or true news. Whoever catches a dove will gain wealth from a beautiful woman. Many doves in the house indicate many offspring and blessings.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The crow is a corrupt, lying, arrogant man. Whoever sees a crow in his house, a corrupt man is betraying his wife or coveting her. Catching a crow indicates falling into worry and hardship.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The crow indicates separation, alienation, and worry. Its cawing is bad news and calamity. Killing it is salvation from worry and hardship. A black crow indicates winter and its cold.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The crow is interpreted as a corrupt man or worry and grief. The pied crow (black and white) indicates a hypocritical man who shows good and hides evil.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Ants indicate soldiers, a household, or a long life. Many ants in a place indicate its many people. Their exit from the house is worry and grief. Ants with wings indicate the death of soldiers or travel.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Ants indicate weak, greedy people. Whoever sees ants on his bed will have many children. Whoever sees ants coming out of their hole will be afflicted with worry. Whoever understands the speech of ants will gain authority.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Ants are interpreted as sustenance and fertility. Their entry into the house with food is goodness, blessing, and low prices. Their exit with food indicates poverty and high prices.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Bees indicate fertility, spoils, and lawful sustenance from a source involving danger. Whoever acquires bees has acquired lawful wealth. Honey from bees is lawful wealth and healing.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Bees indicate people of knowledge, work, and striving for sustenance. Their sting is gaining wealth with fatigue and hardship. Whoever kills bees has destroyed wealth or lost a trade.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Bees are interpreted as benefit and good sustenance. Whoever sees that he owns beehives will gain authority, leadership, and abundant wealth.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The donkey indicates luck, fortune, and fate. Riding it is gaining adornment and status. Its death is the death of its master or the loss of his wealth. Its braying is ugly speech from a foolish man.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The donkey indicates a son, travel, or a scholar without action. A fat donkey indicates the dreamer's wealth, and a thin one his poverty. The donkey carrying the dreamer indicates the strength of his luck.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The donkey is interpreted as luck. A white donkey is good luck, a black one is leadership and wealth, and a green one indicates a pious, god-fearing man.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The apple in a dream is a man's ambition and what he strives for. Sweet apples are lawful wealth, and sour ones are unlawful wealth. Counted apples are counted dirhams (money). The apple tree is a faithful man, close to people.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Apples indicate children and beautiful faces. Whoever smells one in a mosque will get married. Whoever eats one will get what he desires. Apple juice is sustenance from a noble man.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Apples are interpreted as benefit and pleasure. Whoever gets one will attain what he wishes for, proportional to it. A green apple is a blessed son, a red one is a benefit from a ruler, and a white one is a profitable trade.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The pomegranate in a dream is collected wealth or a prosperous city. A single pomegranate is a woman. A sweet one is a righteous, beautiful woman, and a sour one is a bad woman or worry. The pomegranate tree is a noble man among his people.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A pomegranate indicates easy sustenance. Pomegranate seeds are collected wealth. Eating a sweet pomegranate indicates marrying a virgin or buying a beautiful maidservant.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The pomegranate is interpreted as wealth. A sweet one is collected lawful wealth, and a sour one is worry and grief. Whoever sees himself selling pomegranates is choosing the world over the Hereafter.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Figs in a dream are abundant wealth and fertility for whoever obtains them. Eating them indicates many offspring. Its tree indicates a rich, beneficial man to whom the enemies of Islam seek refuge.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Figs indicate sustenance that comes from the direction of Iraq. Eating them out of season is envy and regret. Dried figs indicate lasting wealth and continuous sustenance.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Figs are interpreted as wealth and blessing. Eating them in their season is goodness, benefit, and sustenance without effort. Whoever sees himself gathering them is striving to obtain abundant wealth.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Olives in a dream are wealth, blessing, and guidance. Its tree is a blessed man, beneficial to his family. Olive leaves indicate adherence to religion. Olive oil is knowledge, blessing, and lawful sustenance.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Olives indicate knowledge, the Quran, and lawful money. Pressing them indicates fatigue and hardship, followed by comfort and blessing. Yellow olives are sickness and worry.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Olives are interpreted as lawful money, blessing, and benefit. Its oil is light, wisdom, and healing. Whoever sees himself planting an olive tree will have a blessed son.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Perfume in a dream is good praise, a beautiful memory, and useful knowledge. Whoever wears perfume will attain joy, happiness, and high status. Whoever sees himself selling perfume to people is spreading knowledge and wisdom among them.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Perfume indicates marriage for the unmarried, a child for the pregnant, healing for the sick, and guidance for the sinner. A good scent of perfume indicates good news.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Perfume is interpreted as beautiful praise and a good reputation. Whoever sees himself making perfume is composing knowledge or saying poetry that benefits people.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The crown in a dream for a man is authority, honor, and kingship. For a woman, it is a rich husband of high status. A crown studded with jewels is better than one of pure gold. The crown falling from the head indicates the loss of position or divorce of the wife.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The crown indicates knowledge, the Quran, and kingship. Wearing it on the head indicates marriage to a noble, rich woman, or attaining great authority. A crown of gold for a man is strife in his religion.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The crown is interpreted as high status, prestige, and authority. Whoever sees a crown on his head, his status will rise among people. If the dreamer is a scholar, his knowledge will increase.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A bracelet of gold is an inheritance that will fall into the dreamer's hand. If it is of silver, it is good for the man in his religion and strength. For women, a bracelet is adornment and a husband. Whoever sees himself wearing two gold bracelets will be afflicted with harm from what his hands possess. Shackles and bracelets of silver indicate adherence to religion.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The bracelet indicates what is in a man's hand of wealth or work. It may indicate a brother, son, or friend. Whoever sees that he is wearing a gold bracelet is a man who oppresses people. If a woman sees it, it is joy and marriage to a man of position.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The bracelet is interpreted as worry and grief for a man if it is of gold, and for a woman, adornment and joy. A bracelet of silver indicates a trustworthy servant or lawful money. A bracelet of iron indicates strength and invincibility.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The necklace in a dream for a woman is a husband or a son. For a man, it is authority, a covenant, or a trust. A necklace of pearls indicates knowledge and the Quran. The breaking of the necklace indicates the loss of position or a problem with the wife or son.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The necklace indicates beauty and adornment. Whoever sees a necklace of jewels around his neck will be entrusted with a great trust or gain useful knowledge. For men, a necklace indicates a debt on their necks.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The necklace is interpreted as a covenant and a promise. A beautiful necklace indicates good fulfillment of the covenant. Whoever sees his necklace break and get lost has broken his covenant or lost his trust.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The turban is a man's crown, his honor, his prestige, and his authority. Its beauty and color indicate his state in his authority. A turban of wool indicates asceticism and piety. Its fall indicates the loss of position or separation from the wife.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The turban indicates a wife or leadership. Whoever sees himself wrapping his turban is embarking on a journey. Whoever sees that the ruler gave him a turban will be appointed to a position of authority.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The turban is interpreted as prestige, position, and wife. Whoever sees his turban stolen, his authority is gone or he has separated from his wife. A yellow turban is an illness in the head.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The palace in a dream is a man of high status and righteousness. Entering it indicates marriage, gaining authority, or achieving a wish. An unknown palace indicates Paradise for the pious and Hellfire for the disobedient.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The palace indicates righteous deeds and high status in this world and the Hereafter. Whoever builds a palace will gain high status, kingship, and authority. Whoever sees himself in a palace is safe from fear and will attain joy.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The palace is interpreted as joy, security, and prestige. For the dreamer, it is honor, prestige, and high status. The demolition of the palace indicates the loss of blessings or the death of a great man.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Snow in a dream is sustenance, healing, and spoils if it is in its season and causes no harm. Out of its season, it indicates illnesses, worries, and strife. Walking on snow indicates striving for a matter involving danger and delusion.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Snow indicates wealth and fertility. If the snow is little, it is good. If it is a lot, it is torment. Eating snow in summer indicates the removal of worry, and in winter, it indicates illness.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Snow is interpreted as torment and soldiers. Its fall in its season indicates low prices and the removal of worries. Out of its season, it indicates the injustice of the ruler.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Lightning in a dream indicates guidance after misguidance and the uncovering of hidden matters. It may also indicate a threat from the ruler and fear. Lightning with no rain indicates false promises.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Lightning indicates laughter, glad tidings, and joy. If it burns clothes, it indicates the death of the sick or a scandal. Whoever sees lightning flashing from his house will receive goodness and sustenance.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Lightning is interpreted as an order from the ruler involving fear and hope. If it is with rain, it is goodness and benefit. If it is without rain, it is fear for nothing.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Thunder in a dream is a threat and a warning from the ruler. It may also indicate the king's commands. Thunder alone indicates fear and strife. If it is with rain, it indicates goodness and sustenance.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Thunder indicates fear of the ruler, and it may indicate praising and thanking God. Hearing it indicates strife, wars, and disputes.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Thunder is interpreted as fear of the ruler. If it is with rain and lightning, it is great goodness and benefit. Hearing thunder in its season indicates glad tidings of goodness.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Mud in a dream is sickness, humiliation, and worry. Walking in it is worry, grief, and strife. Eating mud indicates backbiting, gossip, and consuming unlawful money.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Mud indicates severe disease. Building with mud indicates steadfastness in religion and certainty. Whoever falls into mud falls into strife or illness.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Mud is interpreted as strife and hardship. Getting out of it is salvation from worry and illness. Whoever sees himself kneading mud is striving for a lawful matter from which he will earn.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Dust in a dream is wealth. If it is on the face, it is worry, travel, and fatigue. Whoever sees dust rising to the sky, it is a matter that is lost and no news is known of it.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Dust indicates travel or confusion in a matter. Shaking it off clothes indicates poverty and loss of wealth. Dust on riding animals indicates wealth and spoils.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Dust is interpreted as wealth. Its rising to the sky indicates a great event happening in that region. Dust on clothes indicates a journey that brings wealth.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Tears in a dream, if cold, are joy and happiness. If hot, they are worry and sadness. Tears running down the face without crying indicate bad words spoken against the dreamer.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Tears indicate longing for an absent person and loneliness. Flowing from the right eye indicates a matter related to religion, and from the left, a matter related to the world.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Tears are interpreted as joy and relief. If they are of blood, it is remorse and repentance. Whoever sees himself wiping his tears is consoling another in his sadness.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The nose in a dream is what a person prides himself on, such as family, wealth, prestige, or a parent. Its large size indicates high status and prestige. Its small size indicates lowliness. The nose being cut off indicates the dreamer's death or a calamity in whomever it represents.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The nose indicates the father, son, brother, or partner. Its blockage indicates difficulty in matters and death. A nosebleed from it indicates unlawful money.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The nose is interpreted as comfort, prestige, and honor. Something coming out of it indicates the birth of a son or receiving sustenance. A beautiful nose indicates a good state of affairs.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The mouth in a dream is the key to a man's affairs, their conclusion, the source of his sustenance, and his secret. Its large size indicates high status, and its small size indicates lowliness. Something good coming out of it indicates good speech and useful knowledge. Something bad coming out of it indicates ugly speech and backbiting.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The mouth indicates sustenance, knowledge, and guidance. Whoever sees his mouth is sealed will die in a state of disbelief. Whoever sees himself eating from another's mouth will receive goodness from him.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The mouth is interpreted as the house or the treasury. What comes out of it indicates what is in a person's inner self. A beautiful mouth indicates good praise.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The ram (or sheep) in a dream is a male child who is obedient to his parents. Whoever gets a ram will get a righteous son. Slaughtering it indicates disobedience from the son or his death. Eating its meat indicates gaining wealth from his son.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The ram indicates a noble, generous man who is obeyed by his people. Whoever sees himself carrying a ram will gain authority or take responsibility for a great man.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The ram is interpreted as a man of great stature. Its wool, milk, and horn are wealth, benefit, and blessing. Whoever sees himself fighting a ram is disputing with a noble man.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The wolf is an unjust enemy, a lying thief. Whoever sees a wolf in his house, a thief will enter his house. Killing the wolf is victory over the enemy. Whoever sees himself turn into a wolf will attain joy and benefit.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The wolf indicates the accusation of an innocent man, referencing the story of Joseph (Yusuf). Seeing it indicates poverty and fear. Fleeing from it is salvation from the enemy's cunning.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The wolf is interpreted as an unjust king or a severe thief. Whoever sees himself eating wolf meat will gain wealth from a ruler. The wolf's head indicates gaining authority.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The fox is a treacherous, cunning, lying man, or a deceitful woman. Whoever struggles with a fox is disputing with one of his relatives. Drinking its milk is recovery from illness. Whoever catches a fox will get a woman he loves.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The fox indicates an enemy who lies and equivocates much. Playing with a fox indicates the presence of a treacherous woman in the dreamer's life, or vice versa.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The fox is interpreted as a deceitful man or a cunning woman. Killing it is victory over such a man. Whoever sees a fox fleeing from him has a debt owed by a procrastinating man.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The spider indicates a cursed woman who abandons her husband's bed. The spider's web is weakness and feebleness. Whoever sees a spider in his house will see a weak, frail man.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The spider is a devout, ascetic man or a weaver. Killing it indicates expelling a corrupt man. Its house indicates weakness and lack of resourcefulness.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The spider is interpreted as a misguided man, woven into his sin. Whoever sees that he killed a spider will repent from a sin or move away from a bad friend.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The elephant is a huge, tyrannical foreign king. Riding an elephant indicates gaining authority or marrying a woman of great origin. Killing an elephant is conquering a king or a country.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The elephant indicates a blessed man or a king. Whoever sees himself speaking to an elephant will receive goodness from a ruler. Whoever sees a dead elephant, a great king has died in that land.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The elephant is interpreted as a man of great stature or a king. Speaking to an elephant is receiving a blessing from the ruler. Whoever sees himself fleeing from an elephant is fleeing from the ruler.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The camel in a dream is a patient man, or sadness, or travel. Riding a camel is travel or gaining authority. The death of a camel is the death of a great man or the loss of a blessing. A raging camel is a foolish man or a strong enemy.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The camel indicates death, travel, or hatred. Whoever sees that he owns camels will gain leadership and authority. Eating camel meat indicates illness followed by recovery.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The camel is interpreted as a great man. Whoever sees himself riding a camel will embark on a blessed journey. Whoever sees a camel speaking to him will receive goodness that will amaze people.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The cage in a dream is prison or distress. A bird in it indicates a son or a slave. Whoever sees himself in a cage will be imprisoned or fall ill.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The cage indicates a man's home or his shop. Getting out of it is relief for the prisoner and healing for the sick. An empty cage indicates an abandoned house or a grave.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The cage is interpreted as prison and distress. If it has a beautiful bird in it, it is a blessed son. If it is empty, it is worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The coffin (or ark) in a dream indicates a man's house, his wife, or his heart that holds his secret. Whoever sees himself in a coffin will gain great authority, kingship, and prestige.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The coffin indicates tranquility, dignity, and sustenance. For the worried, it is relief, and for the fearful, security. Whoever finds a coffin has found a treasure or knowledge.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The coffin is interpreted as kingship and high status. Carrying it indicates serving the ruler. Whoever sees himself making a coffin is building a house or getting married.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Cheese in a dream is wealth with comfort, joy, and fertility. Soft cheese is better than dry and indicates immediate sustenance. Dry cheese indicates travel and upcoming sustenance.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Cheese indicates blessed sustenance, a contract, and marriage. Eating it with bread indicates a sudden illness. A single piece of cheese indicates one thousand dirhams.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Cheese is interpreted as lawful money. Dry cheese is a journey with benefit. Soft cheese is immediate, blessed sustenance.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Sugar in a dream is good speech, joy, and the removal of worries. It may indicate kisses and celebrations. Eating it indicates gaining lawful sustenance.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Sugar indicates knowledge and the Quran. Whoever sees himself gathering sugar is gathering lawful money. For the prisoner, it is relief, and for the sick, healing.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Sugar is interpreted as wealth and healing from illnesses. For disputants, it is reconciliation, and for the unmarried, marriage. Seeing it indicates hearing good news.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The frog in a dream is a virtuous, devout man, diligent in obeying God. Many frogs in a town indicate torment from God. Eating frog meat is gaining a small benefit from a relative or neighbor.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The frog indicates a righteous neighbor or a righteous woman. Catching one indicates accompanying nobles and scholars. The croaking of frogs indicates false speech or noise.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The frog is interpreted as a magician or a tempter. Whoever sees himself speaking to a frog will gain authority. Whoever sees many frogs leaving a town, evil and worry have left it.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The turtle in a dream is a knowledgeable, ascetic, pious man. Eating its meat indicates gaining knowledge or wealth from a righteous man. Whoever sees a turtle in his house is mingling with scholars and benefiting from them.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The turtle indicates a judge or a man who conceals himself with knowledge and avoids doubts. On the road, it indicates neglected knowledge.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The turtle is interpreted as an adorned, hidden woman. Its presence in a place indicates goodness, fertility, and low prices in that place.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Worms in a dream indicate daughters or enemies from the family. Silkworms indicate the ruler's subjects and his goodness. Worms in the stomach are a man's children eating from his wealth. Worms exiting the body are the removal of worry, grief, and relief. Eating worms indicates gaining wealth from enemies or envy.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Worms in food indicate sustenance, goodness, and blessing. Worms in water indicate fatigue from children. Green worms indicate a righteous woman. Whoever sees many worms in his house, his offspring and goodness will increase.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Worms are interpreted as wealth, servants, and family. Whoever sees worms eating his flesh, his children or servants are eating from his wealth. White worms in a dream indicate hypocrisy and deceit.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The dragon in a dream is a tyrannical king, a great enemy, or a raging sea. Whoever sees himself riding a dragon will gain a great kingdom or travel by sea on a dangerous journey. Killing it indicates victory over a strong enemy.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The dragon indicates an unjust ruler, fire, or heresy. Whoever turns into a dragon will have a long life and gain authority. Eating its meat indicates gaining wealth from the king.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The dragon is interpreted as the sea, the king, or a man of great danger. Riding it indicates gaining a great kingdom, proportional to its obedience. Whoever sees himself fighting a dragon is fighting a tyrannical king.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Swimming in the sea indicates delving into knowledge or entering into the service of a ruler. If he swims and reaches the shore, he will get what he wants. If he does not reach it, he will remain in that matter. Swimming on one's back is repentance from sin.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Swimming indicates striving to fulfill a need. Swimming on land indicates prison and distress. Whoever sees himself swimming with another person is partnering with him in a matter or disputing with him.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Swimming is interpreted as salvation from hardships and fulfillment of needs. Swimming in clear water is lawful sustenance and useful knowledge. In murky water, it is worry and illness.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The Resurrection in a dream indicates justice and fairness for the oppressed against the oppressor. It may also indicate a great war or strife. Whoever sees it happening to him alone, it indicates his death.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The Resurrection indicates general strife and the revealing of secrets. Whoever sees himself being judged with an easy reckoning, it indicates his wife's righteousness and his kindness to her. Whoever is judged with a difficult reckoning, it indicates his loss.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The Resurrection is interpreted as justice and fairness. Whoever sees one of its signs, it is a warning to him from heedlessness. Standing in the gathering place (Mahshar) indicates travel or falling into injustice.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The mirror in a dream indicates vanity, imagination, and the wife. For a pregnant woman to look in it indicates she will give birth to a female who resembles her. For a man, it indicates the arrival of an absent person or a friend in whom he sees himself.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The mirror indicates the wife. Whatever good or bad is seen in it reflects on her. A rusty mirror is the bad state of the wife. A mirror of silver indicates the loss of prestige, and one of gold indicates wealth after poverty.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The mirror is interpreted as prestige and authority. If he sees his face beautiful in it, his situation will improve. If he sees it ugly, his situation will worsen. Whoever sees himself looking into a broken mirror will separate from his wife.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A rainbow in a dream indicates security from fear and strife. Seeing it in red indicates bloodshed in that year; yellow indicates illness; and green indicates fertility.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A rainbow indicates the appearance of strange things. Whoever sees it will get married. Seeing it on the right is good, and on the left is worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A rainbow is interpreted as security, fertility, and the covenant between God and His creation. Seeing it indicates the removal of hardship and the occurrence of happy events.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Eggs in a dream indicate women. Many eggs indicate wealth that one fears will be corrupted. Eating raw eggs is unlawful money, worry, or adultery. Boiled eggs are blessed sustenance and the righteousness of an affair.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Eggs indicate children, spouses, and gathering with family. Whoever sees a hen lay an egg will be blessed with a son. Breaking an egg indicates deflowering a virgin.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Eggs are interpreted as gold and silver. Chicken eggs are blessed sustenance. Whoever sees that he owns many eggs owns abundant wealth and fears its loss.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Wheat in a dream is collected lawful money that comes with fatigue and hardship. An ear of wheat indicates a fertile year. Harvesting it indicates the approach of death or war.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Wheat indicates gold. Whoever sees himself planting wheat is doing a righteous deed that pleases God. Eating cooked wheat indicates goodness will afflict him.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Wheat is interpreted as wealth and sustenance. Eating it indicates righteousness in religion. Storing it indicates saving money for the family.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Vinegar in a dream is blessed money involving fatigue. Drinking it indicates enmity with family. Eating it with bread indicates contentment and blessing in life.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Vinegar indicates long life and blessing in sustenance. It may also indicate a righteous man who benefits those around him.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Vinegar is interpreted as wealth and benefit. Apple vinegar is better than grape vinegar and indicates lawful money.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Salt in a dream is money without effort. It may also indicate strife and illness. Whoever finds salt has found wealth. Eating bread with salt indicates contentment and satisfaction.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Salt indicates asceticism in the world. White salt indicates a righteous man. Seasoning food with salt indicates the righteousness of affairs.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Salt is interpreted as wealth and reconciliation between people. Its corruption is corruption in religion and work. Whoever sees the earth turn to salt, a calamity has befallen it.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Ascending in a dream is elevation in religion and worldly life. Ascending to the sky is gaining authority, but with danger. Ascending a mountain is gaining high status, but with fatigue. For the sick, it is death.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Ascending indicates fulfilling needs and achieving wishes. Ascending a ladder indicates drawing closer to God with righteous deeds.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Ascending is interpreted as honor, prestige, and high status. Ascending to a high place indicates overpowering enemies and success.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Descending from a high place indicates a change of situation for the worse, dismissal from a position, and poverty after wealth. If one descends to a good place, he is moving to comfort after fatigue.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Descending indicates a decline in status, worry, and grief. Descending from the sky indicates God's anger or a severe illness.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Descending is interpreted as worry and grief. Descending to an unknown place indicates death. Descending from a mountain after climbing it indicates completing the matter successfully.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A hammer in a dream indicates a policeman, an aide to the ruler, or a person who divides people. Striking with it indicates victory over enemies.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A hammer indicates strength, might, and sustenance. Hearing its sound indicates a dispute and ugly speech.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A hammer is interpreted as a formidable and strong man. Striking with it indicates conquering enemies and facilitating difficult matters.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A watch (or the Hour) in a dream indicates the coming of the Hour (Day of Judgment) or a matter that happens suddenly. It may also indicate travel or a change in conditions. Looking at it indicates waiting for relief.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A watch indicates sustenance, debt, or worry. Its stopping indicates the disruption of affairs. Fixing it indicates rectifying a corrupt matter.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A watch is interpreted as glad tidings or a warning. If it is accurate, it indicates the straightness of affairs. If it is broken, it indicates chaos.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The kitchen in a dream indicates the servant of the house, the manager of its affairs, or the man's wife. Its cleanliness indicates the righteousness of the servant or wife, and its dirtiness indicates the opposite.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The kitchen indicates the place of sustenance and livelihood. A lit fire in it is sustenance and fertility. If it is empty of food, it indicates poverty and unemployment.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The kitchen is interpreted as the head of the house. Whatever food is seen in it indicates sustenance and goodness. A spacious kitchen indicates abundant sustenance.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The bathhouse (Hammam) in a dream indicates a man's wife or his maidservant. It may also indicate worry, grief, and illness. Bathing in it is repentance, healing, and removal of worry.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The bathhouse indicates the ruler's house, prison, or the house of transgressors. Hot water in it is worry and illness, and cold water is healing and wellness.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The bathhouse is interpreted as a woman of ill repute. Whoever builds a bathhouse will fall into a matter involving strife. Exiting it is salvation from hardship.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A wedding and celebration in a dream indicate calamity and death if there is amusement, music, and dancing. If it is without these, it is joy and goodness. Attending a wedding indicates participation in a calamity.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A wedding indicates worry, grief, and crying. Whoever sees himself as a groom but does not see his bride will die or kill someone. A wedding in a house with a sick person indicates his death.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A wedding is interpreted as worry and sadness. If it does not involve any amusement or music, it is goodness, joy, and blessing.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A funeral indicates a hypocritical man at whose hands people will perish. Walking in a funeral indicates following a corrupt ruler. Whoever sees himself being carried in a funeral will gain authority and high status.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A funeral indicates brotherhood for the sake of God and connecting with kin. Carrying the funeral is serving the ruler. Praying over it is the fulfillment of a need.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A funeral is interpreted as leadership and wealth. A funeral flying in the air indicates the death of a great man in a foreign land.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Debt in a dream is humiliation by day and worry by night. Paying it off is relief and salvation from worry, healing for the sick, and wealth for the poor. Whoever dies while in debt has died in a state of misguidance.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Debt indicates illness, prison, and distress. Whoever sees himself paying off his debt is connecting with his kin or feeding a poor person.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Debt is interpreted as worry and imprisonment. Paying it off indicates releasing a captive, healing the sick, and completing an unfinished matter.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Iron in a dream is wealth, honor, and strength for whoever obtains it. Eating iron indicates victory over enemies and speaking about people's honor. Melting it indicates falling victim to people's tongues.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Iron indicates a man of great might. Wearing a shirt of iron indicates protection from enemies and a long life.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Iron is interpreted as wealth and benefit from a ruler. Whoever sees himself making something from iron will gain sustenance with fatigue.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Silver in a dream is collected wealth, joy, and happiness. Extracting it from a mine indicates cunning with women. Utensils of silver indicate lawful possessions and profitable trade.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Silver indicates righteous deeds and obedience. A dirham (coin) of silver is a handsome baby boy. Wearing an anklet of silver indicates fear and prison.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Silver is interpreted as a beautiful woman or lawful money. Whoever sees himself melting silver is disputing with his wife and falling victim to people's tongues.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Fighting in a dream indicates high prices and strife. Fighting people indicates an epidemic. Whoever sees himself fighting the people of falsehood is championing the truth.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Fighting indicates dispute and effort. Victory in it is victory in wakefulness. Whoever sees himself kill a person is committing a great sin.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Fighting is interpreted as dispute and argument. Whoever sees himself kill himself is repenting sincerely. Fighting the king indicates low prices.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The pig is a huge man with unlawful wealth, and he is a cursed enemy who does not keep a covenant. Riding one is gaining unlawful money and authority. Eating its meat indicates consuming unlawful money.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The pig indicates a strong, unjust enemy. The domestic pig indicates fertility and prosperity that does not last. The wild boar indicates cold and rain.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The pig is interpreted as a lowly man from the non-Muslims (Ahl al-Dhimma) or a conquering enemy. Whoever sees himself fighting a pig is fighting a strong enemy.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The eagle in a dream is a king or a noble man with a long life and prestige. Whoever owns an eagle will gain authority and honor. Whoever sees an eagle fall on him will receive good from a king.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The eagle indicates long life and abundant wealth. Eating its meat is gaining wealth from the ruler. Whoever sees an eagle snatch him will travel far and gain high status.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The eagle is interpreted as a strong king. Whoever sees an eagle hovering over his head will gain authority and honor. The death of an eagle indicates the death of a king or a great scholar.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A kiss in a dream indicates fulfilling a need and victory over an enemy. Kissing a dead person indicates gaining good from his knowledge or wealth. Kissing the ruler indicates gaining authority.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A kiss indicates connection, affection, and goodness. A kiss with desire indicates seeking the world. Whoever sees himself kissing a young boy will fall into enmity with his father.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A kiss is interpreted as goodness and benefit. Kissing a hand indicates humility. Kissing the ground indicates fulfilling a need from a great man.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Light in a dream is guidance, knowledge, and the Quran. Emerging from darkness into light is repentance from sin and guidance after misguidance. Whoever sees himself wearing a garment of light will gain useful knowledge. Bright light indicates righteousness in religion and worldly life.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Light indicates righteous work. Whoever sees light shining from his body will gain knowledge and guidance and become famous for righteousness. Whoever sees himself following a light is following the truth and the Sunnah.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Light is interpreted as Islam, knowledge, and wisdom. Walking in the light is uprightness on the truth. Whoever sees a dark place where light shines, God will relieve the worries of its people.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Darkness in a dream is confusion and misguidance. Walking in darkness indicates delving into falsehood and heresy. Emerging from it is salvation from worry, grief, and repentance.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Darkness indicates oppression and injustice. For the disbeliever, it is torment, and for the believer, loneliness and worry. Sitting in darkness is unemployment from work.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Darkness is interpreted as worry, grief, and hardship. Whoever sees himself in darkness then emerges into light will repent, his situation will improve, and he will become wealthy after poverty.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Dancing in a dream is calamity, worry, and grief. It indicates a scandal and the revealing of secrets. For a sick person, dancing indicates the protraction of his illness. A woman dancing indicates a great scandal.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Dancing for a prisoner indicates his release, and for the poor, sudden wealth that does not last. Dancing in the house indicates a calamity befalling its household. Whoever dances for another shares in his calamity.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Dancing is interpreted as worry and calamity. Whoever sees himself dancing in a public place will become famous for something bad. Dancing alone in a closed place is a lesser worry than dancing in front of people.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Falling from a high place indicates despair of a hoped-for matter, or a change of situation from good to bad. If he falls onto a good place like a mosque or a garden, his change will be for the better.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Falling indicates falling into sin or strife. Surviving it is salvation from that. Falling from an animal indicates a difficult journey or loss of strength.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Falling is interpreted as a change of situation. If no harm befalls him, the change is for the better. If he suffers a fracture or wound, the change is for the worse and a calamity.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A soldier in a dream indicates angels of mercy or torment. A known soldier indicates victory and support. Whoever sees himself become a soldier will gain high status if he is worthy, otherwise, he will fall into a dispute.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A soldier indicates a dispute. Whoever sees himself as a soldier taking his weapon is seeking knowledge and will attain it. The death of a soldier indicates weakness and feebleness.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A soldier is interpreted as victory and support against enemies. Whoever sees himself among soldiers is safe from fear and will achieve his goal.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: An arrow in a dream is a letter, a messenger, or speech. Shooting an arrow indicates speaking about people's honor or sending a messenger. Whoever hits his target with his arrow has achieved his goal.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: An arrow indicates fulfilling a need and achieving a goal. A broken arrow indicates incapacity and failure. Whoever sees himself shooting an arrow into the sky is arrogant and tyrannical.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: An arrow is interpreted as a message, strength, or a male child. Shooting it indicates sending a messenger or impactful speech.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The lamp in a dream is the caretaker of the house, the scholar of the town, or a righteous son. Its light indicates righteousness in religion and worldly life. Its extinguishing indicates the death of whomever it represents or the loss of a blessing.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The lamp indicates a righteous son, a righteous wife, or a good life. A strong lamp light indicates abundant sustenance and relief.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The lamp is interpreted as knowledge, guidance, and faith. Whoever sees himself lighting a lamp will be blessed with a knowledgeable son or will repent from his sins.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The teacher in a dream indicates the ruler, the governor, or anyone who commands and forbids. Whoever sees himself teaching children will gain a position and high status.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The teacher indicates enjoining good and forbidding evil. He is a man of prestige and dignity. Learning from him indicates guidance and righteousness.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The teacher is interpreted as a man of prestige and dignity. Whoever sees himself become a teacher, his status will rise among people.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The farmer in a dream is a man who strives in the affairs of the world and the Hereafter, diligent in his work. Seeing him indicates fertility and sustenance.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The farmer indicates striving and diligence in work. His plowing of the land indicates marriage for the unmarried, and pregnancy for the married.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The farmer is interpreted as a blessed man who brings goodness and benefit. Seeing him indicates a year full of goodness and blessing.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The tailor in a dream is a man who reconciles people and unites them. His sewing of clothes indicates the righteousness of affairs and family reunification.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The tailor indicates a man who strives for reconciliation. Whoever sees himself sewing a garment for himself is reforming his religious and worldly affairs.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The tailor is interpreted as a trustworthy advisor. Whoever sees himself giving a garment to a tailor is consulting a wise man in his affair.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The butcher in a dream indicates the Angel of Death or an unjust, bloodthirsty man. Seeing him indicates hardship and dispute. Buying meat from him indicates a calamity.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The butcher indicates an unjust partner or a man who separates loved ones. An unknown butcher is the Angel of Death.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The butcher is interpreted as a hard-hearted man. Whoever sees himself become a butcher, his heart will become hard and he will oppress people.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The goldsmith in a dream is a lying man who adorns falsehood. Seeing him indicates hypocrisy, pretense, and falling into strife.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The goldsmith indicates a man who unites people with goodness and organizes their affairs. He may also indicate a poet or a scholar.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The goldsmith is interpreted as a man who speaks flowery words that have no truth. Whoever sees himself dealing with him is mingling with people of heresy.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The baker in a dream is a man who is beneficial to people and strives for their interests. Seeing him indicates fertility, prosperity, and low prices.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The baker indicates a just ruler or judge. Taking bread from him indicates receiving blessed sustenance.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The baker is interpreted as a man who manages people's livelihood. His oven indicates the house of justice or the market.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The barber in a dream is a man who takes people's money unjustly. He may also indicate a man who benefits people and removes their worries. Shaving the head with him is payment of debt and removal of worry.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The barber indicates a policeman or a tax collector. Shaving hair out of its proper season indicates poverty and dismissal from a position.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The barber is interpreted as a man who distinguishes between truth and falsehood. Shaving with him indicates repentance and security from fear.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Singing in a dream is false speech and amusement. Beautiful singing indicates a profitable trade. Ugly singing indicates a losing trade. Singing in the market indicates a scandal for the poor and a loss for the rich.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Singing indicates dispute and evil. Whoever sees himself singing falls into strife. The singer is a wise man or scholar who distracts people from the Hereafter.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Singing is interpreted as falsehood and worry. Hearing it indicates hearing false news. Whoever sees himself singing to himself will be afflicted with worry and sadness.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Fear in a dream indicates security in wakefulness. Whoever sees himself afraid will gain security and leadership. Fear of God indicates repentance and guidance.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Fear indicates salvation from hardships. Whoever sees himself afraid of an animal is safe from an enemy.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Fear is interpreted as security. Whoever is afraid in his dream is safe in his wakefulness. Whoever sees himself safe will be afraid in his wakefulness.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Joy in a dream indicates sadness and worry in wakefulness, especially if it involves noise and dancing. Quiet joy indicates happiness and glad tidings.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Joy indicates crying and regret. Whoever sees himself happy and joyous will be afflicted with worry proportional to his joy.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Joy is interpreted as worry and sadness. Joy at another's misfortune indicates gloating and bad character.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
