interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The ostrich is interpreted as a woman. Whoever sees himself slaughtering one will marry a virgin.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The peacock in a dream is a foreign king or a beautiful, rich woman. Its feathers indicate wealth from a woman. A peahen indicates a beautiful maidservant.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The peacock indicates adornment and vanity. Whoever owns a peacock will receive good from a beautiful woman.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The peacock is interpreted as a beautiful woman. Whoever sees himself talking to one will gain authority.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The rooster in a dream is a foreign man, the head of the house, or a muezzin. Its crowing indicates an awakening from heedlessness or the arrival of news.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The rooster indicates a righteous man who enjoins good. Whoever sees himself turn into a rooster will become a muezzin or will die soon.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The rooster is interpreted as a great man. Whoever sees himself fighting a rooster is disputing with a great man.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The hen in a dream is a beautiful, foolish woman. Its entry into the house is goodness and blessing. Its cackling indicates a calamity.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The hen indicates a maidservant or a woman who raises orphans. Whoever sees himself slaughtering one will marry a virgin.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The hen is interpreted as a woman. Its eggs indicate children. Its feathers indicate wealth.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Geese in a dream are beautiful women of wealth. Whoever owns geese will gain wealth and leadership.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Geese indicate a righteous man of high ambition. Their honking indicates a calamity.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Geese are interpreted as wealth and women. Whoever sees himself eating their meat will gain wealth from a woman.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Ducks in a dream are women of dignity. White ducks indicate a righteous woman, and black ones indicate a maidservant.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Ducks indicate righteous men. Their quacking indicates crying in that place.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Ducks are interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees that he owns them will gain wealth from a source related to water.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The crane (bird) in a dream is a poor, needy man. It may also indicate the gathering of people for a good cause.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The crane indicates a man who loves community and familiarity. Its cry indicates a dispute.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The crane is interpreted as a weak man. Whoever sees himself hunting one is oppressing a weak man.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Locusts in a dream are torment and soldiers. If they are cooked or owned, they are wealth and sustenance. If they descend on a town, it is soldiers or strife.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Locusts indicate a rabble. Eating them indicates a small amount of sustenance. Killing them indicates victory over enemies.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Locusts are interpreted as torment. Whoever sees himself eating them will gain wealth from soldiers.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Flies in a dream are a weak, lowly, slandering man. Many flies indicate enemies or worry and grief. Killing them indicates comfort and healing.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Flies indicate unlawful money. They may also indicate a man who gathers people for evil.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Flies are interpreted as a weak enemy. Whoever sees one enter his stomach will mingle with a foolish man and gain wealth from him.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Mosquitoes in a dream are a foolish enemy who sheds blood. Their bite indicates gaining unlawful money from a lowly man.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Mosquitoes indicate worry and sadness from a ruler. Their entry into the house indicates worry entering its household.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Mosquitoes are interpreted as a weak enemy. Whoever sees himself killing one will triumph over his enemy.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Fleas in a dream are weak, slandering enemies. Their bite indicates gaining wealth from foolish people.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Fleas indicate worry and sadness. Killing them indicates victory over enemies.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Fleas are interpreted as a weak enemy. Whoever sees them leaving his house, worry has left him.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Lice in a dream are the world with wealth and children. Many lice are torment. Killing them indicates the removal of worry. Lice in a new garment are authority, and in an old one, debt.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Lice indicate weak enemies. Their bite indicates slander from an enemy. Whoever sees himself picking lice from his garment is being lied about.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Lice are interpreted as wealth and servants. Whoever sees himself eating them is backbiting his servants.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A mouse in a dream is a corrupt woman or a thief. Many mice indicate sustenance and fertility. Whoever sees a mouse playing in his house, his sustenance will increase.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A mouse indicates a Jewish man or a thief. Whoever catches one has gained control over a corrupt woman.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A mouse is interpreted as a servant. Whoever sees himself kill a mouse is firing a servant.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The chameleon in a dream is a man of war or strife. It indicates a fickle man who does not remain in one state.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The chameleon indicates a magician or a hypocritical man. Killing it indicates victory over a magician.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The chameleon is interpreted as a man of bad character who strives for strife.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The mole (animal) in a dream is a man who is blind of heart or misguided. It may also indicate the uncovering of hidden matters.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The mole indicates a heretical man who digs into religion. Whoever catches one will triumph over a misguided man.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The mole is interpreted as a man who strives for worldly affairs and forgets the Hereafter.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The hedgehog in a dream is a quick-tempered man, with little mercy and a narrow chest. It indicates espionage and evil.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The hedgehog indicates a man of bad character who cannot be trusted. Whoever sees himself carrying one is accompanying a man with these traits.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The hedgehog is interpreted as a hateful man. Whoever sees himself eating its meat will gain wealth from a bad man.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The hyena in a dream is an old woman of bad character, a sorceress. Whoever rides one will marry a woman with these traits.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The hyena indicates an unjust enemy. Eating its meat indicates magic.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The hyena is interpreted as an old, sorceress woman. Whoever sees himself fighting one is disputing with a woman.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The bat in a dream indicates a devout, diligent worshiper who is isolated from people. It may also indicate a sorceress. Seeing it indicates security from fear.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The bat indicates the loss of religion and the ruin of a place. It may also indicate a woman of bad character. Whoever catches one will triumph over a misguided man.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The bat is interpreted as a misguided, heretical man. Seeing it indicates unemployment and worry. Whoever sees many bats in a place, ruin will befall it.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The weasel in a dream is a thieving, gossiping, corrupt man. Whoever kills one will triumph over a thief or get rid of a bad man.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The weasel indicates a lowly man who spreads corruption among people. Its bite indicates harm from a man with these traits.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The weasel is interpreted as a man of bad character. Whoever sees himself eating its meat is backbiting a corrupt man.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The sable in a dream is a rich, unjust man. Its fur is unlawful money. Whoever wears it is mingling with an unjust ruler.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The sable indicates a man of wealth and position. Whoever hunts one will gain wealth from a noble man.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The sable is interpreted as a rich man. Whoever sees himself wearing its fur will gain wealth and high status.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The squirrel in a dream is a rich foreign man. Its fur is lawful money.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The squirrel indicates a playful man who loves amusement. Whoever catches one has befriended a man with these traits.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The squirrel is interpreted as a rich man. Whoever sees himself eating its meat will gain wealth from a rich man.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The crocodile in a dream is a policeman or a treacherous thief. Whoever sees himself kill one will triumph over a thief or an enemy. Whoever drags it to land will defeat his opponent.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The crocodile indicates an unjust merchant. There is no good in seeing it, whether on land or in the sea. Eating its meat indicates gaining wealth from an enemy.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The crocodile is interpreted as a strong enemy. Whoever sees himself fleeing from it will be saved from its evil.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The crab in a dream is a man of bad character, difficult to deal with. Whoever befriends one befriends a man with these traits. Eating it is unlawful money.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The crab indicates a gossiping man who strives for corruption. Its bite indicates harm from an enemy.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The crab is interpreted as a hateful man. Whoever sees himself eating it will gain wealth from a bad man.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The snail in a dream indicates travel and moving from one place to another. Whoever sees himself eating it will gain wealth from travel.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The snail indicates a stingy man. It may also indicate a house or a servant.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The snail is interpreted as a man who strives for people's interests. Seeing it indicates goodness and benefit.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The butterfly in a dream is a weak enemy with no strength. It indicates ignorance and vanity. Whoever sees himself chasing a butterfly is following a corrupt woman.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The butterfly indicates a man who backbites people. It may also indicate good news.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The butterfly is interpreted as an adorned woman. Whoever sees a butterfly fluttering around him, a woman is deceiving him.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The Ya'sub (Queen Bee/Dragonfly context dependent) in a dream is the master and king of the bees. It indicates a noble, generous man.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The Ya'sub indicates a knowledgeable scholar or a just ruler. Whoever owns one will gain authority.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The Ya'sub is interpreted as a rich man. Whoever sees himself eating it will gain wealth from a rich man.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The wing in a dream is a son, wealth, or authority. Whoever sees that he has two wings and flies with them will gain authority and travel. Plucking the wing indicates the loss of wealth or dismissal from a position.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The wing indicates adornment and strength. Whoever sees himself flying with two wings will be blessed with two sons.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The wing is interpreted as wealth and a son. The strength of the wing is the son's strength, and its weakness is his weakness.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Eggs in a dream indicate women. Many eggs indicate wealth that one fears will be corrupted. Eating raw eggs is unlawful money, worry, or adultery. Boiled eggs are blessed sustenance and the righteousness of an affair.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Eggs indicate children, spouses, and gathering with family. Whoever sees a hen lay an egg will be blessed with a son. Breaking an egg indicates deflowering a virgin.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Eggs are interpreted as gold and silver. Chicken eggs are blessed sustenance. Whoever sees that he owns many eggs owns abundant wealth and fears its loss.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Crying over a dead person, if without screaming or wailing, is relief and removal of worry. If it is with screaming, it is a calamity. Whoever sees a dead person crying is in torment.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Crying over the dead indicates longing for them. It may also indicate the dreamer's regret for his shortcomings towards them.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Whoever sees himself crying over a known dead person will be afflicted with worry and sadness.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The laughter of a dead person in a dream indicates their good state in the Hereafter and that they are blessed.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Whoever sees a dead person laughing, goodness will reach him from them, such as prayers or charity.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The laughter of the dead is glad tidings for the dreamer of the righteousness of his state and his good end.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The speech of the dead in a dream is truth and honesty, because they are in the abode of truth. So whatever they say is correct. Whoever sees himself talking to a dead person will have a long life.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Whoever sees a dead person talking to him, there will be reconciliation between him and people after a dispute.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The speech of the dead indicates an admonition for the dreamer. If they command him to do something, he should do it if it is good.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Eating with a dead person indicates a long life. If the deceased was righteous, it indicates companionship with the righteous. If he was corrupt, it indicates companionship with the corrupt.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Whoever sees himself eating with a dead person will travel far or live among foreign people.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Eating with the dead indicates sustenance coming from an unexpected source.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Receiving something from the dead in a dream is goodness and sustenance. Whoever sees a dead person give him something of worldly possessions will receive good from an unexpected source. The best gifts are those loved in wakefulness.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Receiving from the dead indicates benefit and sustenance. If they give food, it is lawful sustenance.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Whoever sees a dead person give him a new garment will gain wealth and joy. If it is worn out, he will become poor and sad.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The dead taking something from the living is disliked and indicates deficiency. Whoever sees a dead person take something from him will lose it. If the dead takes the dreamer and goes with him, it indicates his death.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The dead taking something indicates worry and loss. If they take a garment, it indicates illness.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Whoever sees a dead person take his hand will gain wealth from a hopeless source.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The sleep of the dead in a dream indicates their comfort in the Hereafter.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Whoever sees a dead person sleeping is heedless of praying for them and giving charity on their behalf.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The sleep of the dead indicates their good state and safety from torment.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The sickness of the dead in a dream indicates that they are responsible for their religion (debts/obligations). A headache indicates their shortcoming towards their parents, and hand pain indicates their shortcoming towards their siblings.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Whoever sees a dead person sick needs prayers and charity.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The sickness of the dead indicates a sin from which they did not repent.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The enemy in a dream may be a friend in reality, and a friend may be an enemy. Shaking hands with the enemy indicates reconciliation and the end of enmity. Victory over him indicates salvation from worry.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Victory over the enemy in a dream is victory in wakefulness. Fleeing from him is safety and security. Whoever sees himself following his enemy will overpower him.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The enemy is interpreted as a hypocritical friend. Reconciling with him is good and beneficial. Whoever sees his enemy happy will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Seeing a friend in a dream indicates joy, delight, and help. Whoever sees his friend in good appearance, it indicates the good state of the dreamer.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The friend indicates the mirror in which a person sees himself. Whatever good or bad he sees in him reflects on himself.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Seeing a friend is interpreted as goodness and benefit. Disputing with him indicates separation or misunderstanding.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The neighbor in a dream indicates a person's luck. A good neighbor is good luck, and a bad neighbor is bad luck. The neighbor's house indicates a woman.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The neighbor indicates a partner or a relative. Whoever sees himself harming his neighbor is committing a sin.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The neighbor is interpreted as the wife. Whoever sees himself moving next to righteous people will marry a righteous woman.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A guest in a dream indicates a baby boy. Honoring him indicates a good reputation and sustenance. Whoever sees unknown guests, they are thieves.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A guest indicates good news. It may also indicate the arrival of an absent person. Many guests indicate abundant sustenance.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A guest is interpreted as glad tidings and joy. Whoever sees himself hosting righteous people will receive blessing and goodness.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Seeing an orphan in a dream indicates oppression and humiliation. Whoever sees himself being kind to an orphan is being merciful to the weak and will receive a reward.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Whoever sees himself as an orphan will lose his honor and strength. Consuming an orphan's property indicates consuming the unlawful.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The orphan is interpreted as a weak man. Whoever sees himself sponsoring an orphan will receive goodness and sustenance.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Poverty in a dream is wealth in wakefulness. Whoever sees himself poor will become rich. A poor person in a dream is a man who complains a lot.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Poverty indicates righteousness in religion. Whoever sees himself sitting with the poor is sitting with the righteous.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Poverty is interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees himself giving to a poor person, his worry will disappear.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Wealth in a dream indicates poverty in wakefulness. Whoever sees himself rich is content with little. A rich person in a dream is a man independent of people through God.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Wealth indicates tyranny and ingratitude for blessings. It may also indicate contentment and satisfaction. Whoever sees a rich person sees a man keen on the world.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Wealth is interpreted as poverty. Whoever sees himself become rich will become poor.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Thirst in a dream is corruption in religion and need for the world. Whoever sees himself thirsty needs wealth or knowledge. Quenching thirst indicates relief after hardship and wealth after poverty.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Thirst indicates longing for a loved one. It may also indicate poverty and illness. Quenching it indicates fulfilling a need.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Thirst is interpreted as worry and grief. Whoever sees himself drinking water and quenching his thirst, his worry will disappear.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Hunger in a dream indicates loss of wealth and eagerness for the world. It is better than fullness. Hunger in a town indicates high prices.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Hunger indicates fear and poverty. Whoever sees himself hungry is striving to seek sustenance and will attain it.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Hunger is interpreted as worry and grief. Satiety after it indicates relief.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Satiety in a dream indicates boredom and weariness of the world. It is disliked and indicates the approach of death.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Satiety indicates an increase in wealth with fatigue. It may also indicate laziness in obedience.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Satiety is interpreted as worry and grief. Whoever sees himself full is weary of his wife or his work.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Eating in a dream is sustenance and livelihood. Whoever sees himself eating good food in its season will receive blessed sustenance. Sour food is illness and worry. Eating with the right hand is following the Sunnah, and with the left is obeying the enemy.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: If the food eaten in the dream is disliked in wakefulness, it indicates something disliked. Whoever sees himself eating with righteous people will receive blessing and goodness. With corrupt people, it is evil and misfortune.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Eating is interpreted as sustenance and benefit, especially if it tastes good. Eating at a feast indicates glad tidings and joy.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Drinking clear, fresh water in a dream indicates a long life, a pure livelihood, and healing from illnesses. Drinking murky water indicates illness and worry. Drinking hot water indicates torment and hardship.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Drinking indicates guidance and knowledge. Whoever sees himself drinking from a cup will gain wealth from a woman. Drinking from a river indicates gaining wealth from a ruler.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Drinking is interpreted as sustenance and benefit. Drinking sea water indicates gaining wealth from a king.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Swallowing things in a dream indicates greed and avarice. Swallowing pearls indicates concealing knowledge. Swallowing a dinar (gold coin) indicates concealing true testimony.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Whoever sees himself swallow something is keeping a secret. Swallowing what is not edible indicates worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Swallowing is interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees himself swallow something good will gain lawful wealth.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Vomiting in a dream indicates repentance and returning trusts. Whoever vomits easily has repented willingly. Whoever vomits with difficulty has repented under duress. Vomiting blood indicates repentance from unlawful money.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Vomiting indicates revealing secrets. Whoever sees himself vomit is returning a deposit to its owner. For the sick, vomiting is healing.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Vomiting is interpreted as repentance and salvation from worry. Whoever sees himself vomit food is giving a gift.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Spitting in a dream is speech. If it is good, it is good speech. If it is ugly, it is ugly speech. Spitting on a wall indicates spending money.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Spitting indicates strength. Whoever spits on a man overpowers him with his words. Spitting blood indicates unlawful money.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Spitting is interpreted as speech. Spitting on the ground indicates buying property.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Sneezing in a dream indicates the appearance of a hidden matter. For the sick, it is healing. Whoever sneezes and people praise him (say 'Yarhamuk Allah') will receive goodness.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Sneezing indicates guidance from God and an awakening from heedlessness. It may also indicate the death of the sick.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Sneezing is interpreted as relief. Whoever sees himself sneeze, his affairs will be facilitated.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Yawning in a dream indicates illness or an action for which Satan blames him. It indicates laziness and unemployment.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Yawning indicates worry and grief. Whoever sees himself yawn will fall into hardship.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Yawning is interpreted as illness. Whoever sees himself covering his mouth when yawning is following the Sunnah.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Sleeping in a dream is heedlessness and unemployment. Sleeping on the back indicates control over the world. Sleeping on the stomach indicates loss of wealth. Sleeping in a graveyard indicates death.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Sleeping indicates rest from fatigue. For the fearful, it is security. Sleeping in the mosque indicates trust in God.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Sleeping is interpreted as heedlessness. Whoever sees himself sleeping is neglecting an important matter.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Drowsiness in a dream is security from fear. It indicates righteousness in religion and worldly life.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Drowsiness indicates guidance after misguidance. For the sick, it is healing.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Drowsiness is interpreted as security. Whoever sees himself drowsy is safe from what he fears.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Madness in a dream is unlawful money that the dreamer acquires. It may also indicate wealth. A boy's madness is wealth for his father. A woman's madness is a fertile year.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Madness indicates honor and high status. Whoever sees himself mad will gain authority.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Madness is interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees himself having a fit of madness will find a treasure.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Epilepsy in a dream indicates worry, grief, and strife. Whoever sees himself having a seizure will fall into hardship.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Epilepsy indicates gaining authority and wealth. Whoever sees himself having a seizure, his status will rise.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Epilepsy is interpreted as wealth and position. Whoever sees himself having a seizure will find a treasure.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Leprosy in a dream is wealth without effort. It indicates new clothing.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Leprosy indicates an inheritance. Whoever sees himself leprous will gain wealth from an inheritance.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Leprosy is interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees his flesh falling off from it is spending his money.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Vitiligo in a dream is wealth and clothing. Whoever sees himself with vitiligo will gain wealth and good praise.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Vitiligo indicates a man who backbites people. It may also indicate an inheritance.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Vitiligo is interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees himself with vitiligo will gain wealth from an unexpected source.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Scabies in a dream is wealth obtained through fatigue and toil. Whoever sees himself with scabies will gain wealth from his relatives.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Scabies indicates worry and grief from relatives.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Scabies is interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees himself scratching his scabies is striving to seek wealth.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Itching in a dream indicates investigating the affairs of relatives. Whoever sees himself scratching his body will gain wealth from his relatives.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Itching indicates poverty and need. It may also indicate compassion for relatives.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Itching is interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees himself scratching his head is asking about the state of his superior.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Sores in a dream are wealth proportional to their size. If pus comes out, it is unlawful money. If blood comes out, it is lawful money.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Sores indicate debt or worry. Their healing indicates payment of debt and removal of worry.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Sores are interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees sores on his body will gain wealth.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A wound in a dream indicates wealth and benefit. If it is on the right hand, it is wealth from a man. If on the left, it is wealth from a woman. A fresh wound indicates true speech.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A wound indicates debt. Its healing indicates payment of debt. Whoever sees himself wound himself is falling into sin.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A wound is interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees his wound bleeding is spending money.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Breaking limbs in a dream indicates illness, poverty, or calamity. Breaking the hand indicates a brother's illness, and breaking the leg indicates the father's illness.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A fracture indicates hardship and worry. Its mending indicates relief and removal of worry.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A fracture is interpreted as poverty and illness. Whoever sees one of his limbs break will suffer a loss in his wealth.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The private parts in a dream are the secret and the trust. Exposing them indicates revealing a secret and scandal. Whoever sees himself looking at another's private parts is seeking their faults.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The private parts indicate a defect in religion. Exposing them indicates falling into sin. Covering them indicates repentance.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The private parts are interpreted as a secret. Whoever sees his private parts exposed, his secret will be revealed.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Circumcision in a dream indicates following the Sunnah and purification from sins. For a polytheist, it is conversion to Islam, and for a sinner, repentance.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Circumcision indicates righteousness in religion and worldly life. Whoever sees himself circumcise himself is purifying himself from a sin.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Circumcision is interpreted as joy and happiness. Whoever sees himself circumcise a boy is striving for his righteousness.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Ablution in a dream is a trust fulfilled, a debt paid, or a testimony given. It is light and purification from sins. Whoever sees himself performing ablution with impure water is in worry and grief. Completing the ablution indicates achieving one's goal.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Ablution indicates relief from worries. For the sick, it is healing, and for the sinner, repentance. Ablution with hot water indicates illness or worry.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Ablution is interpreted as security and relief. Whoever sees himself performing ablution has emerged from worry. If he does not complete his ablution, his affair will not be completed.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Washing (full body) in a dream indicates repentance, purification, and removal of worry. Washing with cold water indicates healing and wellness. Washing with hot water indicates illness and worry.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Washing indicates payment of debt and relief from distress. For the unmarried, it is marriage, and for the poor, wealth.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Washing is interpreted as goodness and blessing. Whoever sees himself washing in his clothes indicates his righteousness and chastity.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Dry ablution in a dream indicates travel or illness. It is imminent relief. Whoever sees himself performing dry ablution will be saved from hardship.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Dry ablution indicates fulfilling a need when it is difficult. For the sick, it is evidence of approaching death.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Dry ablution is interpreted as relief. Whoever sees himself performing dry ablution will embark on a blessed journey.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The prayer rug in a dream is a man's world. Its spaciousness is the spaciousness of his world. Its beauty is the beauty of his world. Prostrating on it indicates following the Sunnah.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The prayer rug indicates a righteous woman. Sitting on it indicates control over the world. A new prayer rug is a new world approaching.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The prayer rug is interpreted as a woman or a position. Whoever sees himself folding his prayer rug is separating from his wife or his position.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Prayer beads in a dream indicate a righteous woman, a righteous son, or lawful money. Praising God with them indicates obedience and worship.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Prayer beads indicate a good life and lawful sustenance. Their breaking indicates the scattering of one's affairs.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Prayer beads are interpreted as a trustworthy servant or a righteous woman. Whoever sees prayer beads in his hand will receive goodness and sustenance.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The Qibla in a dream indicates what a person turns to, such as a leader, a wife, or travel. Praying towards it indicates uprightness in religion. Turning away from it indicates misguidance.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The Qibla indicates obedience to God and following the Sunnah. Whoever sees himself searching for the Qibla is confused about his religion.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The Qibla is interpreted as the wife or a position. Whoever sees himself praying towards other than it is committing a great mistake.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Fasting in a dream indicates a vow, repentance, health, and a baby boy. Whoever sees himself fasting will gain high status and honor. Breaking the fast indicates illness or travel.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Fasting indicates payment of debt and removal of worry. Whoever sees himself breaking the fast intentionally is backbiting people or committing a sin.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Fasting is interpreted as health and wellness. Whoever sees himself fasting perpetually is avoiding sins.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Breaking the fast in a dream indicates illness, travel, or joy and happiness. Breaking the fast before its time indicates backbiting and gossip.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Breaking the fast indicates recovery from illness. It may also indicate committing a sin.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Breaking the fast is interpreted as relief. Whoever sees himself break his fast, his worry will disappear.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Zakat in a dream indicates an increase in wealth, blessing, and salvation from hardships. Whoever sees himself paying Zakat will gain wealth and high status.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Zakat indicates payment of debt and healing from illness. It indicates righteousness in religion and worldly life.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Zakat is interpreted as lawful money. Whoever sees himself withholding it will be afflicted with poverty and worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Charity in a dream indicates healing from illnesses and salvation from affliction. Charity in secret is better than in public.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Charity indicates sincerity in work. For a merchant, it is profit, and for the sick, healing.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Charity is interpreted as relief and removal of worry. Whoever sees himself giving charity will receive goodness and sustenance.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Supplication in a dream indicates the fulfillment of needs and achieving goals. If it is with screaming, it is calamity and strife. Supplicating in darkness indicates salvation from worry.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Supplication indicates worship. It may also indicate a baby boy. Whoever sees himself supplicating for himself will be blessed with a son.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Supplication is interpreted as worship. Whoever sees himself supplicating to God will have his prayer answered.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Praising God (saying SubhanAllah) in a dream indicates salvation from hardships and removal of worry. For the prisoner, it is relief, and for the sick, healing.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Praising God indicates obedience to God. Whoever sees himself praising God will gain authority and high status.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Praising God is interpreted as relief and blessing. Whoever sees himself praising God will be blessed with a righteous son.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Declaring God's oneness (saying La ilaha illa Allah) in a dream indicates guidance, martyrdom, and a good end.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Declaring God's oneness indicates relief and salvation from worry. Whoever sees himself declaring God's oneness will die upon monotheism (Tawhid).

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Declaring God's oneness is interpreted as goodness and blessing. Whoever sees himself declaring God's oneness will attain what he wishes for.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Declaring God's greatness (saying Allahu Akbar) in a dream indicates victory over enemies, joy, and relief.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Declaring God's greatness indicates repentance and salvation from hardships. In its proper place, it indicates holidays and celebrations.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Declaring God's greatness is interpreted as triumph and victory. Whoever sees himself declaring God's greatness, his status will rise.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Seeking forgiveness in a dream indicates sustenance, a child, and salvation from worry. Whoever sees himself seeking forgiveness, God will expand his sustenance.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Seeking forgiveness indicates long life and righteousness of state. For the sinner, it is repentance.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Seeking forgiveness is interpreted as wealth and a child. Whoever sees himself seeking forgiveness, God will forgive him.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Sending blessings on the Prophet (PBUH) in a dream indicates following his Sunnah, victory over enemies, and fulfillment of needs.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Whoever sees himself sending blessings on the Prophet will gain honor, nobility, and see him (the Prophet) in a dream.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Sending blessings on the Prophet is interpreted as goodness, blessing, and salvation from hardships.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Jihad in a dream indicates striving to seek sustenance for one's family. Returning from it indicates wealth and profit in trade.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Jihad indicates high ambition and elevation in this world and the Hereafter. Whoever dies in Jihad will attain martyrdom.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Jihad is interpreted as goodness and blessing. Whoever sees himself striving (Jihad) will gain spoils and high status.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Whoever sees that he died a martyr will attain joy, happiness, glad tidings, and a good life.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Martyrdom indicates profit in trade and marriage to the Houris (maidens of Paradise).

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Martyrdom is interpreted as elevation and high status in this world and the Hereafter.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Disbelief in a dream indicates poverty. Whoever sees himself disbelieve after having faith will become poor. It may also indicate misguidance and distance from the truth.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Disbelief indicates tyranny and arrogance. Whoever sees himself disbelieving is committing a great sin.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Disbelief is interpreted as misguidance. Whoever sees himself calling people to disbelief is calling them to heresy.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Apostasy from Islam in a dream indicates dismissal from a position, death of a son, or corruption in religion.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Apostasy indicates loss in trade and poverty after wealth.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Apostasy is interpreted as worry and grief. Whoever sees himself apostatize will be afflicted with great worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Sin in a dream indicates debt. Whoever sees himself committing a sin will fall into debt. Repentance from it is payment of the debt.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Sin indicates worry and grief. Confessing it indicates repentance and high status.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Sin is interpreted as loss. Whoever sees himself committing a sin will lose in his trade.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Repentance in a dream indicates salvation from hardships, payment of debt, and relief.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Repentance indicates authority and high status. Whoever sees himself repent will gain kingship.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Repentance is interpreted as goodness and blessing. Whoever sees himself repenting, his affair will become righteous.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Theft in a dream indicates adultery, usury (Riba), and lying. The thief is a cunning, deceitful man. Whoever sees himself stealing is falling into sin.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Theft indicates worry and grief. Whoever has something stolen from him will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Theft is interpreted as betrayal. The thief is a treacherous man.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Killing in a dream is a great sin. Whoever sees himself kill a person is committing a sin. Whoever sees himself killed will have a long life and receive goodness.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Killing indicates salvation from worry. Whoever sees himself killed unjustly will gain high status and victory.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Killing is interpreted as goodness and benefit for the victim. Whoever sees himself kill himself has repented sincerely.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Adultery in a dream is betrayal and theft. Whoever sees himself commit adultery is stealing or betraying a trust.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Adultery indicates seeking the unlawful. Whoever sees himself commit adultery with a known woman will receive unlawful good from her.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Adultery is interpreted as loss. Whoever sees himself commit adultery will lose in his trade.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Whoever sees himself marry a dead woman and consummates the marriage will attain a hopeless matter. If he does not consummate it, he is striving for a dead matter that will not be completed. A woman marrying a dead man indicates the scattering of her family and her impoverishment.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The marriage of the dead in a dream indicates comfort and joy for their family. Whoever sees that a dead person got married, it indicates their good state with Allah Almighty.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Whoever sees himself marry a dead woman will triumph in a matter he had despaired of. If the woman is unknown, he will die.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Divorce in a dream indicates poverty. Whoever divorces his wife once is leaving his job or being dismissed from his position. A triple divorce indicates he will never return to his job.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Divorce indicates separation from a king or ruler. For the unmarried, it is separation from their current state. Whoever divorces his sick wife, she will die.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Divorce is interpreted as worry and grief. Whoever sees himself divorce his wife will become rich.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Pregnancy in a dream for a woman is an increase in her wealth. For a man, it is worry, grief, and sadness. A woman's pregnancy indicates that she persists in her affair and gains wealth and high status from it.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Pregnancy indicates blessing and wealth. For a man, it is a hidden worry. An old woman's pregnancy indicates strife. A virgin's pregnancy indicates trouble reaching her family because of her.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Pregnancy is interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees his wife is pregnant hopes for good from his world.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Childbirth in a dream indicates relief from hardships and worries, payment of debt, and repentance. Giving birth to a female is relief and joy. Giving birth to a male is worry and grief followed by relief.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Childbirth indicates rest from fatigue. For the sick, it is healing; for the prisoner, release; and for the indebted, payment of debt. Whoever sees himself give birth will be saved from hardship.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Childbirth is interpreted as relief and comfort. Whoever sees his mother give birth to him, if he is sick, he will die, and if he is poor, he will become rich.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Breastfeeding in a dream indicates prison and illness. Whoever sees himself breastfeeding from a woman will be afflicted with distress and illness. A man breastfeeding from his own breast indicates betrayal of trust.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Breastfeeding indicates a change of situation. For a child, it is good, and for an adult, it is worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Breastfeeding is interpreted as imprisonment. Whoever sees himself breastfeeding will be imprisoned or fall ill.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The beard in a dream for a man is wealth, honor, and prestige. Its length indicates high status and wealth. Whoever sees his beard grow long enough to reach his navel is committing a sin.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The beard indicates adornment and dignity. Plucking it indicates loss of wealth. Shaving it indicates loss of prestige and position.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The beard is interpreted as wealth and prestige. Whoever sees his beard is white has gained dignity and reverence.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The mustache in a dream indicates wealth. Its length indicates drinking intoxicants or falling into debt. Trimming it indicates following the Sunnah and removal of worry.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The mustache indicates a servant or a chamberlain. Whoever sees his mustache is long will fall into worry.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The mustache is interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees himself trimming it is spending his money in obedience.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The eyebrows in a dream are religion, dignity, and adornment. Their beauty indicates righteousness in religion. Their falling indicates a deficiency in religion or prestige.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The eyebrows indicate children or partners. Their meeting indicates familiarity and love.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The eyebrows are interpreted as parents. The right eyebrow is the father, and the left is the mother.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Eyelashes in a dream indicate the covering of religion and protection from strife. Their length indicates strength in religion. Their falling indicates a deficiency in religion.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Eyelashes indicate children. Their beauty indicates the righteousness of the children.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Eyelashes are interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees that his eyelashes are thick, his wealth will increase.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The cheek in a dream is the place of a man's adornment and his humility. Its beauty indicates a good state and joy. A scratch on it indicates humiliation and worry.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The cheek indicates reputation and praise. A white cheek indicates a good reputation, and a black one indicates a bad reputation.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The cheek is interpreted as a child. The right cheek is the male child, and the left is the female.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The chin in a dream indicates what a person adorns himself with, such as wealth or prestige. Its beauty indicates a good state. An injury to it indicates a loss in wealth.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The chin indicates the leader of the people. Whatever happens to it reflects on him.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The chin is interpreted as a rich man. Whoever sees that his chin is large will gain wealth and prestige.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The neck in a dream is the place of trust and religion. Its strength indicates trustworthiness. Striking it indicates paying off debt or relief from worry.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The neck indicates authority. Whoever sees himself strike a man's neck will gain authority over him.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The neck is interpreted as debt. Whoever sees a rope around his neck has a debt upon him.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The shoulder in a dream indicates a brother or a friend. Its strength is the brother's strength, and its weakness is his weakness. Its dislocation indicates separation from the brother.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The shoulder indicates the wife or the partner. Whatever happens to it reflects on them.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The shoulder is interpreted as a child. The right shoulder is the son, and the left is the daughter.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The arm in a dream is the brother or friend relied upon. Its strength is the brother's strength, and its cutting off is his separation.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The arm indicates striving and work. Whoever sees his arm is long is generous.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The arm is interpreted as a partner in work. Whoever sees his arm break will separate from his partner.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The palm in a dream indicates sufficiency and sustenance. An open palm indicates generosity, and a closed one indicates stinginess. A severed palm indicates abandoning prayer.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The palm indicates work. Whoever sees his palm become large, his sustenance will increase.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The palm is interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees something in his palm will gain wealth.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The fingers of the hands in a dream indicate children or the five daily prayers. Their increase is an increase in goodness. Their decrease is a decrease in it. Interlacing them indicates the gathering of family.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Fingers indicate servants and helpers. Their cutting off indicates the loss of a helper.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Fingers are interpreted as relatives. The thumb indicates the father, and the index finger indicates the mother.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Nails in a dream are a man's weapon, his strength, and his victory over his enemies. Their length indicates strength and abundance in sustenance. Trimming them indicates following the Sunnah.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Nails indicate wealth. Whoever sees his nails fall off, his wealth is gone.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Nails are interpreted as benefit. Their length indicates an increase in wealth.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The chest in a dream is the repository of knowledge and secrets. Its breadth indicates forbearance and knowledge. Its narrowness indicates ignorance and stinginess.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The chest indicates religion and Islam. Its soundness is the soundness of religion, and its illness is illness in religion.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The chest is interpreted as prestige and status. Whoever sees his chest is broad will gain high status.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A woman's breast in a dream indicates her daughter. Milk in it is sustenance and blessing. For a man, the breast indicates worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The breast indicates the wife or mother. Whoever sees that he has many breasts will be blessed with many children.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The breast is interpreted as wealth. Its largeness indicates abundance of wealth, and its smallness indicates its scarcity.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The belly in a dream is the place of a man's secret, his wealth, and his family. Its largeness indicates abundance of wealth and children. Pain in it indicates worry from family.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The belly indicates the grave or prison. Whoever sees his belly split open, his secret will be revealed.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The belly is interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees something in his belly is hiding wealth.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The back in a dream is a man's support and help from a brother, son, or friend. Its strength is the support's strength, and its breaking is the death of whomever it represents.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The back indicates religion. Whoever sees himself carrying a heavy load on his back is carrying many sins.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The back is interpreted as prestige and position. Whoever sees his back hunched, his prestige is gone.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The navel in a dream indicates the mother or the wife. Pain in it indicates worry from them.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The navel indicates stored wealth. Whoever sees something coming out of it is spending from his wealth.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The navel is interpreted as a trustworthy servant. Whatever happens to it reflects on him.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The thigh in a dream is a man's clan and his close relatives. Its strength is the clan's strength. Its severing indicates the scattering of the family.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The thigh indicates the wife. The right thigh is relatives from the father's side, and the left is from the mother's side.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The thigh is interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees his thigh is strong, his wealth will increase.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The leg (shin) in a dream is a man's lifespan and his livelihood. Its strength is the strength of his livelihood. Its breaking indicates the approach of death or difficulty in matters.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The leg indicates family and clan. Whoever sees that he has many legs, his life will be long and his wealth will increase.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The leg is interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees his leg is made of iron, his life will be long and his wealth will increase.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The knee in a dream is a man's toil and striving in his work. Pain in it indicates fatigue in seeking sustenance.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The knee indicates a partner in work. Whatever happens to it reflects on him.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The knee is interpreted as wealth. Its strength is the strength of wealth, and its weakness is its weakness.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The heel in a dream is a man's offspring in his wealth and son. Pain in it indicates worry from the son.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The heel indicates steadfastness in religion. Whoever sees his heel is strong is steadfast in his religion.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The heel is interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees his heel break, his wealth is gone.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A boil in a dream is wealth proportional to its size. If it bursts and pus comes out, the wealth is gone. If blood comes out, it is unlawful money.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A boil indicates worry and grief. The exit of its contents indicates the removal of worry.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A boil is interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees many boils on his body will gain abundant wealth.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Pimples in a dream are wealth. If they are on the face, they are debts. The exit of their contents is payment of the debt.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Pimples indicate worries. Whoever sees pimples on his body will be afflicted with worry proportional to them.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Pimples are interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees them appear on his hand will gain wealth.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A wart in a dream is wealth that does not last. Whoever sees a wart on his hand will gain wealth that disappears quickly.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A wart indicates worry. Cutting it off indicates the removal of worry.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A wart is interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees himself cut it off is spending his money.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Swelling in a dream is an increase in wealth after fear. Whoever sees swelling on his body will gain wealth and prestige.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Swelling indicates worry and grief. Its disappearance indicates the removal of worry.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Swelling is interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees his body swell, his wealth will increase.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A nosebleed in a dream indicates unlawful money. If the blood is thin, it is money from a ruler. If it is thick, it is a miscarriage.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A nosebleed indicates health of the body. It may also indicate worry from a superior.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A nosebleed is interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees himself having a nosebleed will gain wealth proportional to the blood.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A cough in a dream is a complaint. Whoever sees himself coughing is complaining about his superior or about something that pains him.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A cough indicates worry and grief. It may also indicate illness.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A cough is interpreted as a complaint. Whoever sees himself coughing up blood is complaining about unlawful money.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A cold in a dream indicates a minor illness or news coming from afar.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A cold indicates a small worry that disappears quickly.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A cold is interpreted as news. If the mucus is clear, it is good news. If it is murky, it is bad news.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Fever in a dream indicates payment of debt and long life. It is the messenger of the Angel of Death. Whoever sees himself feverish is delving into sin.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Fever indicates the fulfillment of a promise. For the sick, it is death.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Fever is interpreted as worry and grief. Whoever sees himself feverish will be afflicted with worry.
