interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The plague in a dream is torment from the ruler or war. Whoever dies from it dies a martyr. Whoever sees plague in a town, strife will occur in it.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The plague indicates fear and hardship. Surviving it is salvation from worry.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The plague is interpreted as torment. Whoever sees himself afflicted with it is in hardship.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The shroud in a dream indicates an inclination towards adultery. Whoever sees himself wearing it will die if he is sick. If not, his religion will be corrupted.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The shroud indicates covering (concealment). Whoever sees himself making a shroud is doing a deed by which he covers people's faults.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The shroud is interpreted as worry and grief. Whoever sees himself wrapped in a shroud will be afflicted with great worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The bier in a dream is a noble man. Whoever sees himself carried on a bier will gain authority and high status.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The bier indicates travel or profitable trade. Whoever sees himself on a bier will travel and gain wealth.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The bier is interpreted as a great man. Whoever sees himself break a bier is harming a great man.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The graveyard in a dream indicates the abode of the Hereafter, prison, or the abode of the corrupt. Visiting it indicates visiting prisoners. Walking in it indicates following funerals.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The graveyard indicates admonition and repentance. Whoever sees himself build a house in it will die.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The graveyard is interpreted as worry and grief. Whoever sees himself digging a grave in it will be imprisoned.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Resurrection from graves in a dream indicates salvation from prison or hardship. For the sinner, it is repentance, and for the poor, wealth.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Resurrection indicates the revealing of secrets and the uncovering of hidden matters.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Resurrection is interpreted as relief. Whoever sees the dead coming out of their graves, general relief will occur.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The gathering (on Judgment Day) in a dream indicates the ruler's soldiers or a great strife. Whoever sees himself being gathered will fall into hardship.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The gathering indicates oppression and injustice. Whoever sees himself in the gathering place (Mahshar) will witness oppression.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The gathering is interpreted as worry and grief. Whoever sees himself gathered alone, his worry will be prolonged.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The reckoning (on Judgment Day) in a dream indicates the ruler's torment or the dreamer's heedlessness. Whoever is reckoned with an easy reckoning, God will relieve his worry. Whoever is reckoned with a difficult reckoning will fall into hardship.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The reckoning indicates worry and grief. Whoever sees himself reckoning with himself is repenting from a sin.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The reckoning is interpreted as loss. Whoever sees himself being reckoned will lose in his trade.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The Path (Sirat bridge over Hell) in a dream indicates the path of truth and Islam. Walking on it indicates uprightness in religion. Stumbling on it indicates misguidance.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The Path indicates fear and hardship. Crossing it indicates salvation from worry.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The Path is interpreted as travel. Whoever sees himself cross it easily, his journey will be easy.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Paradise in a dream is the abode of peace and security. Entering it indicates glad tidings, joy, and lawful sustenance. Whoever sees himself eat from its fruits will gain useful knowledge.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Paradise indicates joy and happiness. For the sick, it is healing, and for the worried, relief. Whoever sees himself enter it, his end will be good.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Paradise is interpreted as goodness and blessing. Whoever sees himself in Paradise will attain what he wishes for.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Hellfire in a dream indicates strife, evil, and an unjust ruler. Entering it indicates committing major sins. Exiting it is repentance and salvation.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Hellfire indicates poverty and worry. Whoever sees himself eat from it is consuming unlawful money.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Hellfire is interpreted as torment. Whoever sees himself being tormented in it will be afflicted with great worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The king in a dream is God Almighty. Seeing the king with a pleasant face indicates God's pleasure. His anger indicates God's anger. Whoever sees himself become a king will gain honor and nobility.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The king indicates position and high status. Whoever sees himself talking to the king, his need will be fulfilled.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The king is interpreted as prestige and authority. Speaking with the king is fulfillment of a need. His death indicates the weakness of the state.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The vizier in a dream indicates a man upon whom the king relies. Seeing him indicates the fulfillment of needs. His dismissal indicates difficulty in matters.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The vizier indicates a partner or a friend. Whoever sees himself become a vizier will gain high status and a position.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The vizier is interpreted as a wise man. Whoever sees himself sitting with him is sitting with wise men.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The judge in a dream is God Almighty or a jurist scholar. Whoever sees himself appointed as a judge will gain a high position and wisdom. His ruling with justice indicates his uprightness.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The judge indicates dispute and justice. A ruling in his favor is relief, and a ruling against him is worry.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The judge is interpreted as a wise man. Disputing before him indicates seeking fairness.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The policeman in a dream is the Angel of Death or worry and grief. Whoever sees a policeman following him is in worry and fear.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The policeman indicates an unjust man. Fleeing from him is salvation from evil.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The policeman is interpreted as an enemy. Whoever sees himself fighting him is fighting an enemy.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The executioner in a dream is a man of foul language. Seeing him indicates dispute and evil.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The executioner indicates a man who backbites people. Whoever sees himself as an executioner will fall victim to people's tongues.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The executioner is interpreted as a bad man. Whoever sees him strike him will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The shop in a dream is a man's world, his wife, and his servant. Its beauty and spaciousness indicate the spaciousness of his world and the righteousness of his wife. Its ruin indicates his death or the divorce of his wife.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The shop indicates a son or an animal. Whoever sees himself sitting in his shop, his affairs are stable. Whoever sees himself closing it, his livelihood is disrupted.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The shop is interpreted as a woman. Whatever good or bad is seen in it reflects on her. A new shop is a new wife.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The gutter in a dream is a man who spends another's money or a servant who conveys speech. Water flowing from it indicates the removal of worry and relief.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The gutter indicates a gossiping man. Whoever sees water flowing from it will hear good words.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The gutter is interpreted as a servant. If it is new, he is a trustworthy servant. If it is old, he is treacherous.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Sweeping the house in a dream indicates loss of wealth. If the place is unknown, it indicates death. Sweeping the mosque indicates righteousness in religion.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Sweeping indicates the removal of worry. Sweeping another's house indicates gaining wealth from him.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Sweeping is interpreted as poverty. Whoever sees himself sweep his house will become poor.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Washing clothes in a dream indicates repentance, payment of debt, and removal of worry. Washing the face indicates modesty and righteousness of affair. Washing the dead indicates praying for them.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Washing indicates relief and salvation. Washing a utensil indicates the righteousness of the servant.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Washing is interpreted as goodness and blessing. Whoever sees himself washing something, his affair will become righteous.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Hanging laundry in a dream indicates revealing secrets. If the laundry is clean, it is the revealing of good matters. If it is dirty, it is the revealing of bad matters.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Hanging laundry indicates the return of an absent person or travel. It may also indicate the removal of worry.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Hanging laundry is interpreted as good praise. Whoever sees himself hang laundry, his reputation for good will spread.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Cauterizing with fire in a dream indicates bad speech or unlawful money. If the cauterizing is for illness, it is righteousness in religion. Cauterizing on the forehead indicates withholding Zakat.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Cauterizing indicates strife. Whoever sees himself cauterize a person is tempting him in his religion.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Cauterizing is interpreted as worry and grief. Whoever sees himself cauterize himself will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Cupping in a dream indicates removal of worry, payment of debt, and healing from illness. It may also indicate fulfilling a trust or the dismissal of a governor.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Cupping indicates partnership or writing. Whoever sees himself being cupped will be saved from hardship.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Cupping is interpreted as goodness and benefit. For the sick, it is healing, and for the indebted, payment of debt.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Bloodletting a vein in a dream indicates loss of wealth or illness. If blood comes out, it is righteousness in religion. If pus comes out, it is worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Bloodletting indicates healing from illness. It may also indicate travel.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Bloodletting is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself being bled, his worry will disappear.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Medicine in a dream indicates righteousness in religion and knowledge. Drinking beneficial medicine indicates healing and guidance. Drinking unpleasant medicine indicates illness.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Medicine indicates repentance and returning to God. Whoever sees himself drink medicine is learning useful knowledge.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Medicine is interpreted as goodness and benefit. Whoever sees himself treating a sick person is advising an ignorant person.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Poison in a dream is unlawful money or worry and grief. Drinking it indicates falling into strife or illness. Whoever sees himself give poison to another is plotting against him.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Poison indicates long life. It may also indicate wealth. Whoever drinks it and is not harmed will gain wealth and benefit.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Poison is interpreted as unlawful money. Whoever sees himself eat it is consuming unlawful money.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Shackles in a dream are steadfastness in religion. Whoever sees himself shackled is steadfast in his religion. Shackles of silver indicate marriage, and of gold indicate worry.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Shackles indicate worry and grief. They may also indicate travel. Whoever sees himself break shackles has relieved someone's worry.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Shackles are interpreted as debt. Whoever sees himself shackled has a debt upon him.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A yoke (around the neck) in a dream is disbelief and misguidance. Whoever sees a yoke on his neck is stingy and withholds God's right.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A yoke indicates a bad wife. Whoever sees himself yoked will marry a woman of bad character.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A yoke is interpreted as worry and grief. Whoever sees himself yoked will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The staff in a dream is a noble, strong man relied upon. Leaning on it indicates seeking help from a strong man. Striking the ground with it indicates travel.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The staff indicates victory over enemies. Whoever sees a staff in his hand will gain authority.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The staff is interpreted as a noble man. Whoever sees his staff break, the one he relies on will die.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The rod in a dream is a wise man. Whoever sees a rod in his hand will gain wisdom and a baby boy.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The rod indicates command and prohibition. Whoever sees himself strike with it is commanding and prohibiting.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The rod is interpreted as a son. Whoever sees his rod break, his son will die.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The whip in a dream is a gossiping man who divides people. Striking with it indicates admonition.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The whip indicates ugly speech. Whoever sees himself being whipped will hear words that harm him.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The whip is interpreted as a bad man. Whoever sees himself strike with it is harming people with his tongue.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The tambourine in a dream is fame and good reputation. If it is at a wedding, it is joy and happiness. If at a funeral, it is calamity.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The tambourine indicates marriage or the arrival of an absent person. Playing it indicates hearing good news.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The tambourine is interpreted as news. If its sound is good, it is good news. If it is ugly, it is bad news.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The flute in a dream is strife and calamity. Hearing it indicates bad news. Playing it indicates amusement and falsehood.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The flute indicates a man who announces news. If its sound is good, it is good news. If it is ugly, it is bad news.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The flute is interpreted as falsehood. Whoever sees himself play it is speaking false words.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The oud in a dream is false speech and amusement. Playing it indicates falling into worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The oud indicates a wise man. Hearing its sound indicates hearing words of wisdom.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The oud is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself play it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The drum in a dream is false news and false fame. Beating it indicates falling into a matter by which one becomes famous for falsehood.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The drum indicates a man who announces news. For the sick, it is death.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The drum is interpreted as news. Whoever sees himself beat it, his news will spread.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Chess in a dream is dispute, argument, and false speech. Playing it indicates disputing with a foolish man.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Chess indicates travel, war, or planning matters.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Chess is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself play it is disputing.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Backgammon in a dream is false speech and dispute. Playing it indicates falling into sin.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Backgammon indicates an easy matter that is completed quickly. It may also indicate travel.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Backgammon is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself play it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: An image in a dream indicates a hypocritical man or a false friend. Looking at it indicates vanity and falsehood.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: An image indicates children. A man's image indicates a baby boy, and a woman's image indicates a female.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: An image is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself look at his image will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A statue in a dream indicates children, partners, or enemies. Whoever sees himself make a statue is falling into strife.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A statue indicates a useless man. Worshiping it indicates misguidance.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A statue is interpreted as worry and grief. Whoever sees that he owns one will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The cross in a dream indicates a lying man or a false witness. Carrying it indicates authority. Prostrating to it indicates misguidance.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The cross indicates a wife or a son. It may also indicate strife.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The cross is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself carry it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The sailor in a dream is the manager of people's affairs. Seeing him indicates travel or the fulfillment of needs.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The sailor indicates a man who strives for people's interests. Whoever sees himself become a sailor will gain authority.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The sailor is interpreted as a wise man. Whoever sees himself talk to him will gain wisdom.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The ship's anchor in a dream indicates steadfastness in a matter and certainty in religion. It is security from fear.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The anchor indicates a man relied upon. Whoever sees the ship cast its anchors, his affairs will stabilize.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The anchor is interpreted as steadfastness. Whoever sees himself raise it is embarking on a journey.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The ship's sail in a dream is its authority and honor. Its tearing indicates the loss of authority.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The sail indicates high status and prestige. A white sail indicates religion and righteousness.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The sail is interpreted as a noble man. Whoever sees himself ride it will gain high status.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The oar in a dream is the servant or helper. Rowing with it indicates striving to seek sustenance.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The oar indicates salvation from hardships. Whoever sees himself rowing will be saved from worry.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The oar is interpreted as a son. Whoever sees his oar break, his son will die.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The island in a dream indicates a woman to whom people seek refuge. Or it indicates a work to which a person resorts.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The island indicates a ruler or a scholar. Landing on it indicates security and comfort.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The island is interpreted as a rich woman. Whoever sees that he owns it will marry a rich woman.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The seashore in a dream indicates salvation from fear and hardship. Reaching it after swimming indicates relief after distress.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The beach indicates travel or the beginning of a new matter. Walking on it indicates striving to seek sustenance.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The beach is interpreted as relief and security. Whoever sees himself on the beach is safe from what he fears.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Sand in a dream is wealth. Walking on it indicates striving in worldly affairs. Collecting it indicates collecting money. Abundant sand indicates worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Sand indicates healing from illnesses. It may also indicate travel. Red sand indicates a position.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Sand is interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees himself digging in it is plotting to seek wealth.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Waves in a dream are torment, hardship, and strife. Raging waves indicate an unjust ruler. Surviving them is salvation from worry.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Waves indicate men in strife. Whoever sees himself riding the waves will fall into hardship.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Waves are interpreted as worry and grief. Whoever sees the waves cover him will be afflicted with great worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Sea foam in a dream is something useless and false speech.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Foam indicates unlawful money. Whoever sees himself collecting it is collecting money unlawfully.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Foam is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself eat it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A whirlpool in the sea indicates the ruler's prison or great hardship. Falling into it indicates destruction.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A whirlpool indicates strife. Surviving it is salvation from strife.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A whirlpool is interpreted as great worry. Whoever sees himself fall into it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A flood in a dream is torment from God or a conquering enemy. Its entry into houses indicates general strife. Surviving it is salvation from hardship.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A flood indicates the ruler's soldiers or a general illness. If it is of blood, it is war.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A flood is interpreted as torment. Whoever sees himself flee from it is saved from torment.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A torrent in a dream is an enemy. If it is murky, it is an unjust enemy. If it is clear, it is justice from the ruler. Its entry into the village indicates strife.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A torrent indicates travel or war. Whoever sees himself swim in it will be saved from an enemy.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A torrent is interpreted as an enemy. Whoever sees himself prevent it from entering his house is preventing an enemy from harming him.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A pond in a dream is a noble, generous man. Bathing in it indicates the removal of worry.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A pond indicates a rich woman. Drinking from it indicates gaining wealth from a woman.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A pond is interpreted as a rich man. Whoever sees himself swim in it is mingling with the rich.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A pool in a dream is a rich woman. Clear water in it indicates her righteousness, and murky water indicates her corruption.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A pool indicates a treasurer. Whoever sees himself bathe in it will gain wealth.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A pool is interpreted as a woman. Whoever sees himself fall into it will get married.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A fountain in a dream is a generous, giving man. Its water indicates his wealth. Whoever drinks from it will receive good from him.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A fountain indicates joy and happiness. For the sick, it is healing, and for the worried, relief.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A fountain is interpreted as a rich man. Whoever sees that he owns one will gain wealth and high status.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A jar in a dream is a servant or a woman. Its fullness indicates wealth, and its emptiness indicates poverty. Breaking it indicates the death of the servant or the divorce of the wife.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A jar indicates a man's secret. Whoever sees himself drink from it will learn a secret.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A jar is interpreted as a woman. Whoever sees himself buy one will get married.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A pitcher in a dream is a servant. It indicates a gossiping man who spreads talk.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A pitcher indicates a maidservant. Drinking from it indicates marrying a maidservant.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A pitcher is interpreted as a servant. Breaking it indicates the servant's death.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: An ewer in a dream is a trustworthy servant. It may also indicate a righteous son. Performing ablution from it indicates repentance and relief.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: An ewer indicates a knowledgeable or repentant man. Drinking from it indicates gaining knowledge.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: An ewer is interpreted as a son. Breaking it indicates the son's death.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A cup in a dream is a woman. If it is full, she is pregnant. If it breaks, the woman dies. A glass cup indicates revealing secrets.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A cup indicates the caretaker of the house. Whoever sees himself drink from a cup will gain wealth from a woman.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A cup is interpreted as a woman. Whoever sees himself take a cup will get married.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A goblet in a dream is a servant. It indicates a man who does not keep a secret.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A goblet indicates a woman. Drinking from it indicates receiving good from her.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A goblet is interpreted as a servant. Breaking it indicates the servant's death.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A bottle in a dream is a woman or a maidservant. Breaking it indicates separation from her. What is inside it indicates her state.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A bottle indicates a hypocritical man or a gossiping woman. There is no good in seeing it.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A bottle is interpreted as a woman. Whoever sees himself buy one will get married.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A bucket in a dream is a man who extracts money through cunning and deceit. Whoever sees himself lowering his bucket into a well is seeking the world and will attain it through cunning.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A bucket indicates striving to seek sustenance. If it fills up, he will gain sustenance. If its rope breaks, his affair will become difficult.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A bucket is interpreted as a man. Whoever sees himself drawing water with it will gain wealth from a man.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A waterskin in a dream is a servant, a brother, or a friend who guards wealth. Its fullness indicates wealth, and its emptiness indicates poverty.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A waterskin indicates travel. Drinking from it indicates receiving good during travel.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A waterskin is interpreted as a woman. Whoever sees it tear will separate from his wife.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A water carrier in a dream is a knowledgeable man who benefits people with his knowledge. Whoever sees himself giving water to people is spreading knowledge among them.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A water carrier indicates a generous man. Drinking from his hand indicates receiving good from him.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A water carrier is interpreted as a righteous man. Whoever sees himself become a water carrier, his affair will become righteous.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A fan in a dream indicates a servant or a child. It is comfort and relief from worry. Whoever sees a fan in his hand, fanning himself with it, will gain comfort and authority.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A fan indicates a woman or a servant. Fanning with it in summer indicates goodness and benefit, and in winter indicates worry.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A fan is interpreted as comfort and relief. Whoever sees his fan break, his servant or child will die.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The cradle in a dream indicates comfort and joy. For the unmarried, it is marriage, and for the married, a child. Sleeping in it indicates prison or illness.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The cradle indicates a woman or a maidservant. Whoever sees himself in the cradle will be afflicted with worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The cradle is interpreted as comfort. Whoever sees himself buy one will attain comfort and joy.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The swing in a dream indicates corruption in religion and indecision in a matter. Whoever sees himself swinging is wavering in his religion.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The swing indicates amusement and falsehood. Riding it indicates falling into strife.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The swing is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself ride it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The net in a dream indicates cunning and deceit. Falling into it indicates falling into hardship. A fishing net indicates striving to seek sustenance.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The net indicates religion or prison. Whoever sees himself fishing with it will gain sustenance.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The net is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself fall into it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The fishing hook in a dream indicates cunning and deceit in seeking sustenance. Whoever sees himself fishing with it will gain sustenance through cunning.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The fishing hook indicates a gossiping man who strives for corruption.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The fishing hook is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself fishing with it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The trap in a dream is a cunning, deceitful man. Falling into it indicates falling into hardship and cunning. Setting it indicates plotting against people.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The trap indicates debt or prison. Surviving it is salvation from hardship.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The trap is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself fall into it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The sieve in a dream indicates distinguishing between truth and falsehood, or knowledge and prudence. It is a servant who distinguishes between matters.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The sieve indicates a man who divides people. Whoever sees himself sieving flour is ridding his wealth of doubts.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The sieve is interpreted as a knowledgeable man. Whoever sees himself sieving something is investigating a matter.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The fine sieve (Mankhul) in a dream indicates knowledge and distinction. It is a knowledgeable man who distinguishes between truth and falsehood.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The fine sieve indicates a trustworthy servant. Whoever sees himself sieving flour with it will gain lawful money.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The fine sieve is interpreted as a righteous man. Whoever sees that he owns one has befriended a righteous man.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The basin in a dream is a servant or a maidservant. The water in it indicates wealth. Washing in it indicates marriage.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The basin indicates a woman. If it is of gold, she is a woman of ill repute. If of silver, she is a righteous woman.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The basin is interpreted as a servant. Whoever sees himself wash in it will be blessed with a servant.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The towel in a dream is a servant. It indicates the removal of worry and comfort.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The towel indicates a woman or a maidservant. Drying oneself with it indicates gaining benefit from a woman.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The towel is interpreted as comfort and relief. Whoever sees himself hold one will attain comfort.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The hourglass in a dream indicates counting one's life and days. The running out of its sand indicates the approach of death.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The hourglass indicates travel or waiting for something. It indicates a man who calculates matters.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The hourglass is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself looking at it is in worry and anticipation.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The map in a dream indicates travel or planning matters. Looking at it indicates planning for something. Drawing one indicates striving for a new matter.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The map indicates a wise man who manages affairs. Whoever sees himself reading a map is consulting a wise man.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The map is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself lose his map is confused about his affair.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The compass in a dream indicates guidance and righteousness. It is a knowledgeable man who guides people.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The compass indicates salvation from confusion. Whoever sees a compass in his hand will be guided to the right path.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The compass is interpreted as a righteous man. Whoever sees it break will stray from the truth.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Binoculars in a dream indicate revealing secrets and learning hidden matters. Looking through them indicates searching for truth.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Binoculars indicate a man who spies on people. They may also indicate a long journey.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Binoculars are interpreted as news coming from afar. Whoever sees himself looking through them is waiting for news.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The microscope in a dream indicates scrutinizing matters and uncovering their details. It is a knowledgeable, meticulous man.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Looking through a microscope indicates searching for a hidden matter. Whoever sees that he owns one will gain detailed knowledge.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The microscope is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself look through it is in worry and scrutiny.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The telescope in a dream indicates high ambition and looking towards the future. It indicates the science of astronomy.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Looking through a telescope indicates a long journey or waiting for news from a distant place.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The telescope is interpreted as a knowledgeable man. Whoever sees that he owns one has befriended a scholar.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The camera in a dream indicates keeping secrets or revealing them. Taking pictures with it indicates documenting a matter or giving testimony.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The camera indicates a man who spies on people. The picture in it indicates a memory.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The camera is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself take a picture is in worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The telephone in a dream indicates news coming from afar. A call on it indicates connecting with kin or partnership. Its disconnection indicates severing ties.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The telephone indicates a man who conveys news. If the sound is clear, it is true news. If it is distorted, it is false news.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The telephone is interpreted as news. Whoever sees himself talking on it is waiting for news.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The radio in a dream indicates news and rumors. Hearing it indicates hearing news. If it is good, it is good. If it is bad, it is evil.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The radio indicates a man who broadcasts secrets. Its loud sound indicates a scandal.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The radio is interpreted as news. Whoever sees himself listen to it is hearing news.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Television in a dream indicates the world, its adornment, and its temptation. Watching it indicates amusement and heedlessness. Whatever good is seen in it is good, and whatever evil is seen in it is evil.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Television indicates a hypocritical man who shows other than what he conceals. Seeing it indicates strife.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Television is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself watch it is in worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The computer in a dream indicates the mind, planning, and strategy. Working on it indicates striving for a detailed matter.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The computer indicates a knowledgeable, managing man. Whoever sees that he owns one will gain wisdom and knowledge.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The computer is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself work on it is in worry and thought.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The train in a dream indicates travel or a change of conditions. Riding it indicates moving from one state to another. Missing it indicates missing an opportunity.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The train indicates lifespan. Its speed is the speed of life passing. An accident indicates a calamity.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The train is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself ride it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The car in a dream indicates progress in the world. Its beauty and speed indicate the good state of the dreamer and the speed of achieving his wishes. An accident indicates difficulty in matters.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The car indicates a wife, travel, or a position. Riding it indicates high status and honor.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The car is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself ride it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (Analogous to Flying) The airplane in a dream indicates swift travel and sudden changes in circumstances. Boarding it indicates attaining a high position or achieving a distant wish. Its crash indicates failure in a project or a setback in life.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (Analogous to Flying) The airplane indicates news coming from afar. For the sick, it indicates the approach of their end. Boarding it with family indicates gathering for travel or an occasion.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: (Analogous to Flying) The airplane is interpreted as elevation and honor. Whoever sees himself piloting it takes charge of a great matter and bears significant responsibility.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The airport in a dream indicates the beginning of a new phase, travel, or waiting for an important matter. Crowding in it indicates many preoccupations and worries. A quiet airport indicates stability and comfort.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The airport indicates the world and departing from it. Seeing planes take off indicates missed opportunities, and their landing indicates the arrival of goodness and sustenance.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The airport is interpreted as relief and waiting for news. Whoever sees himself bidding farewell to a traveler is separating from a friend. Whoever sees himself welcoming an arrival will hear good news.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The bag in a dream is a man's secret and his trust. Whatever good or bad is in it reflects on his secret. A heavy bag is worries and responsibilities. A light one is comfort and removal of worry.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The bag indicates a wife or a servant. Losing it indicates separation or loss. Finding it indicates receiving good.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The bag is interpreted as travel. Whoever sees himself carry a bag is preparing for travel.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A passport in a dream indicates the facilitation of matters and moving from one state to a better one. Tearing it indicates difficulty in matters.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A passport indicates testimony or proof. Whoever sees himself obtain one will achieve his goal.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A passport is interpreted as relief and salvation. Whoever sees himself renew it has renewed his affair and his situation has improved.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The hotel in a dream indicates the world because it is a temporary abode. It may indicate travel, illness, or the grave. A beautiful hotel indicates a good world, and an ugly one indicates a bad world.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The hotel indicates a foreign man. Staying in it indicates mingling with foreigners.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The hotel is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself stay in one will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The restaurant in a dream indicates the place of sustenance and striving. Eating in it indicates receiving sustenance. A luxurious restaurant indicates abundant sustenance, and a simple one indicates little sustenance.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The restaurant indicates a generous man. Whoever sees himself eat in it will receive good from a generous man.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The restaurant is interpreted as goodness and benefit. Whoever sees that he owns one will gain leadership and sustenance.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Stairs in a dream indicate the means of elevation in religion and worldly life. Ascending them indicates gaining high status and position, and descending them indicates decline and dismissal. Unknown stairs indicate a long life.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Stairs indicate travel, a servant, or the stages of life. Stairs of clay indicate authority with righteousness in religion, and of wood indicate authority with hypocrisy. Falling from them is failure and loss.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Stairs are interpreted as safety and victory. Ascending them is elevation, and descending them is decline. Broken stairs indicate illness or death.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (Analogous to Ascending) The elevator in a dream indicates the rapid achievement of goals and elevation. Ascending in it indicates quickly attaining a position. Descending in it indicates a sudden decline.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The elevator indicates changing circumstances. If it is ascending, it is a change for the better. If descending, it is a change for the worse. Its breakdown indicates difficulty in matters.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The elevator is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself ride it will be afflicted with worry and anxiety.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A tunnel in a dream indicates cunning and deceit or a hidden matter. Entering it indicates entering hardship. Exiting it indicates salvation and relief.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A tunnel indicates prison or the grave. A dark tunnel indicates worry, grief, and misguidance.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A tunnel is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself enter it will be afflicted with worry. Exiting it is relief.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The gardener in a dream is a man who strives in matters of marriage. He is a righteous man who calls to goodness.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The gardener indicates a man who cares for women's affairs. Seeing him indicates goodness and blessing.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The gardener is interpreted as a righteous man. Whoever sees himself talk to him will receive goodness.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The hunter in a dream is a man who pursues women with cunning and deceit. Hunting on land indicates spoils from land, and hunting at sea indicates spoils from the sea.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The hunter indicates a man who strives to seek sustenance. Whoever sees himself hunting will gain sustenance.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The hunter is interpreted as a cunning man. Whoever sees himself fall into his hands will fall into cunning.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The shepherd in a dream is anyone who holds a position of authority. Herding sheep indicates authority over people who obey him. Herding pigs indicates authority over disbelievers.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The shepherd indicates a knowledgeable scholar or a just ruler. Whoever sees himself herding sheep will gain authority.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The shepherd is interpreted as the king or ruler. Whoever sees himself as a shepherd will gain a position.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The merchant in a dream is a man who strives to seek the world. His profit indicates profit in wakefulness, and his loss indicates loss.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The merchant indicates a striving man (mujahid). He may also indicate a man keen on the world.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The merchant is interpreted as a striving man. Whoever sees himself as a merchant will gain sustenance and travel.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Every artisan in a dream indicates the head of his craft. The tailor is a man who reconciles people, and the blacksmith is a man of might.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The artisan indicates a man who strives to seek sustenance. Whoever sees himself learn a craft will gain sustenance.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The artisan is interpreted as a managing man. Whoever sees himself sit with artisans sits with wise men.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The scholar in a dream indicates high status and prestige. Sitting with him indicates guidance. His death indicates the appearance of heresy.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The scholar indicates rain or a doctor. Whoever sees himself become a scholar will gain high status and good praise.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The scholar is interpreted as the king. Whoever sees himself talk to a scholar has talked to a king.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The poet in a dream is a man who says what he does not do and misguides people. Whoever sees himself become a poet is speaking falsehood.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The poet indicates a gossiping man. Hearing his poetry indicates hearing false speech.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The poet is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself sit with one will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (Analogous to Amusement) The actor in a dream is a hypocritical man who shows other than what he conceals. Seeing him indicates strife and vanity.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The actor indicates the world and its adornment. Whoever sees himself act is falling into vanity.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The actor is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself watch one will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Playing in a dream is mockery of religion and the world. Playing backgammon and chess is dispute and false speech. Playing with children is joy and happiness.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Playing indicates vanity. Whoever sees himself play is deluded by his world.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Playing is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself play will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Screaming in a dream indicates calamity and strife. If it is with crying, it is worry and sadness. Screaming over the dead indicates following their way.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Screaming indicates fear and hardship. Whoever sees himself scream will fall into hardship.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Screaming is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself scream will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Whispering in a dream indicates hidden speech or cunning. Whoever sees himself whisper in someone's ear is revealing a secret to him.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Whispering indicates backbiting and gossip. Whoever sees people whispering are plotting against him.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Whispering is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself whisper is in worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Writing in a dream indicates cunning and deceit. Whoever sees himself write a letter is plotting against someone. Writing with the right hand indicates good, and with the left indicates evil.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Writing indicates the fulfillment of needs. Whoever sees himself write and leaves no trace is abandoning his work.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Writing is interpreted as sustenance. Whoever sees himself write his name will gain sustenance.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Reading books in a dream indicates wisdom and knowledge. Reading the Quran indicates high status and guidance. Reading poetry indicates lying and amusement.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Reading indicates the fulfillment of needs. Whoever sees himself read a book will gain authority.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Reading is interpreted as sustenance. Whoever sees himself read will gain sustenance.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Drawing in a dream indicates amusement and falsehood. Drawing images of living beings indicates lying and fabricating lies against God.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Drawing indicates planning for something. If the drawing is beautiful, it is a good matter. If it is ugly, it is an evil matter.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Drawing is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself draw will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Sculpting stones in a dream indicates striving for a difficult matter. Sculpting statues indicates falling into strife.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Sculpting indicates having children. Whoever sees himself sculpt a stone will be blessed with a hard-hearted son.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Sculpting is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself sculpt will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Sewing in a dream indicates righteousness of affairs, family reunification, and familiarity. Whoever sees himself sew a garment for himself is reforming his worldly affairs. Whoever sees himself sew people's clothes is advising them.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Sewing indicates repentance and returning to God. For the poor, it is wealth, and for the worried, relief.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Sewing is interpreted as reconciliation. Whoever sees himself sew two garments together is reconciling two men.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Spinning in a dream indicates travel. Whoever sees himself spin cotton or wool is embarking on a blessed journey. If the thread breaks, his journey will be difficult.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Spinning indicates a righteous woman. Whoever sees himself spin will marry a righteous woman. A woman spinning indicates the arrival of her absent one.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Spinning is interpreted as sustenance. Whoever sees himself spin will gain sustenance.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Weaving in a dream indicates travel. Weaving a garment indicates completing a matter. If the garment is good, the matter is completed well.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Weaving indicates familiarity and love. Whoever sees himself weave is reconciling people.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Weaving is interpreted as travel. Whoever sees himself weave will travel.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The weaver in a dream is a man who travels often. He may also indicate a man who divides people with gossip.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The weaver indicates a man who manages people's affairs. Seeing him indicates goodness and benefit.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The weaver is interpreted as a man who strives in travel.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The dyer in a dream is a hypocritical man who adorns falsehood. Dyeing clothes indicates falling into strife.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The dyer indicates a man who brings joy to people and removes their worries. Red dye is joy, and yellow is illness.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The dyer is interpreted as a man who embellishes matters. Whoever sees himself dye a garment will fall into a matter by which he becomes known.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The cotton carder in a dream is a man who relieves distress and removes worries. Carding cotton indicates the removal of worry.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The cotton carder indicates a man who divides people. He may also indicate travel.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The cotton carder is interpreted as relief. Whoever sees himself card cotton, God will relieve his worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The mender in a dream is a man who reconciles people. Mending a garment indicates repentance and righteousness of affair.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The mender indicates a man who unites families. Whoever sees himself mend a garment is reconciling disputants.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The mender is interpreted as reconciliation. Whoever sees himself mend a garment, his affair will become righteous.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The washerman in a dream is a man who removes worries. Washing clothes indicates repentance and relief.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The washerman indicates a knowledgeable man who purifies people from sins.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The washerman is interpreted as relief. Whoever sees himself wash a garment, his worry will disappear.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The carpenter in a dream is a man who disciplines and refines people. He indicates the leader of the hypocrites.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The carpenter indicates a man who strives for the destruction of hypocrites. Seeing him indicates victory over enemies.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The carpenter is interpreted as a man who strives for reform. Whoever sees himself as a carpenter, his affair will become righteous.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The builder in a dream is a man who unites people in goodness. Building indicates long life and familiarity.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Building indicates marriage for the unmarried. Whoever sees himself build a house will get married.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Building is interpreted as goodness and blessing. Whoever sees himself build will receive goodness.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The digger in a dream is a cunning man who strives in worldly affairs. Digging graves indicates building houses. Digging wells indicates plotting against women.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The digger indicates a man who strives to seek sustenance. Whoever sees himself dig will gain sustenance with fatigue.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The digger is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself dig will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The garbage collector in a dream is a trustworthy servant or a rich man. Garbage is wealth.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The garbage collector indicates a man who strives to seek the world. Whoever sees himself collect garbage has collected wealth.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The garbage collector is interpreted as a rich man. Whoever sees himself as a garbage collector will become rich.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The bathhouse keeper in a dream is a man who removes people's worries. He may also indicate the caretaker of the ruler's house.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The bathhouse keeper indicates a man who strives in women's affairs.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The bathhouse keeper is interpreted as relief. Whoever sees himself talk to him will receive relief.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The tanner in a dream is a man who treats difficult matters and reforms them. Tanning leather indicates reforming a corrupt woman.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The tanner indicates a man who travels much and gains wealth with fatigue.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The tanner is interpreted as a man who reconciles people.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The shoemaker in a dream is a man who reconciles women. Mending a shoe indicates mending the wife's affair.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The shoemaker indicates a man who strives in women's affairs. He may also indicate a matchmaker.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The shoemaker is interpreted as a man who reconciles people.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The potter in a dream is a man who strives justly in people's affairs. Pottery is lawful money.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The potter indicates a man who assumes authority. Whoever sees himself make pottery will gain authority.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The potter is interpreted as a righteous man. Whoever sees himself buy from him has befriended a righteous man.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The house painter in a dream is a hypocritical man who adorns falsehood. Painting houses indicates pretense.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The house painter indicates a man who covers people's faults. White paint indicates righteousness, and black indicates corruption.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The house painter is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself paint his house will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The image maker (Musawwir) in a dream is a man who falls into strife. Making images of living beings indicates lying against God.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The image maker indicates a man who adorns falsehood. Seeing him indicates worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The image maker is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself make images will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The engraver in a dream is a man who adorns the world. Engraving walls indicates amusement and falsehood.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The engraver indicates a man who misguides people. Seeing him indicates strife.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The engraver is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself engrave will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The sweeper in a dream indicates a trustworthy servant who removes worries.
