interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The sweeper indicates a poor man who strives to seek sustenance.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The sweeper is interpreted as relief. Whoever sees himself sweep, his worry will disappear.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The orator in a dream is a man of position and prestige. Hearing his sermon indicates admonition. If he is worthy of giving sermons, he will gain authority.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The orator indicates a man who enjoins good and forbids evil. Whoever sees himself give a sermon, his status will rise.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The orator is interpreted as the king or ruler. Whoever sees himself talk to him will receive goodness.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The preacher in a dream is a man who cries out of fear of God. Seeing him indicates salvation from hardships. Hearing his admonition indicates repentance.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The preacher indicates a righteous man who calls to goodness. Whoever sees himself preach to people will gain high status.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The preacher is interpreted as relief. Whoever sees himself sit with one, his worry will disappear.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The muezzin in a dream is a man who calls to goodness. He may also indicate Hajj. The Adhan at its proper time indicates relief.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The muezzin indicates a truthful man. Whoever sees himself call the Adhan will gain authority.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The muezzin is interpreted as good news. Whoever hears the Adhan will hear good news.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The Imam in a dream is anyone who is followed. Seeing him indicates high status and prestige. His death indicates the ruin of the town.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The Imam indicates the father or the teacher. Whoever sees himself pray behind him is following the truth.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The Imam is interpreted as the king or ruler. Whoever sees himself talk to him will receive goodness.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The market inspector in a dream is a man who enjoins good and forbids evil. Seeing him indicates fear of the ruler.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The market inspector indicates a righteous man. Whoever sees himself become one will gain high status.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The market inspector is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself flee from him is saved from worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Silk in a dream for men indicates authority and high status but corruption in religion. Wearing it indicates marriage to a noble woman. For women, it is marriage, joy, and adornment.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Silk indicates love and passion. Wearing it indicates falling in love. Yellow silk is illness, and red is fame.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Silk is interpreted as prestige and position. Whoever sees himself wear it will gain high status. If he is dead, he is in the bliss of Paradise.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Cotton in a dream is lawful money and covering (concealment). Collecting it indicates collecting money. Carding it indicates the removal of worry.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Cotton indicates a humble man. Wearing it indicates righteousness in religion and worldly life.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Cotton is interpreted as lawful money. Whoever sees himself sell it is spending his money for good.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Wool in a dream is collected lawful money. Wearing it indicates asceticism and piety. Spinning it indicates a blessed journey.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Wool indicates a righteous man. Whoever sees himself wear it sits with the righteous.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Wool is interpreted as lawful money. Whoever sees himself collect it has collected wealth.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Linen in a dream is lawful money and good praise. Wearing it indicates a good life.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Linen indicates a righteous man. Whoever sees himself plant it will receive goodness and sustenance.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Linen is interpreted as lawful money. Whoever sees himself wear it will become rich.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Wax in a dream indicates a righteous son or a just ruler. A lit candle indicates high status and joy. Its extinguishing indicates death or dismissal.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Wax indicates knowledge and guidance. For the unmarried, it is marriage, and for the sick, healing.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Wax is interpreted as goodness and blessing. Whoever sees himself light a candle will be blessed with a righteous son.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Tar in a dream is unlawful money. Being smeared with it indicates falling into strife or heresy.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Tar indicates a man of bad character. Seeing it indicates worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Tar is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself walk on it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Pitch in a dream indicates fortification and defense. Coating a ship with it indicates salvation.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Pitch indicates a man who keeps secrets. Seeing it indicates goodness and benefit.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Pitch is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself collect it has collected wealth.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Sulfur in a dream is unlawful money. Its smell indicates ugly praise. Its ignition indicates strife.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Sulfur indicates a lying man. Seeing it indicates worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Sulfur is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees that he owns it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The playground in a dream indicates the world, its adornment, and its amusement. Playing in it indicates heedlessness of the Hereafter.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The playground indicates a market or a gathering place. Whoever sees himself play in it is disputing.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The playground is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself in it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The ball in a dream indicates dispute and travel. Playing with it indicates disputing with a man. Hitting it indicates travel.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The ball indicates a man who shifts between people. Whoever sees himself play with it will overcome his opponent.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The ball is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself play with it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The joints of the body in a dream indicate relatives and partners. Their strength is the relatives' strength, and their weakness is their weakness.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Joints indicate the management of affairs. Pain in them indicates poor management.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Joints are interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees his joints are strong, his wealth will increase.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Sweat in a dream for the sick is healing, for the poor is wealth, and for the worried is relief. Foul-smelling sweat indicates committing a sin.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Sweat indicates fulfilling a need. Sweat on the face indicates modesty.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Sweat is interpreted as wealth that comes from fatigue. Whoever sees himself sweat will gain wealth with fatigue.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Saliva in a dream is a man's wealth and strength. Its flowing indicates loss of wealth. Its dryness indicates poverty.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Saliva indicates knowledge and wisdom. Whoever sees his saliva flow will gain knowledge.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Saliva is interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees himself lick his saliva is consuming from his wealth.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Mucus in a dream indicates a child. If it is dry, it is a male child. If it is moist, it is a female. Expelling it indicates the removal of worry.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Mucus indicates a debt being paid. It may also indicate good news.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Mucus is interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees himself expel it will gain wealth.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Phlegm in a dream is a man's strength. Its expulsion indicates the removal of worry and healing from illness.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Phlegm indicates collected wealth. Whoever sees himself expel it is spending money.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Phlegm is interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees it come out of his mouth will gain wealth.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A single louse in a dream is a gossiping woman who divides people. Killing it indicates victory over a bad woman.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A louse indicates a weak enemy. Its bite indicates slander from an enemy.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: A louse is interpreted as a servant. Killing it indicates firing a servant.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The hazelnut in a dream is a rich, generous man, but difficult to deal with. Eating it indicates gaining lawful money with fatigue.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The hazelnut indicates collected wealth. Its shell indicates worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: The hazelnut is interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees himself eat it will gain wealth.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Almonds in a dream are wealth and removal of illness. Sweet almonds are lawful money. Bitter ones indicate words of truth. Its tree indicates a foreign man.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Almonds indicate healing from illnesses. For the deceased, it is a good state.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Almonds are interpreted as wealth. Eating them indicates gaining wealth after a dispute.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Pistachios in a dream are easy, blessed money. Its tree indicates a generous man.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Pistachios indicate a rich man. Eating them indicates gaining lawful money.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Pistachios are interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees himself eat them will gain wealth.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Walnuts in a dream are collected wealth that comes only with fatigue. Their sound indicates dispute. Its tree indicates a stingy man.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Walnuts indicate rich men. Playing with them indicates disputing.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Walnuts are interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees himself eat them will gain wealth with fatigue.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Chestnuts in a dream are wealth from toil and fatigue. Eating them indicates gaining wealth from a noble man.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Chestnuts indicate a strong man. Its tree indicates a man who protects his family.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Chestnuts are interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees himself eat them will gain wealth.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Chickpeas in a dream are wealth that comes with fatigue and hardship. Eating them raw indicates worry and grief. Cooked indicates sustenance.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Chickpeas indicate a stingy man. Eating them indicates gaining little wealth.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Chickpeas are interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself eat them will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Fava beans in a dream are wealth. If green, it is lawful money that grows. If dry, it is worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Fava beans indicate a poor man. Eating them indicates contentment and satisfaction.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Fava beans are interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself eat them will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Lentils in a dream are lowly money. Eating them indicates worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Lentils indicate a blessed man. Eating them indicates lawful sustenance.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Lentils are interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself eat them will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Rice in a dream is collected wealth that comes with fatigue and hardship. Eating it indicates gaining wealth proportional to what was eaten. Cooked rice is better than raw and indicates sustenance that grows and increases.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Rice indicates worry and grief if raw. If cooked, it is lawful money and blessed sustenance. Whoever sees himself plant rice is striving for a matter involving fatigue and sustenance.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Rice is interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees himself eat it will gain wealth. Rice with milk indicates a matter involving doubt.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Barley in a dream is lawful money with health of the body. It is better than wheat in some aspects. Barley flour indicates religion and guidance.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Barley indicates a short-lived son or little, blessed sustenance. Whoever sees himself plant it has done a righteous deed.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Barley is interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees himself eat it will gain lawful money.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Corn in a dream is lowly money with no good in it. Eating it indicates worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Corn indicates a poor man. It is little money that does not last.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Corn is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself eat it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Sesame in a dream is lawful money that grows and increases. Eating it indicates receiving blessed sustenance.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Sesame indicates a noble man. Whoever sees himself collect it has collected wealth.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Sesame is interpreted as lawful money. Its oil indicates blessing and healing.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Mustard seed in a dream is unlawful money or poison. Eating it indicates falling into worry or illness.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Mustard seed indicates a man of bad character. Seeing it indicates worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Mustard seed is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself eat it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Cumin in a dream is lawful money and healing from illnesses.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Cumin indicates a righteous man. Eating it indicates healing.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Cumin is interpreted as goodness and benefit. Whoever sees himself eat it will receive goodness.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Coriander in a dream is a man beneficial in religion and worldly life. Green coriander indicates righteousness, and dry indicates lasting wealth.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Coriander indicates a righteous man. Eating it indicates healing.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Coriander is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself eat it will receive goodness.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Cinnamon in a dream is good praise and a good reputation.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Cinnamon indicates a wise man. Drinking it indicates hearing words of wisdom.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Cinnamon is interpreted as good news. Whoever smells it will hear good news.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Ginger in a dream is good praise and a good reputation. Eating it indicates attaining high status.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Ginger indicates a sharp-tempered man. In Paradise, it is the drink of those brought near (to God).

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Ginger is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself eat it will receive goodness.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Pepper in a dream is unlawful money. Eating it indicates worry, grief, and dispute.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Pepper indicates a gossiping man. Seeing it indicates hearing ugly speech.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Pepper is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself eat it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Eggplant in a dream out of season is disliked. In its season, it is sustenance obtained with fatigue. White eggplant indicates good praise.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Eggplant indicates a man of changing reputation. Eating it indicates gaining sustenance through cunning and deceit.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Eggplant is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself eat it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Squash (Yaqtin) in a dream is a knowledgeable man or a doctor. It is healing from illnesses. Its tree indicates a blessed man.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Squash indicates guidance and following the Sunnah. Eating it indicates knowledge and wisdom.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Squash is interpreted as goodness and blessing. Whoever sees himself eat it will receive goodness.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Cucumber in a dream in its season is blessed sustenance. Out of season, it is illness and worry. Green cucumber indicates a righteous woman.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Cucumber indicates worry and sadness. Eating it indicates falling into worry.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Cucumber is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself eat it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Armenian cucumber in a dream indicates a son or sustenance. In its season, it is good. Out of season, it is disliked.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Armenian cucumber indicates worry and grief. Eating it indicates striving for a lowly matter.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Armenian cucumber is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself eat it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Carrot in a dream indicates an easy-going man. For whoever holds it, it is worry and grief. Eating it indicates goodness and benefit.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Carrot indicates the facilitation of difficult matters. Whoever sees himself eat it, his affair will be facilitated.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Carrot is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself eat it will receive goodness.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Turnip in a dream is a rural woman. Eating it indicates worry. Its leaves are better than its root.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Turnip indicates a righteous son. Seeing it indicates goodness and blessing.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Turnip is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself eat it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Radish in a dream is lawful sustenance. Eating it indicates striving for a good matter. Whoever sees himself plant it has started a blessed matter.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Radish indicates a man from the People of the Book (Ahl al-Dhimma). There is no good in seeing it.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Radish is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself eat it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Leek in a dream is unlawful money and ugly praise. Eating it indicates the appearance of a hidden matter.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Leek indicates a lowly man. Seeing it indicates worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Leek is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself eat it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Arugula in a dream is a man of bad character. Eating it indicates falling into evil.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Arugula indicates worry and grief. There is no good in seeing it.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Arugula is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself eat it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Lettuce in a dream indicates a man who appears good but is bad inside. Eating it indicates illness.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Lettuce indicates goodness and benefit. It is healing from illnesses.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Lettuce is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself eat it will receive goodness.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Cabbage in a dream is a coarse, harsh man. It indicates collected wealth.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Cabbage indicates a stingy man. Eating it indicates worry.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Cabbage is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself eat it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Cauliflower in a dream is a foreign man with no good in him.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Cauliflower indicates worry and grief. Eating it indicates illness.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Cauliflower is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself eat it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Spinach in a dream indicates worry and sadness.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Spinach indicates lawful money and healing from illnesses.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Spinach is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself eat it will receive goodness.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Parsley in a dream indicates righteous work and good praise.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Parsley indicates a righteous man. Eating it indicates healing.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Parsley is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself eat it will receive goodness.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Mint in a dream indicates mourning and worry. Whoever sees himself eat it will hear bad news.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Mint indicates a righteous man. Smelling it indicates comfort and joy.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Mint is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself eat it will receive goodness.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Watermelon in a dream is worry, grief, and illness, especially the yellow kind. Green watermelon indicates a worried man. Whoever sees himself eat it will emerge from worry proportional to what he ate. Indian watermelon indicates a heavy-spirited man.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Watermelon indicates unemployment and worry. Whoever sees it emerges from worry. Green watermelon indicates healing from illnesses. Red watermelon for a woman is adornment, and for a man is worry.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Watermelon is interpreted as worry and grief. Eating it indicates release from prison. Many watermelons in the house indicate the death of its inhabitants.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Apricots in a dream indicate illness. If green, it is better than yellow. Its tree indicates a rich man who does not benefit from his wealth.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Apricots indicate a hypocritical man. Eating them indicates illness or worry. Sweet apricots indicate little sustenance.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Apricots are interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself eat them will be afflicted with worry. Its tree indicates a man with no good in him.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Peaches in a dream in their season indicate achieving hope and attaining one's goal. Out of season, they indicate fatigue and illness. Sour peaches indicate fear.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Peaches indicate a righteous brother. Picking them indicates gaining wealth from a brother. Its tree indicates a rich, brave man.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Peaches are interpreted as goodness and benefit. Whoever sees himself eat them will attain what he wishes for.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Pears in a dream are collected wealth. In their season, it is sustenance. Out of season, it is illness. Green ones are lawful money, and yellow ones are illness.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Pears indicate a beautiful woman. Picking them indicates gaining wealth from a woman.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Pears are interpreted as goodness and benefit. Whoever sees himself eat them will receive goodness.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Quince in a dream indicates travel or illness. It is disliked for its color and taste. Its tree indicates a man who is not benefited from.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Quince indicates a wise man. For a merchant, it is profit, and for the sick, healing.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Quince is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself eat it will receive goodness.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Mulberries in a dream are lawful money and abundant sustenance. White mulberries indicate righteousness in religion, and black ones indicate an increase in wealth.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Mulberries indicate a righteous, rich man. Eating them indicates receiving sustenance from a righteous man.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Mulberries are interpreted as goodness and benefit. Whoever sees himself eat them will receive goodness.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Cherries in a dream indicate joy and lawful money. Eating them indicates achieving what one wishes for.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Cherries indicate an honest man. Its tree indicates a wise man.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Cherries are interpreted as goodness and benefit. Whoever sees himself eat them will receive goodness.

interpretations.source: Tafsir al-Ahlam al-Kabir (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Bananas in a dream are wealth. For a merchant, it is wealth, and for a worshiper, religion. Eating them for the sick indicates death.

interpretations.source: Ta'tir al-Anam fi Ta'bir al-Manam (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Bananas indicate a rich, generous man. Its tree indicates a believing man.

interpretations.source: Al-Isharat fi Ilm al-Ibarat (Ibn Shahin)
interpretations.text: Bananas are interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees himself eat them will gain wealth.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Lemon in a dream indicates blame. A green lemon is better than a yellow one. A yellow lemon indicates illness and worry.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Lemon indicates illness and worry. Its tree is a man beneficial to people. Eating it indicates gaining money after blame.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Lemon is interpreted as blame. The yellow of it is illness, and the green is good. Whoever sees himself squeezing it will fall into worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Orange in a dream indicates children. If it is sweet, it is sustenance and a righteous child. If it is sour, it is illness and worry.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Orange indicates health of the body. Collecting it indicates gathering money. Its tree indicates a righteous man.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Orange is interpreted as goodness and benefit. Whoever sees himself eating it will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Sour pomegranate in a dream is unlawful money or worry and grief. Eating it indicates falling into worry.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Sour pomegranate indicates a woman of bad character. Or it indicates a city whose people are corrupt.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Sour pomegranate is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself eating it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Coconut in a dream indicates money from a non-Arab man. It may indicate the speech of soothsayers and astrologers. Eating it indicates gaining knowledge from an astrologer.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Coconut indicates a strange man. Whoever sees himself eating it will hear strange speech.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Coconut is interpreted as money. Whoever sees himself eating it will gain money.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Sugarcane in a dream is good words that are repeated. Sucking it indicates attaining what one wishes after effort. Pressing it indicates gaining money with difficulty.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Sugarcane indicates lawful money. Planting it indicates a good deed.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Sugarcane is interpreted as goodness and benefit. Whoever sees himself eating it will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Chard in a dream indicates sustenance from a noble man. It is commendable for whoever eats it.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Chard indicates a man who conceals people's flaws. Seeing it indicates goodness.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Chard is interpreted as goodness and benefit. Whoever sees himself eating it will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Dandelion in a dream is money from a lowly man. Eating it indicates worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Dandelion indicates a servant of bad character. Seeing it indicates worry.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Dandelion is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself eating it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Prayer in the mosque indicates following the Sunnah, fulfillment of needs, and safety from fear. Whoever sees himself praying in the mosque will attain goodness and sustenance.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Prayer in the mosque indicates profitable trade. Whoever sees himself leading prayer in the mosque will gain a position of power.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Prayer in the mosque is interpreted as goodness and blessing. Whoever sees himself praying in it, his affairs will be rectified.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Obligatory prayer at home indicates the righteousness of the household. Optional prayer in it indicates sustenance and blessing.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Prayer at home indicates stability and comfort. Whoever sees himself praying in his home, his affairs will stabilize.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Prayer at home is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself praying in it will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Ablution with murky or hot water indicates worry, grief, and illness. It indicates falling into a doubtful matter.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Whoever sees himself performing ablution with murky water will fall into worry. If he is a merchant, he will lose in his trade.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Ablution with murky water is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself performing ablution with it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Reading the Quran in a dream indicates exaltation, prestige, and enjoining good and forbidding evil. Whoever sees himself reading the Quran while not having memorized it will gain knowledge.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Reading the Quran indicates the fulfillment of needs. Whoever sees himself reading it, his status will rise.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Reading the Quran is interpreted as goodness and blessing. Whoever sees himself reading it will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Demolishing a building in a dream indicates death, separation, or loss. Demolishing a house indicates the death of its owner. Demolishing a mosque indicates the death of a scholar.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Demolition indicates worry, grief, and calamity. Whoever sees himself demolishing his house will scatter his family.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Demolition is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself demolishing something will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Walking in a dream indicates striving to seek livelihood. Walking barefoot indicates worry and fatigue. Walking on one leg indicates losing half of one's money.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Walking indicates following the Sunnah. Whoever sees himself walking straight is on the right path.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Walking is interpreted as livelihood. Whoever sees himself walking is striving to seek livelihood.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Standing in a dream indicates stagnation of one's condition and difficulty in affairs. Whoever sees himself standing, his affairs will stop.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Standing indicates confusion and hesitation. Standing in prayer indicates steadfastness in religion.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Standing is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself standing is in worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Sitting in a dream indicates stability and comfort. Sitting on a chair indicates exaltation and position.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Sitting indicates having control of a matter. Whoever sees himself sitting on the ground, his affairs will stabilize.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Sitting is interpreted as comfort. Whoever sees himself sitting will attain comfort.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Leaping in a dream indicates travel or a change in condition. Leaping to a high place indicates exaltation. To a low place indicates degradation.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Leaping indicates strength and activity. Whoever sees himself leaping, his affair will become strong.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Leaping is interpreted as travel. Whoever sees himself leaping will travel.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: An earthquake in a dream indicates fear of the ruler or a general affliction that will befall that place. If one sees the earth shaking with him, it indicates the emergence of hidden matters. The shaking of the earth indicates illness, war, or strife.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: An earthquake indicates travel or a change in conditions. If the earthquake is in a specific place, it indicates a hardship that will afflict its people. If one sees a mountain moving from its place, it indicates the death of a king or a great man.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: An earthquake is interpreted as torment and worry. Whoever sees the earth shaking will fall into worry and hardship. If the earthquake is light, it is a minor worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with fire) A volcano in a dream indicates great strife and anger from the ruler. The eruption of lava from it indicates a general affliction and illness.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A volcano indicates an angry man with authority. Its eruption indicates war or great strife. Escaping from it is salvation from hardship.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A volcano is interpreted as torment. Whoever sees himself near it is in danger.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A lunar eclipse in a dream indicates a calamity that afflicts the minister or the scholar, or removal from a position. It may indicate the death of the king's wife.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A lunar eclipse indicates the illness of one attributed to the moon, like the wife or mother. It may indicate a loss in trade.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A lunar eclipse is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees the moon eclipsed will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A solar eclipse in a dream indicates a calamity that afflicts the king or the father. It may indicate illness or death.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A solar eclipse indicates the appearance of heresy or the death of a scholar. It may indicate the injustice of the ruler.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A solar eclipse is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees the sun eclipsed will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A thunderbolt in a dream is torment from the ruler or a debt. If it burns something, it is damage to property. If it kills, it is death upon sin.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A thunderbolt indicates sudden bad news. It may indicate a sudden illness.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A thunderbolt is interpreted as torment. Whoever sees it strike a place, torment will befall it.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Meteors in a dream indicate the cursing of devils and following the Sunnah. They may indicate war or strife.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Meteors indicate scholarly men who strike with the truth. Whoever sees a meteor fall, a scholar has died.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Meteors are interpreted as goodness and blessing. Seeing them indicates righteousness in religion.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The galaxy in a dream indicates the gathering of nobles and scholars. It is a path of goodness and guidance.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The galaxy indicates a blessed journey. Looking at it indicates high ambition.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The galaxy is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself walking in it is walking on a path of goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The horizon in a dream indicates hope and expectation. A clear horizon indicates the fulfillment of wishes. A cloudy one indicates despair.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The horizon indicates a distant journey. Looking at it indicates waiting for someone absent.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The horizon is interpreted as news. If it is bright, it is good news. If it is dark, it is bad news.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A mirage in a dream is falsehood, delusion, and a matter that will not be completed. Whoever sees himself following a mirage is following a false matter.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A mirage indicates a lying man who does not keep his promise. Seeing it indicates disappointment.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A mirage is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: An echo in a dream indicates false speech or a man who imitates others. Hearing it indicates hearing false news.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: An echo indicates a man with no opinion of his own. Whoever sees himself hearing his echo is following his desires.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: An echo is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself hearing it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A shadow in a dream indicates a ruler or a scholar to whom people resort. Sitting in it indicates comfort and safety. Its disappearance indicates the loss of position.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A shadow indicates the wife or child. It is better in summer than in winter.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A shadow is interpreted as a noble man. Whoever sees himself sitting in it is sitting with a noble man.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Air in a dream indicates religion and guidance. Clear air indicates righteousness in religion. Murky air indicates strife.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Air indicates the ruler. Whoever sees himself owning the air will gain authority.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Air is interpreted as falsehood. Whoever sees himself following it is following falsehood.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A dry well in a dream indicates a woman who does not give birth, or a scholar whose knowledge is not benefited from, or poverty and unemployment.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A dry well indicates difficulty in affairs and disappointment. Descending into it indicates worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A dry well is interpreted as a poor woman. Whoever sees himself digging it is striving for a matter that will not be completed.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A spring in a dream indicates a noble, generous man. A clear spring indicates lasting goodness. A murky one indicates worry and illness.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A spring indicates a child, a wife, or knowledge. Drinking from it indicates attaining goodness.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A spring is interpreted as goodness and blessing. Whoever sees himself bathing from it, his worry will vanish.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A canal in a dream indicates a man through whom sustenance flows. The flow of water in it indicates the continuity of sustenance.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A canal indicates a servant or a messenger. Whoever sees himself digging it will gain sustenance.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A canal is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees water flowing in it will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A waterwheel in a dream indicates a man who strives for people's interests. Its sound indicates a dispute.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A waterwheel indicates travel and sustenance. Its rotation indicates striving to seek livelihood.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A waterwheel is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees it turning will attain goodness and sustenance.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A dam in a dream is an impenetrable man who keeps secrets. It indicates a just ruler. Its collapse indicates the death of the ruler.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A dam indicates knowledge and religion that prevents strife. Building it indicates a good deed.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A dam is interpreted as the king. Its strength is the king's strength, and its weakness is the king's weakness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with running water) A waterfall in a dream indicates continuous sustenance and lasting goodness. Its sound indicates fame and good reputation.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A waterfall indicates a generous, bountiful man. Bathing in its water indicates the removal of worry and healing.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A waterfall is interpreted as goodness and blessing. Whoever sees himself standing under it will attain abundant goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Ice in a dream is torment, worry, and grief. Walking on it indicates striving in a dangerous matter.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Ice indicates collected money. Its melting indicates the disappearance of worry and money.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Ice is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself eating it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Hail in a dream is torment from God or war. If it is a small amount in its season, it is fertility and sustenance.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Hail indicates high prices and poverty. It may indicate illness.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Hail is interpreted as torment. Whoever sees it descending on a people, torment will befall them.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A channel in a dream indicates sustenance that flows through a man. The flow of water in it indicates the continuity of sustenance.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A channel indicates a servant or a partner. Clear water in it indicates the righteousness of the servant.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A channel is interpreted as goodness and benefit. Whoever sees himself drinking from it will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A swamp in a dream indicates a woman of bad character or strife. Falling into it indicates falling into worry and hardship.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A swamp indicates a lowly man. Getting out of it is salvation from evil.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A swamp is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself falling into it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Mud in a dream is strife, worry, and illness. Walking in it indicates wading into strife.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Mud indicates hardship and illness. Getting out of it is salvation and relief.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Mud is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself falling into it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A fountain in a dream is a generous, noble man. If it is clear, it is lasting goodness. If it is murky, it is worry and illness.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A fountain indicates a child, a wife, or knowledge. Drinking from it indicates attaining goodness.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A fountain is interpreted as goodness and blessing. Whoever sees himself bathing from it, his worry will vanish.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Treasure in a dream indicates knowledge for the scholar, a position for the ruler, and money for the merchant. If the dreamer is single, he will marry. Finding a treasure indicates vast sustenance or martyrdom in the cause of God. A small treasure is a minor worry.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Treasure indicates pregnancy for a woman. It may indicate collected money. Whoever sees himself finding a treasure will gain knowledge, a child, or money according to the size of the treasure.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Treasure is interpreted as goodness and benefit. Whoever sees himself extracting a treasure will gain money from a ruler or knowledge from a scholar.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A dinar in a dream indicates a handsome male child. Many dinars indicate knowledge and a position of power. Whoever sees himself losing a dinar, his son will die or he will abandon a prayer.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A dinar indicates religion and knowledge. Whoever sees a dinar in his hand will be entrusted with a secret or knowledge.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A dinar is interpreted as a child or knowledge. Whoever sees himself finding dinars will be blessed with children or knowledge.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A dirham in a dream indicates a male child. It may indicate speech and dispute. A sound dirham indicates truthful speech, and a fake one indicates false speech.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A dirham indicates an answered prayer. Whoever sees a dirham in his hand will get what he wishes.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A dirham is interpreted as a child. Whoever sees himself finding one will be blessed with a child.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Copper coins (Fulus) in a dream indicate ugly speech, dispute, and worry. Whoever sees himself finding them will fall into worry.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Copper coins indicate cheating and deception. There is no good in seeing them.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Copper coins are interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself possessing them will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A wall in a dream is the man's condition. If it is strong, his condition is strong. If it is leaning, it indicates illness or worry. Its fall indicates the death of the house's owner.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A wall indicates an impenetrable man. Whoever sees himself building a wall is building glory or marrying into a family.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A wall is interpreted as a noble man. Walking on it indicates having control of matters.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The foundation of a building in a dream is the grandfather, the father, or the religion. Its strength is the strength of the religion and the grandfather. Its weakness is their weakness.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The foundation indicates knowledge and piety. Whoever sees himself laying a foundation will be blessed with a scholarly child.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The foundation is interpreted as the father. Whoever sees his foundation is strong, his father was righteous.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Baked brick in a dream is unlawful money. Building with it indicates falling into worry and hardship.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Brick indicates men gathered for corruption. Seeing it indicates worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Brick is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself building with it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Gypsum in a dream indicates stability of affairs and righteousness in religion. Plastering the house indicates covering and protection from enemies.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Gypsum indicates a hypocritical man. Working with it indicates falling into heresy.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Gypsum is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself plastering his house will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Pebbles in a dream are money and dirhams. Collecting them indicates gathering money. They indicate hard-hearted men.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Pebbles indicate dispute and harsh speech. Walking on them indicates worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Pebbles are interpreted as money. Whoever sees himself collecting them will gather money.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A rock in a dream indicates patient women or long life. Sitting on it indicates marriage. Moving it indicates striving in a difficult matter.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A rock indicates a hard-hearted man or a scholar who does not act on his knowledge.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A rock is interpreted as a noble man. Whoever sees himself owning it has befriended a noble man.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Tiles in a dream indicate beautiful women. Their beauty indicates their beauty. Breaking them indicates separating from them.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Tiles indicate a man's worldly life. Its breadth is the breadth of his world. Its cleanliness is its righteousness.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Tiles are interpreted as women. Whoever sees himself tiling his house will marry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Marble in a dream is money, exaltation, and joy. It indicates a beautiful, rich wife. White marble indicates religion and righteousness.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Marble indicates a position of power or profitable trade. Whoever sees his house is made of marble will attain wealth and exaltation.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Marble is interpreted as goodness and benefit. Whoever sees himself owning it will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Wood in a dream is hypocritical men. A roof of wood indicates an arrogant man. Walking on wood indicates traveling by sea.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Wood indicates a man who is relied upon in matters. Collecting it indicates slander.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Wood is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself carrying it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A pin in a dream is worry and grief. It may indicate a servant or a male child.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A pin indicates a slandering man. Being pricked by it indicates harm from an enemy.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A pin is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself being struck by it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: An axe in a dream indicates sustenance and strength. It is a man who is relied upon in hardships. Striking with it indicates victory over enemies.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: An axe indicates a brave man. Whoever sees an axe in his hand will gain a position of power.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: An axe is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself striking with it will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A saw in a dream is a man who divides people. It indicates dispute and argument.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A saw indicates a man who divides inheritances. Whoever sees himself sawing wood is separating two partners.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A saw is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself sawing with it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Scissors in a dream are a just, dividing man. Cutting hair with them indicates the removal of worry. Cutting cloth indicates separation.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Scissors indicate a man who divides people. Whoever sees scissors in his hand will dispute.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Scissors are interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself cutting with them will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A nail in a dream is a mediator between people. Hammering it indicates marriage or completing a matter.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A nail indicates a brother or a son. Whoever sees himself finding a nail will be blessed with a son.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A nail is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself hammering it will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Sulfur (matches) in a dream is unlawful money. Its smell indicates ugly praise. Its ignition indicates strife.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Sulfur indicates a lying man. Seeing it indicates worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Sulfur is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself possessing it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A wicker basket in a dream is a servant. If it is full, he is a rich servant. If it is empty, he is a poor servant.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A wicker basket indicates a woman or travel. Carrying it indicates worry.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A wicker basket is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself carrying it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A candle in a dream is a righteous son, a just ruler, or a righteous wife. A lit candle indicates exaltation and joy. Its extinguishing indicates death, dismissal, or worry.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A candle indicates knowledge and guidance. For the single, it is marriage; for the sick, recovery; and for the pregnant, a male child.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A candle is interpreted as goodness and blessing. Whoever sees himself lighting a candle will be blessed with a righteous son or gain a position of power.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A lantern in a dream is the custodian of the house, the scholar of the town, or a righteous son. Its light indicates righteousness in religion and worldly life. Its extinguishing indicates the death of the one it represents or the loss of a blessing.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A lantern indicates a righteous son, a righteous wife, or a good life. A bright lantern light indicates abundant sustenance and relief.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A lantern is interpreted as knowledge, guidance, and faith. Whoever sees himself lighting a lantern will be blessed with a scholarly son or will repent from his sins.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A desk in a dream indicates position and work. An organized desk indicates organized affairs and success. A messy desk indicates distraction and loss.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A desk indicates a man who manages his affairs. Sitting at it indicates taking responsibility. Writing on it indicates making contracts.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A desk is interpreted as the wife or business partner. Whatever good or bad is seen in it reflects on them.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A message in a dream indicates a position of power or rank. A folded message indicates a hidden matter. Reading it indicates hearing news. If it is sealed, it is true news.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A message indicates the fulfillment of needs. Whoever sees himself writing a message is striving for a matter and will attain it.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A message is interpreted as news. If it is open, it is well-known news. If it is closed, it is secret news.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Ink in a dream indicates a child, sustenance, and benefit. Writing with it indicates completing a matter. Spilling it indicates loss of money.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Ink indicates knowledge and wisdom. Whoever sees himself drinking ink will gain knowledge.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Ink is interpreted as goodness and blessing. Whoever sees his garment stained with it will gain fame.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A seal in a dream is a position of power and rank. Whoever sees himself sealing something is completing a matter. A seal of gold indicates a position with worry.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A seal indicates marriage for the single. Sealing a message indicates achieving one's goal.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A seal is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself sealing will attain goodness and rank.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A mailman in a dream indicates news coming from afar. If his face is handsome, it is good news. If it is ugly, it is bad news.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Mail indicates a trustworthy man who delivers news. Seeing him indicates the fulfillment of needs.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Mail is interpreted as news. Whoever sees himself receiving mail will hear news.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: An alley in a dream indicates worry, grief, and distress. Exiting it is relief and salvation.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: An alley indicates a woman of bad character. Walking in it indicates falling into hardship.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: An alley is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself walking in it will be afflicted with worry.
