interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A fence in a dream indicates religion or a man who protects his family. Its strength is the strength of the religion, and its weakness is its weakness.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A fence indicates a partner or a neighbor. Whoever sees himself building a fence is fortifying himself.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A fence is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself building it will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Flowers in a dream indicate joy and happiness that does not last. Picking them indicates receiving good praise. Yellow flowers indicate a sick woman.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Flowers indicate children or wealth. Seeing them indicates the return of an absent person.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Flowers are interpreted as goodness and benefit. Whoever sees himself gathering them will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A thorn in a dream indicates a man of difficult temperament. It entering the body indicates falling into strife or debt.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A thorn indicates worry and grief. Removing it indicates the removal of worry.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A thorn is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees it entering his hand will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Grass in a dream indicates religion and Islam. Green grass indicates righteousness in religion. Dry grass indicates its corruption.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Grass indicates money and sustenance. Eating it indicates wealth for the poor, and illness for the rich.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Grass is interpreted as goodness and blessing. Whoever sees himself gathering it will gather money.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Embers in a dream are unlawful money or a matter involving danger. Whoever sees himself carrying them is bearing a sin.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Embers indicate a man seeking knowledge from an unjust ruler. Eating them indicates consuming orphans' money.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Embers are interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself being touched by them will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Steam in a dream indicates worry, grief, and an incomplete matter. It indicates false speech.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Steam indicates confusion and hesitation. Whoever sees it coming out of his mouth is telling lies.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Steam is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A sponge in a dream indicates a servant or a child. It indicates a man who gathers money.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A sponge indicates a man who strives for people's interests. Seeing it indicates goodness.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A sponge is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself owning it will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with a comb) A hairbrush in a dream indicates a beneficial man who removes worries. Using it indicates the removal of worry and healing.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A hairbrush indicates joy and happiness. It indicates the righteousness of affairs.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A hairbrush is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself combing with it, his affairs will be rectified.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A dove in a dream is a righteous woman or a beautiful maidservant. Its coo indicates longing and nostalgia.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A dove indicates a companionable woman. Whoever catches one will marry a righteous woman.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A dove is interpreted as a woman. Whoever sees himself eating its meat will gain money from a woman.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A parrot in a dream is a philosopher man or an orphan. It may indicate a beautiful woman. Teaching it to speak indicates striving for a false matter.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A parrot indicates a lying man. Seeing it indicates worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A parrot is interpreted as a non-Arab man. Whoever sees himself owning one has befriended a non-Arab man.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A canary in a dream is a handsome-faced child, or a man who recites the Quran with a beautiful voice.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A canary indicates a companionable man. Its song indicates hearing good news.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A canary is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself owning one will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A nightingale in a dream is a singing child or an eloquent man.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A nightingale indicates a righteous man. Its song indicates hearing good words.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A nightingale is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself hearing it will hear good news.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A seagull in a dream is a merchant man who travels by sea. Seeing it indicates travel and sustenance.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A seagull indicates a man who travels frequently. Whoever sees himself catching one will gain sustenance from travel.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A seagull is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself owning one will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A gecko in a dream is a slandering man who enjoins evil and forbids good. Killing it indicates triumph over a bad man.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A gecko indicates a weak enemy. Seeing it indicates worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A gecko is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself killing it, his worry will vanish.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A lizard in a dream is a slandering man who corrupts relations between people. It is an enemy that does not harm.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A lizard indicates a sick man. Killing it indicates the recovery of the sick.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A lizard is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself killing it, his worry will vanish.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A silkworm in a dream indicates the ruler's subjects and his goodness. It may indicate unlawful money.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A silkworm indicates a man who strives to seek lawful (halal) earnings. Whoever sees himself raising them will attain goodness and sustenance.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A silkworm is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees it producing silk will attain goodness from a ruler.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A cockroach in a dream is a weak enemy. Many of them indicate worry and grief. Killing them indicates triumph over an enemy.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A cockroach indicates a slandering man. Seeing it indicates hearing ugly speech.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A cockroach is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself killing it, his worry will vanish.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A beetle in a dream is an ugly, slandering woman. It may indicate a filthy enemy.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A beetle indicates a man of bad character. Killing it indicates triumph over an enemy.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A beetle is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself killing it, his worry will vanish.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A dung beetle in a dream is a magician man or a filthy enemy. It indicates unlawful money.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A dung beetle indicates a bad servant. Killing it indicates firing a servant.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A dung beetle is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself killing it, his worry will vanish.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The monk in a dream is a heretical man of falsehood and cunning. Whoever sees himself becoming a monk introduces heresy into his religion and mixes with the people of misguidance.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The monk indicates a man who is eager for the world, showing asceticism while concealing desire. Sitting with him indicates mixing with the people of heresy.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The monk is interpreted as worry and grief. Whoever sees himself speaking to a monk will fall into worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The soothsayer in a dream is a man of falsehood and lies. Whoever sees himself becoming a soothsayer falls into strife and speaks falsehood.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The soothsayer indicates a slandering man who divides people. Asking him a question indicates falling into confusion.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The soothsayer is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself sitting with him will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The fortune-teller in a dream is a lying man who claims knowledge of the unseen. Believing him indicates misguidance.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The fortune-teller indicates a man who leads people into strife. Whoever sees himself becoming a fortune-teller falls into strife.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The fortune-teller is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself asking him a question will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The astrologer in a dream is a man of falsehood. Whoever sees himself becoming an astrologer mixes with the people of falsehood.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The astrologer indicates a man who misleads people. Seeing him indicates worry.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The astrologer is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself sitting with him will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The slave in a dream indicates an owned man. Whoever sees himself becoming a slave falls into hardship. Whoever sees himself freeing a slave, God will relieve his worry.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The slave indicates worry and humiliation. Buying one indicates buying worry. Selling one indicates the disappearance of worry.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The slave is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself as a slave will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The eunuch in a dream indicates angels. Whoever sees himself becoming a eunuch attains exaltation. It may indicate a man who does not keep a secret.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The eunuch indicates a man trustworthy with secrets. Seeing him indicates goodness.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The eunuch is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself speaking to him will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Blindness in a dream is misguidance in religion. Whoever sees himself blind is straying from the truth. If he is an infidel, he will be afflicted with worry. Blindness of sight (for a believer) indicates wealth.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A blind person indicates a rich man who is ungrateful for blessings. Whoever sees himself treating him is guiding him to the truth.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Blindness is interpreted as misguidance. Whoever sees himself blind is in misguidance.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Deafness in a dream is corruption in religion. Whoever sees himself deaf does not listen to the truth.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A deaf person indicates a man who does not accept advice. Seeing him indicates worry.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Deafness is interpreted as misguidance. Whoever sees himself deaf is in misguidance.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Muteness in a dream is corruption in religion. Whoever sees himself mute backbites people. If he is righteous, it is piety and silence from falsehood.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A mute person indicates a heretical man. Seeing him indicates worry.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Muteness is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself mute will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A one-eyed person in a dream is a man deficient in religion and worldly life. He indicates a man who looks at what is forbidden.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A one-eyed person indicates a man who sees with only one eye. It indicates a deficiency in wealth or children.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Being one-eyed is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself one-eyed will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Lameness in a dream is weakness in religion or worldly life. Whoever sees himself lame is striving for a matter that will not be completed.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A lame person indicates a man who depends on others. It may indicate travel.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Lameness is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself lame will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A hunchback in a dream indicates worry, grief, and debts. Whoever sees himself as a hunchback is carrying a heavy burden.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A hunchback indicates a man of great wealth and long life.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A hunchback is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself as a hunchback will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: An old man in a dream indicates seriousness and luck. An unknown old man is the dreamer's

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: An old man indicates a scholar or a righteous man. Accompanying him indicates guidance.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: An old man is interpreted as goodness and blessing. Whoever sees himself becoming an old man will gain dignity and knowledge.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: An old woman in a dream is the worldly life (dunya). A beautiful old woman is a world approaching with goodness. An ugly one is a world turning away with evil. Her death indicates the demise of the worldly life.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: An old woman indicates a year. A fat old woman is a fertile year, and a thin one is a year of drought.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: An old woman is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself speaking to her will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A young man in a dream is an enemy. An unknown young man is a strong enemy. A white (skinned) young man is a hidden enemy, and a black (skinned) one is a rich enemy.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A young man indicates strength and activity. Whoever sees himself becoming a young man, his affair will be renewed and strengthened.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A young man is interpreted as an enemy. Whoever sees himself fighting him is fighting an enemy.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A virgin in a dream indicates a world approaching with goodness. Whoever sees himself marrying a virgin will attain goodness and a position.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A virgin indicates profitable trade or land that has not been cultivated. Taking her virginity indicates starting a new matter.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A virgin is interpreted as goodness and blessing. Whoever sees himself speaking to her will hear good news.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A non-virgin woman in a dream indicates a world that has been experienced. Marrying her indicates entering an easy matter.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A non-virgin woman indicates an old trade. Whoever sees himself marrying her will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A non-virgin woman is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself speaking to her will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A barren woman in a dream indicates worry and grief. Marrying her indicates entering a matter with no good in it.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A barren woman indicates a year of drought. Whoever sees himself marrying her will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A barren woman is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself speaking to her will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A widow in a dream indicates a deficient world. Marrying her indicates entering a deficient matter.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A widow indicates need and want. Whoever sees himself marrying her will be afflicted with poverty.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A widow is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself speaking to her will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A divorced woman in a dream indicates separation from work or a position. Marrying her indicates returning to an old job.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A divorced woman indicates unemployment and worry. Whoever sees himself marrying her will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A divorced woman is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself speaking to her will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Nudity in a dream indicates exposure of secrets and scandal. If it is among people who are not ashamed, it is good. Nudity in the mosque indicates repentance.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Nudity indicates an enemy who shows friendship. For the sick, it is recovery, and for the worried, it is relief.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Nudity is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself naked will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Heat in a dream, in its season, indicates fertility and sustenance. Out of its season, it indicates illnesses and worries.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Heat indicates poverty and debt. Whoever sees himself being harmed by heat will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Heat is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself in heat will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Cold in a dream indicates poverty. Whoever sees himself in extreme cold will be afflicted with poverty and worry. Cold in its season (winter) is better than seeing it out of season. Washing with cold water indicates repentance and healing.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Cold indicates fear of the ruler or debt. It may indicate unemployment and disruption of travel. Whoever sees himself shivering from cold will become poor.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Cold is interpreted as worry and grief. Whoever sees himself feeling cold will be afflicted with worry. Wearing what protects from cold indicates wealth and salvation from worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Heat in a dream, in its season (summer), indicates fertility, sustenance, and benefit. Out of its season, it indicates illnesses, worries, and strife.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Heat indicates poverty and debt. Whoever sees himself being harmed by heat will be afflicted with worry and grief from a ruler or a debt.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Heat is interpreted as worry and grief. Whoever sees himself in heat will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A raging sea in a dream indicates great strife and affliction, or an unjust, oppressive ruler. Riding it indicates entering a dangerous matter. Escaping from it is salvation from hardship.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A raging, dark sea indicates strife and affliction. It may indicate fear and hardship. Whoever sees himself struggling with its waves is struggling with worries and horrors.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A raging sea is interpreted as an unjust king. Whoever sees himself drowning in it will fall under the king's oppression.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A calm, clear sea in a dream indicates a just king, goodness, and prosperity. Swimming in it indicates entering the king's service and gaining benefit.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A calm sea indicates a stable life and abundant sustenance. For the traveler, it is safety, and for the sick, it is recovery.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A calm sea is interpreted as a just king. Whoever sees himself drinking from it will gain money from the king.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Diving in the sea indicates entering the service of the ruler or seeking knowledge. If one brings out pearls, he will gain wealth or knowledge.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Diving indicates striving in a dangerous matter. If the water is clear, it is striving for good. If it is murky, it is striving for evil.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Diving is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself diving will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Ebb and flow in a dream indicate fluctuating conditions and unstable affairs. The flow (high tide) indicates an increase in goodness, and the ebb (low tide) indicates its decrease.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Ebb and flow indicate the ruler's commands and prohibitions. The flow indicates his giving, and the ebb indicates his withholding.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Ebb and flow are interpreted as worry. Whoever sees them will be afflicted with worry and anxiety.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A mole in a dream is a man blind of heart, or a misguided heretic. It may indicate the uncovering of hidden matters because it brings out what is in the earth. Whoever catches one will triumph over a man with these traits.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A mole indicates a heretical man who digs into religion and creates strife. It may indicate a rich, miserly man who hides his wealth. Whoever sees himself eating its meat has backbitten a misguided man.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A mole is interpreted as a man who strives for worldly matters and forgets the hereafter. Whoever sees himself catching one will befriend a misguided man.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The laughter of a dead person in a dream indicates their good state in the hereafter and that they are in bliss and happy. It is good tidings for the dreamer of righteousness and a good outcome.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Whoever sees a dead person laughing or smiling will receive goodness and benefit from them, such as an answered prayer, accepted charity, or a debt paid on their behalf.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The laughter of the dead is good tidings for the dreamer of the acceptance of their deeds and the righteousness of their state. It indicates that the deceased is pleased with their family.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The speech of a dead person in a dream is truth and sincerity, because they are in the abode of truth. Everything they say, command, or forbid is true and must be followed if it is good. Whoever sees himself speaking to a dead person will have a long life.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Whoever sees a dead person speaking to him will have reconciliation with people after a dispute, or a difficult need will be met. The speech of the dead is an admonition and a reminder.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The speech of the dead indicates an admonition for the dreamer. If they command something, it must be done if it is good and in accordance with Sharia. If they forbid something, it must be avoided.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with money) Paper money in a dream may indicate temporary sustenance or fleeting worries. A lot of it may indicate strife or much talk.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with money) Paper money indicates relief after hardship, or the fulfillment of a need. It may indicate talk and dispute.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with money) Paper money is interpreted as worry and grief. Whoever sees himself finding it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A bank in a dream indicates a place for saving money and trusts. It may indicate a rich man or a strong institution. Entering it indicates seeking money or security.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A bank indicates trust and financial security. Depositing money in it indicates saving money, and withdrawing it indicates needing it.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A bank is interpreted as a rich and trustworthy man. Dealing with it indicates financial benefit.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with writing and money) A check in a dream indicates a promise of money or a financial commitment. Receiving it indicates the imminent acquisition of money. Writing it indicates spending money or committing to a debt.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A check indicates trust or a guarantee. It may indicate travel.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A check is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself holding one will be afflicted with worry because of money.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with sustenance and money) A salary in a dream indicates regular sustenance and livelihood. Its increase indicates an expansion in sustenance. Its decrease indicates hardship.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A salary indicates reward for work. Receiving it indicates gaining benefit.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A salary is interpreted as goodness and benefit. Whoever sees himself receiving it will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Inheritance in a dream indicates knowledge, money, or marriage. Whoever sees himself inheriting money will gain knowledge or marry.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Inheritance indicates goodness and blessing. Whoever sees himself inheriting something will attain goodness from where he does not expect.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Inheritance is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself inheriting will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A will in a dream indicates a covenant and pact. Whoever sees himself making a will is concerned about his religious or worldly affairs.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A will indicates maintaining family ties. Whoever sees himself receiving a bequest is bearing a trust.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A will is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself writing his will will have a long life.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Buying in a dream indicates desire for the thing bought. Buying what is good indicates goodness, and buying what is evil indicates evil. Buying a slave indicates buying worry.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Buying indicates replacement. Whoever buys something and sells it has replaced one state with another.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Buying is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself buying something will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Selling in a dream indicates dispensing with the thing sold. Whoever sells his hereafter for his worldly life has lost. Whoever sells his worldly life for his hereafter has profited.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Selling indicates separation. Whoever sells something he loves will part with someone dear to him.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Selling is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself selling something will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A pawn in a dream indicates debt and worry. Whoever sees himself pawning something will fall into debt.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A pawn indicates the stability of a matter. Whoever sees himself pawning, his matter will become stable.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A pawn is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself pawning will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A loan in a dream indicates maintaining family ties and kindness. Whoever sees himself giving a loan is being kind to people.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A loan indicates worry. Whoever sees himself taking a loan will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A loan is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself giving a loan will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Bankruptcy in a dream indicates a deficiency in religion or worldly life. It indicates poverty and need.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Bankruptcy indicates a bad situation. Whoever sees himself bankrupt, his situation will worsen.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Bankruptcy is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself bankrupt will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A partnership in a dream indicates sustenance and benefit if it is in goodness. If it is in evil, it is worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A partnership indicates marriage or travel. Whoever sees himself partnering with someone will be blessed with a child.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A partnership is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself in a partnership will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Sponsorship in a dream indicates commitment to a debt or trust. Whoever sees himself sponsoring someone is taking on a responsibility.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Sponsorship indicates worry and grief. Whoever sees himself sponsoring an orphan will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Sponsorship is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself sponsoring will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Testimony in a dream indicates paying off a debt or fulfilling a trust. False testimony indicates lying and misguidance.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Testimony indicates exaltation and position. Whoever sees himself testifying to the truth, his status will rise.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Testimony is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself testifying will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with an arrow) A bullet in a dream indicates hurtful and harmful speech, or a messenger with bad news. Being hit by it indicates falling into harm or hearing what one dislikes.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A bullet indicates the quick fulfillment of a need or reaching a goal quickly. It may indicate a sudden worry.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A bullet is interpreted as swift news. If it hits its target, the news will come true. If it misses, it will not.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with a weapon) A pistol in a dream indicates power, protection, and strength. Carrying it indicates gaining power or a position. Firing it indicates decisive speech or a dispute.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A pistol indicates a man of might and power. It may indicate a male child.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A pistol is interpreted as power and victory. Whoever sees himself carrying one will gain power and victory.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with a weapon and spear) A rifle in a dream indicates power and authority. Carrying it indicates gaining a position or exaltation. Hunting with it indicates striving to seek livelihood.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A rifle indicates a strong, brave man. It may indicate a male child.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A rifle is interpreted as power, victory, and triumph over enemies. Whoever sees himself shooting with it is speaking influential words.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with a weapon and thunder) A cannon in a dream indicates an oppressive ruler or a great war. Its sound indicates strife and fear.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A cannon indicates tremendous news or wide fame.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A cannon is interpreted as worry and fear. Whoever sees himself hearing its sound will be afflicted with fear.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with a weapon and fortress) A tank in a dream indicates impenetrable power and a strong ruler. Riding it indicates gaining a position and protection. Destroying it indicates defeating an enemy.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A tank indicates a strong army or an impenetrable fortress. Seeing it indicates power and strength.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A tank is interpreted as power and victory. Whoever sees himself riding one will gain power and victory.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with fire and thunderbolt) A bomb in a dream indicates great strife or sudden bad news. Its explosion indicates the occurrence of a calamity or scandal.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A bomb indicates ugly speech and slander that causes strife. Carrying it indicates striving for strife.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A bomb is interpreted as worry and fear. Whoever sees one exploding will be afflicted with worry and fear.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: War in a dream indicates high prices, strife, or an epidemic. War between two kings indicates great strife. War between the subjects and the king indicates low prices.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: War indicates dispute and effort. Victory in it is victory in wakefulness. Fleeing from it indicates falling into strife.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: War is interpreted as dispute and strife. Whoever sees himself in a war is in a dispute.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Peace in a dream indicates security, reconciliation, and the end of enmity. Making peace with an enemy indicates reconciliation with him.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Peace indicates good tidings and goodness. Whoever sees himself greeting people with peace will receive good from them.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Peace is interpreted as goodness and security. Whoever sees himself greeting someone with peace will attain goodness and security.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A handshake in a dream indicates reconciliation, affection, and a pact. Shaking hands with an enemy indicates reconciliation with him.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A handshake indicates an oath of allegiance or a partnership. Whoever sees himself shaking hands with a man is partnering with him in a matter.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A handshake is interpreted as goodness and benefit. Whoever sees himself shaking hands with someone will receive good from him.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A hug in a dream indicates long life and love. Hugging a dead person indicates long life. Hugging an enemy indicates reconciliation.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A hug indicates sharing in good times and bad. Whoever sees himself hugging a woman is attached to the world.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A hug is interpreted as goodness and love. Whoever sees himself hugging someone will have a long life.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A kiss in a dream indicates fulfillment of a need and victory over an enemy. Kissing a dead person indicates receiving good from their knowledge or money. Kissing the ruler indicates gaining a position.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A kiss indicates connection, affection, and goodness. A kiss with desire indicates seeking the world. Whoever sees himself kissing a boy will fall into enmity with his father.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A kiss is interpreted as goodness and benefit. Kissing a hand indicates humility. Kissing the ground indicates fulfilling a need from a great man.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A school in a dream indicates a place of knowledge and scholars. Entering it indicates seeking knowledge and guidance. Sitting in it indicates sitting with scholars.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A school indicates a wife or a child. Whoever sees himself building a school will be blessed with a scholarly child.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A school is interpreted as goodness and benefit. Whoever sees himself learning in it will attain goodness and knowledge.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with school and knowledge) A university in a dream indicates a high scholarly rank or a gathering of scholars. Entering it indicates seeking higher knowledge or striving for a great matter.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A university indicates a rise in status and attaining a prestigious position in knowledge or work.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A university is interpreted as goodness and exaltation. Whoever sees himself graduating from it has completed a matter successfully.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A book in a dream indicates strength, relief, and joy. A book in the right hand is true testimony and a good deed. A book in the left hand is regret for an ugly deed. Whoever sees himself reading a book he doesn't understand will receive an inheritance.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A book indicates good news and companionship. A folded book indicates the approach of one's end or a hidden matter. Reading a book indicates gaining knowledge, wisdom, and guidance.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A book is interpreted as a believing man or a righteous woman. Tearing a book indicates the loss of knowledge, religion, or money. Whoever sees himself being given a book will receive a position or be given a trust.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A library in a dream indicates knowledge, wisdom, and sitting with scholars. Entering it indicates seeking knowledge. Buying books from it indicates gaining beneficial knowledge.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A library indicates a scholarly man or a righteous woman. Sitting in it indicates guidance and righteousness.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A library is interpreted as goodness and benefit. Whoever sees himself owning one will gain vast knowledge.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: An exam in a dream indicates a test from God Almighty. If one succeeds in it, it indicates the strength of his faith and patience. If he fails, it indicates his weakness.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: An exam indicates worry and hardship. Succeeding in it is relief and salvation. Failing in it indicates falling into hardship.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: An exam is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself being examined will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Success in a dream indicates achieving one's goal and fulfilling wishes. It indicates triumph and victory.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Success indicates relief after hardship and ease after difficulty.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Success is interpreted as goodness and joy. Whoever sees himself succeeding will attain goodness and joy.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Failure in a dream indicates failure, disappointment, and difficulty in affairs.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Failure indicates falling into hardship and worry. It indicates loss.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Failure is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself failing will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with a book and success) A graduation certificate in a dream indicates completing a matter successfully and achieving one's goal. It is good tidings of goodness and exaltation.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A graduation certificate indicates a position, rank, or beneficial knowledge.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A graduation certificate is interpreted as goodness and joy. Whoever sees himself receiving one will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with writing and knowledge) Homework in a dream indicates a responsibility or a trust. Completing it indicates fulfilling the trust. Not completing it indicates negligence.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) Homework indicates worry and fatigue in seeking knowledge or livelihood.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) Homework is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself doing it is in worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Cheating in an exam in a dream indicates cunning, deceit, and not being prepared for matters.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Cheating indicates committing a sin or following a false path.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Cheating is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself cheating will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) Expulsion from school in a dream indicates failure in seeking knowledge or abandoning the path of guidance.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) Expulsion indicates removal from a position or separation from a beloved matter.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) Expulsion is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself being expelled will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A hospital in a dream indicates the removal of worries and recovery from illnesses. For the sick, it is recovery, and for the healthy, it is repentance.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A hospital indicates the house of the ruler or the judge. Entering it indicates seeking a need.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A hospital is interpreted as relief. Whoever sees himself entering it, God will relieve his worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A nurse in a dream indicates a righteous woman who helps in goodness and removes worries.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A nurse indicates good tidings and imminent relief.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A nurse is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself speaking to her will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with a wound and healing) A surgical operation in a dream indicates the uncovering of a hidden matter or the correction of a corrupt situation. Its success indicates the righteousness of the matter, and its failure indicates its corruption.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A surgical operation indicates the removal of worry and recovery from illness after fatigue.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A surgical operation is interpreted as relief. Whoever sees himself undergoing one, God will relieve his worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with medicine) An injection in a dream indicates goodness and benefit that comes quickly. If it is painful, it is a benefit with fatigue.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) An injection indicates the fulfillment of a need or recovery from illness.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) An injection is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself receiving one will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with uncovering matters) An X-ray in a dream indicates the uncovering of a hidden matter or learning the truth of an illness.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) An X-ray indicates searching for the truth. Whoever sees himself undergoing one is searching for a matter.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) An X-ray is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself undergoing one is in worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with inability and a chair) A wheelchair in a dream indicates inability, weakness, or an illness that prevents movement. It may indicate a position where one depends on others.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A wheelchair indicates worry, grief, and restriction of movement.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A wheelchair is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself sitting in one will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with a staff) A crutch in a dream indicates a man who is relied upon or a son who is leaned on. Leaning on it indicates dependence on others.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A crutch indicates long life. It may indicate travel.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A crutch is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself leaning on one will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with a wound) A bandage in a dream indicates concealing a matter and hiding it. Applying it indicates trying to fix a corrupt matter.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A bandage indicates the removal of worry and healing. Removing it indicates the uncovering of the matter.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A bandage is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself applying one will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with a fracture) A cast in a dream indicates fixing a corrupt matter or mending a broken heart (comforting someone). Wearing it indicates patience and endurance.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A cast indicates a man who reconciles people. Removing it indicates the removal of worry and healing.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A cast is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees one on himself will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with a vehicle and illness) An ambulance in a dream indicates imminent relief and salvation from hardship or illness.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) An ambulance indicates a man who strives to fulfill people's needs.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) An ambulance is interpreted as relief. Whoever sees himself riding in one, God will relieve his worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with medicine and healing) A pharmacy in a dream indicates a place of healing and removal of worries. Entering it indicates seeking healing or advice.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A pharmacy indicates a scholarly man or a wise doctor.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A pharmacy is interpreted as goodness and healing. Whoever sees himself entering one will attain goodness and healing.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with writing and medicine) A prescription in a dream indicates beneficial advice or useful knowledge that leads to healing and righteousness.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A prescription indicates a solution to a problem or a way out of hardship.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A prescription is interpreted as goodness and benefit. Whoever sees himself receiving one will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with fever and scales) A thermometer in a dream indicates anxiety and worry, or a test of one's condition. Its rise indicates hardship, and its fall indicates weakness.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A thermometer indicates a man who distinguishes between matters.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A thermometer is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself using one is in worry and anxiety.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Travel in a dream indicates revealing people's characters. If one travels returning, he repents from his sins. If he travels to a better place, his condition improves. If he travels to a worse place, his condition worsens. For the sick, travel indicates death.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Travel indicates moving from one state to another. For the rich, it is poverty, and for the poor, it is wealth (one of the opposites). Returning from travel indicates fulfilling rights and repentance.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Travel is interpreted as a change in condition. If the travel is to a known place, he will attain goodness. If it is to an unknown place, it is worry or death.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Returning from travel in a dream indicates repentance from sins, fulfillment of a need, or salvation from hardships. It is relief and the end of worry.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Returning from travel indicates fulfilling rights and duties. It indicates relief after distress.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Returning from travel is interpreted as goodness and benefit. Whoever sees himself returning from his travel will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A farewell in a dream indicates separation between spouses or partners. It may indicate death for the sick.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A farewell indicates the return of a divorced woman to her husband. It may indicate the loss of a position.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A farewell is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself bidding farewell to someone will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Estrangement in a dream indicates wealth for the poor. Returning from it indicates repentance and salvation.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Estrangement indicates a change in condition. It may indicate death.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Estrangement is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself as a stranger will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Lying down in a dream indicates rest and idleness. Lying on the back indicates mastery of the world. Lying on the stomach indicates loss of money and loss.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Lying down indicates illness or heedlessness. For the fearful, it is security.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Lying down is interpreted as heedlessness. Whoever sees himself lying down is in a state of heedlessness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Washing a dead person in a dream indicates the repentance of a corrupt man at the hands of the dreamer. Whoever sees himself washing a dead person will be saved from worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Washing a dead person indicates paying off their debt or executing their will. Whoever sees himself being washed while alive, it indicates the removal of his worry and his salvation.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Washing the dead is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself washing a dead person will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A tiger in a dream indicates an unjust ruler or a strong enemy with open hostility. Riding one indicates gaining authority. Eating its meat indicates gaining wealth and honor. Fighting it indicates fighting a strong enemy.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A tiger indicates a strong, unjust man or a hateful enemy. Seeing it indicates fear of the ruler. A tigress is a wicked woman.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A tiger is interpreted as a strong enemy. Whoever sees himself fighting it is disputing with a strong enemy. Whoever sees himself eating its meat will gain money from his enemy.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A leopard in a dream indicates a fickle, hypocritical man who shows affection but conceals enmity. Riding it indicates glory, exaltation, and marrying a bad woman.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A leopard indicates glory and leadership. Whoever fights one is fighting a noble man. Whoever gets its skin or hair will gain money from an enemy.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A leopard is interpreted as a man of great status. He is a spiteful enemy. Whoever sees himself riding one will gain glory and authority.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with strong, horned animals) It may indicate a strong king or a man of might, power, and authority. Its horn indicates his strength and weapon.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It indicates a strong, solitary man, or a ruler with prestige and power, who may be unjust.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as a strong, brave man, or an enemy who is difficult to deal with. Fighting it indicates a severe confrontation.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The giraffe indicates a beautiful, graceful woman, or good news coming from afar.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The giraffe indicates long life or the occurrence of a wondrous event. Whoever owns one will marry a beautiful woman of high status.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: It is interpreted as a beautiful woman. Whoever sees himself riding one will attain exaltation.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A monkey in a dream is a poor, deprived man whose blessing has been stripped away. He indicates a cunning, deceitful man. Whoever turns into a monkey has committed a major sin.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A monkey indicates a Jewish man or a cursed enemy. Arguing with it indicates illness.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A monkey is interpreted as a cursed enemy. Its bite indicates a dispute or illness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A bear in a dream indicates a foolish man of great might, or a woman of bad character. Riding it indicates gaining a position or fear of a ruler.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A bear indicates strife, evil, or a large, wicked man.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A bear is interpreted as a strong, brave, foolish man, or a treacherous thief.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A whale in a dream indicates a minister, a prison, or worry. Whoever sees a whale in the sea, it indicates a great event will happen. Being swallowed by it indicates poverty or prison (story of Jonah).

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A whale indicates a righteous man or a mosque. Whoever sees himself in the belly of the whale will be saved from worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A whale is interpreted as worry and grief. Whoever sees himself catching one will gain sustenance.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with large fish and predators) A shark may indicate a strong, dangerous enemy in the water (symbol of the world or authority), or great sustenance that comes with risk.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate a man of authority, power, and might, or a dangerous thief.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as a strong enemy or looming danger. Escaping from it is salvation from evil.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with sea creatures and number) An octopus, with its many arms, may indicate a man of cunning and guile, involved in many matters or having many followers and aides. It may indicate tangled and complex issues.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate a strong, difficult man whom people cling to for their needs, or an enemy with widespread harm.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as a man with many

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with fish and play) A dolphin may indicate a peaceful man who loves good, or it indicates good news and tidings coming from the direction of the water (travel or trade).

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A dolphin may indicate salvation from drowning or hardships, or a loyal friend who helps in crises.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A dolphin is interpreted as goodness, salvation, and joy.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: An empty grave may indicate a prison without a prisoner, or a worry that will disappear, or a matter that will not be completed.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: An empty grave may indicate an empty house or a marriage that will not happen.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: An empty grave is interpreted as worry that dissipates or false hope.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Burial in a dream indicates a long journey, prison, or marriage. Whoever sees himself being buried alive will be imprisoned or afflicted with great worry.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Burying a dead person indicates paying off their debt or following their way. Burying a living person indicates overpowering and oppressing them.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Burial is interpreted as worry and prison. Whoever sees himself burying something is hiding a secret or money.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Lying in a dream indicates false testimony, misguidance, and corruption in religion. Whoever sees himself lying will fail in his argument and lose.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Lying indicates poverty and need. Whoever sees himself lying against God has disbelieved.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Lying is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself lying will be afflicted with worry and humiliation.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Betrayal in a dream indicates poverty and humiliation. Betrayal of a trust indicates corruption in religion.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Betrayal indicates adultery or theft. Whoever sees himself betraying is committing a sin.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Betrayal is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself betraying will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Injustice in a dream indicates the ruin of homes and the loss of blessings. Whoever sees himself committing injustice will become poor. Whoever sees himself being wronged will be victorious over his oppressor.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Injustice indicates associating partners with God (shirk). It indicates worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Injustice is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself committing injustice will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
