interpretations.text: Justice in a dream indicates righteousness in religion and worldly life, and salvation from injustice. Whoever sees himsel judging justly between people will gain exaltation and a position.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Justice indicates following the truth. It indicates security and prosperity.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Justice is interpreted as goodness and blessing. Whoever sees himself being just will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Pardoning in a dream indicates forgiveness, long life, and salvation from torment. Whoever sees himself pardoning someone who wronged him will receive a great reward.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Pardoning indicates piety and righteousness. It indicates relief and the end of worry.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Pardoning is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself pardoning will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Revenge in a dream indicates victory over enemies and triumphing over them.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Revenge indicates the end of worry and the fulfillment of a need.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Revenge is interpreted as triumph. Whoever sees himself taking revenge will triumph over his enemy.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Gray hair in a dream is dignity, prestige, and long life. It may indicate poverty and worry. Graying of the beard is better than graying of the head.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Gray hair indicates weakness of condition or the arrival of an absent person. Plucking it indicates opposing the Sunnah.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Gray hair is interpreted as dignity. Whoever sees his hair has turned gray will gain dignity.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Baldness in a dream for a man is the loss of wealth and prestige. For a woman, it is a calamity concerning her husband or a scandal.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Baldness indicates worry and grief from one's superior. Whoever sees himself bald will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Baldness is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself bald will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Paralysis in a dream indicates disruption of affairs and corruption in religion. Paralysis of the right hand indicates injustice, and the left indicates the death of a brother or sister.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Paralysis indicates committing a great sin that warrants punishment. It indicates worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Paralysis is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself paralyzed will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with malignant diseases) Cancer in a dream may indicate severe worry, a malignancy in religion or body, or a hidden enemy consuming the dreamer.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate unlawful money that corrupts its owner's life, or great strife, or long-lasting sorrow.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as worry, grief, and illness. Recovery from it indicates the end of worry and repentance.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Diarrhea in a dream indicates extravagance in spending money. If it has a foul smell, it is spending on forbidden things.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Diarrhea indicates the end of worry and recovery from illness.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Diarrhea is interpreted as money. Whoever sees himself having it will lose money.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Constipation in a dream indicates stinginess, miserliness, and difficulty in affairs.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Constipation indicates worry and grief. Whoever sees himself having it, his affairs will become difficult.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Constipation is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself having it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A beautiful voice in a dream indicates good tidings, joy, and exaltation. An ugly voice indicates worry, grief, and bad news.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A voice indicates reputation and mention. A loud voice indicates strength and victory.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A voice is interpreted as news. If good, it is good news; if ugly, it is bad news.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Shortness of breath in a dream indicates worry, grief, and hardship. Ease of breath indicates relief and comfort.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Breath indicates life and spirit. Its cessation indicates death.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Shortness of breath is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself breathing with difficulty will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with a purse and money) A wallet in a dream indicates a place for keeping money or secrets. Its fullness indicates wealth, and its emptiness indicates poverty. Losing it indicates loss of money or exposure of a secret.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A wallet indicates a wife or a trustworthy servant. It may indicate a child.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A wallet is interpreted as goodness and sustenance. Whoever sees himself finding one will gain sustenance.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: An earring in a dream for a woman is adornment and marriage. If it is of pearl, it is knowledge and the Quran. For a man, it indicates trade or hearing singing.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: An earring indicates a male child. Whoever sees an earring in his ear will be blessed with a son or learn knowledge.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: An earring is interpreted as goodness and adornment. Whoever sees himself wearing one will attain goodness and adornment.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Thread in a dream indicates proof and evidence. White thread is dawn, and black thread is night. Tying a thread indicates completing a matter or magic.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Thread indicates intimacy and connection. Thread in a needle indicates little sustenance.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Thread is interpreted as sustenance. Whoever sees himself spinning it will gain sustenance.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A button in a dream indicates a wife or a servant. Attachingit indicates marriage. It falling off indicates divorce.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A button indicates a child. Whoever sees his buttons fall off, his children will die.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A button is interpreted as money. Whoever sees himself attaching one will gain money.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A belt in a dream indicates resolve and determination in matters. Tightening it indicates preparing for a journey or an important matter.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A belt indicates a child or a servant. Whoever sees himself tightening his belt, his affair will become strong.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A belt is interpreted as money. Whoever sees himself wearing one will gain money.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with a cap and turban) A hat in a dream indicates exaltation, prestige, and authority, or a husband. Its beauty indicates a good situation. Its falling indicates loss of position or worry.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A hat indicates travel, marriage, or protection. Wearing it indicates achieving one's goal.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A hat is interpreted as prestige and position. Whoever sees himself wearing one, his status will rise.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A sash in a dream indicates adornment and prestige. For a woman, it is a husband, and for a man, a child or a position.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A sash indicates honor and exaltation. Whoever sees himself wearing one will gain glory.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A sash is interpreted as goodness and position. Whoever sees himself wearing one will gain a position.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Gloves in a dream indicate protection and preservation. They are a servant or money.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Gloves indicate a man who is relied upon in matters. Wearing them indicates strength and power.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Gloves are interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself wearing them will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Socks in a dream are a man's wealth and his protection. New socks indicate preserving wealth. Torn ones indicate its loss.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Socks indicate a servant or a woman. Their good smell indicates good praise.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Socks are interpreted as money. Whoever sees himself wearing them will gain money.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: An umbrella in a dream is a ruler or a man of high status to whom people resort. Taking shelter under it indicates gaining protection and benefit.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: An umbrella indicates protection from harm. For the traveler, it is a return, and for the fearful, it is security.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: An umbrella is interpreted as a noble man. Whoever sees himself taking shelter under it will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with a ship) A boat in a dream is salvation for one who is in hardship or worry. Riding it indicates following guidance or travel. Its sinking is a calamity.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A boat indicates a wife, a child, or a short journey.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A boat is interpreted as salvation and relief. Riding it indicates emerging from worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with riding and moving) A bicycle in a dream indicates striving for a worldly matter. Its speed indicates the speed of achieving the goal. Falling off it indicates stumbling and failure.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A bicycle indicates a change in condition or a short journey.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A bicycle is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself riding one will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with the eye and insight) Glasses in a dream indicate an increase in insight or clarity of matters. They may indicate a child or money. Breaking them indicates loss of insight or a loss.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) Glasses indicate guidance and knowledge. Wearing them indicates following the truth.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) Glasses are interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself wearing them will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with glasses and the eye) Contact lenses in a dream indicate an attempt to see matters clearly or change one's perspective on them. They may indicate beautifying one's appearance or hiding a truth.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) They may indicate sharp insight or hidden knowledge. Losing them indicates confusion and being lost.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) They are interpreted as worry and anxiety about a matter.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Cooking in a dream indicates managing affairs and striving for livelihood. Cooking good food indicates gaining lawful sustenance and benefit. Cooking what is not eaten indicates striving for falsehood.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Cooking indicates fulfilling needs and achieving goals. Whoever sees himself cooking will get what he wishes.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Cooking is interpreted as goodness and benefit. Whoever sees himself cooking will attain goodness and sustenance.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Baking bread in a dream indicates striving to seek a livelihood. If one bakes good bread, his life will be good. If one bakes bad bread, his life will be miserable.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Baking bread indicates gaining wealth and knowledge according to the quality of the bread.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Baking bread is interpreted as goodness and striving for sustenance. Whoever sees himself baking will gain sustenance.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with sweeping and washing) Cleaning in a dream indicates the end of worries and troubles, repentance from sins, and righteousness.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) Cleaning indicates relief after hardship and recovery from illness. Cleaning the house indicates the righteousness of its people.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) Cleaning is interpreted as goodness and blessing. Whoever sees himself cleaning, his affairs will be rectified and his worry will vanish.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Arranging things in a dream indicates organizing affairs and managing livelihood. Arranging the house indicates the righteousness of the wife and her good management.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Arranging indicates emerging from chaos and confusion. It indicates righteousness.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Arranging is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself arranging something, his affairs will be rectified.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Watering plants or trees in a dream indicates marriage, raising children, or performing a good deed. Watering people indicates kindness to them and spreading knowledge.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Watering indicates fulfilling needs and gaining sustenance. Whoever sees himself watering a thirsty person, God will relieve his worry.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Watering is interpreted as goodness and benefit. Whoever sees himself watering will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with instruments of amusement) Playing music in a dream indicates amusement, falsehood, and empty talk. It may indicate a calamity if it is at a funeral.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) Playing music may indicate hearing news. If the music is beautiful, it is good news; if it is ugly, it is bad news.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) Playing music is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself playing music will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Listening in a dream indicates accepting truth or falsehood depending on what is being listened to. Listening to the Quran is guidance, and to singing is amusement and falsehood.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Listening indicates obedience and following. Whoever sees himself listening to advice is being guided.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Listening to good is interpreted as good, and to evil as evil. Whoever sees himself listening to good words will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Looking in a dream indicates contemplation and reflection. Looking at the sky indicates ambition and exaltation. Looking at what God has forbidden indicates committing a sin.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Looking indicates insight. Whoever sees himself looking with the light of God has received guidance.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Looking is interpreted as good if it is at what is lawful, and as evil if it is at what is forbidden.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Touching in a dream indicates marriage or connection. Touching what is not lawful indicates committing a sin.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Touching indicates achieving one's goal. Whoever sees himself touching something will attain it.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Touching is interpreted as good if it is rightful, and as evil if it is false.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Smelling good scents in a dream indicates good praise, joy, and healing. Smelling foul odors indicates ugly praise, worry, and illness.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Smelling indicates hearing news. A good scent is good news, and a bad one is bad news.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Smelling is interpreted as news. Whoever sees himself smelling a good scent will hear good news.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Tasting food in a dream indicates testing matters. Sweet indicates good, bitter indicates evil, and sour indicates worry.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Tasting indicates experience and knowledge. Whoever sees himself tasting something is experiencing a matter.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Tasting is interpreted as experience. Whoever sees himself tasting will gain experience in a matter.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Getting lost in a dream indicates confusion and misguidance in religion or worldly life. Losing one's way indicates following falsehood.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Getting lost indicates unemployment and poverty. Losing something indicates losing it in wakefulness.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Getting lost is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself lost will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Searching for something in a dream indicates striving to seek it. If one finds it, he achieves his goal. If one does not find it, his affair will be difficult.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Searching indicates eagerness for the world. Whoever sees himself searching for something is eager for it.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Searching is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself searching is in worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Hiding in a dream indicates fear and salvation from enemies. Whoever sees himself hiding is safe from what he fears.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Hiding indicates keeping secrets. It may indicate cunning and deceit.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Hiding is interpreted as salvation. Whoever sees himself hiding will be saved from worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Escaping in a dream indicates salvation and security from fear. Escaping from death indicates the approach of one's end.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Escaping indicates repentance and returning to God. It may indicate gaining a position.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Escaping is interpreted as salvation. Whoever sees himself escaping will be saved from worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Chasing in a dream indicates dispute and striving for a matter. If the chaser wins, he achieves his goal. If he is defeated, he loses.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Chasing indicates fear and hardship. Whoever sees himself chasing an enemy will triumph over him.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Chasing is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself chasing is in worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Hunting in a dream is spoils and sustenance. Hunting on land indicates spoils from land, and hunting at sea indicates spoils from the sea. Hunting with cunning indicates gaining sustenance with cunning.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Hunting indicates striving to seek livelihood. Whoever sees himself hunting will gain sustenance.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Hunting is interpreted as goodness and benefit. Whoever sees himself hunting will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Slaughtering in a dream indicates injustice, disobedience to parents, and cutting family ties. Slaughtering what is lawful to slaughter indicates honoring parents or performing Hajj. Slaughtering a son indicates gaining wealth.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Slaughtering indicates marriage. Whoever sees himself slaughtering an animal will triumph over his enemy.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Slaughtering is interpreted as good if it is for what is lawful. Whoever sees himself slaughtering himself has repented sincerely.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Calling out in a dream indicates enjoining good and forbidding evil. Calling from a distant place indicates heedlessness. Calling from a nearby place indicates a warning.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Calling out indicates fame and mention. Whoever hears a good call will receive good praise.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Calling out is interpreted as news. If good, it is good news; if ugly, it is bad news.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Visiting in a dream indicates intimacy, love, and maintaining family ties. Visiting the sick indicates recovery. Visiting a prisoner indicates relief.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Visiting indicates fulfilling needs. Visiting graves indicates admonition.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Visiting is interpreted as goodness and benefit. Whoever sees himself visiting someone will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Anger in a dream indicates prison, illness, or loss of money. God's anger indicates His anger in wakefulness. Parents' anger indicates disobedience to them.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Anger indicates worry and grief. Whoever sees himself angry will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Anger is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself angry will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Anxiety in a dream indicates instability of affairs, confusion, and hesitation.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Anxiety indicates fear of the future or waiting for something.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Anxiety is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself anxious will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Hope in a dream indicates long life and hope in God's mercy. It indicates the fulfillment of wishes.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Hope indicates relief after hardship. Whoever sees himself hoping for something will attain it.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Hope is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself hoping will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Despair in a dream indicates despairing of God's mercy. It indicates failure and disappointment.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Despair indicates worry and grief. Whoever sees himself despairing will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Despair is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself despairing will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Life in a dream after death indicates wealth after poverty, or repentance after sin, or relief after hardship.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Life indicates righteousness in religion and worldly life. Whoever sees himself alive will have a long life.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Life is interpreted as goodness and blessing. Whoever sees himself alive will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The rooftop of a house in a dream indicates a woman of high status. Ascending it indicates attaining exaltation because of a woman. Falling from it indicates separating from her.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The rooftop indicates position and prestige. An unknown rooftop indicates travel.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A rooftop is interpreted as exaltation. Whoever sees himself on a rooftop will attain exaltation.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with rooftop and window) A balcony in a dream indicates exaltation and awareness of matters. It may indicate a woman showing her adornment. Standing on it indicates waiting for news.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A balcony indicates prestige and fame. Falling from it indicates loss of prestige or a scandal.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A balcony is interpreted as goodness and exaltation. Whoever sees himself on it will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with a road) A street in a dream indicates striving to seek livelihood or religion. A wide, straight street indicates truth and abundant sustenance, and a narrow, crooked one indicates misguidance and hardship.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A street indicates the state of the people. A clean street indicates their righteousness, and a dirty one indicates their corruption.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A street is interpreted as work and striving. Walking in it indicates striving for a matter.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with trees and desert) A forest in a dream indicates strife or a group of people gathered for a matter. Entering it indicates entering strife. Exiting it is salvation.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A forest indicates a dangerous place or an unjust ruler. Getting lost in it indicates confusion and fear.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A forest is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself in it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with land and agriculture) A farm in a dream indicates the world and striving in it. A green farm indicates a good deed and lawful sustenance. A dry one indicates a false deed.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A farm indicates a wife or a child. Whoever sees himself owning a farm will attain goodness and sustenance.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A farm is interpreted as goodness and blessing. Whoever sees himself in it will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with a maker and work) A factory in a dream indicates a place of work and striving for livelihood. Working in it indicates toil and fatigue in seeking a living.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A factory indicates a man who manages many affairs. Entering it indicates starting a project.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A factory is interpreted as worry and fatigue. Whoever sees himself working in it will be afflicted with fatigue.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with a maker and factory) A workshop in a dream indicates a place of work and sustenance. Working in it indicates striving to seek lawful (halal) sustenance.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A workshop indicates a man who is diligent in his work.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A workshop is interpreted as goodness and sustenance. Whoever sees himself in it will gain sustenance.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with the sea and the ship) A harbor in a dream indicates safety and salvation after travel or hardship. Arriving at it indicates achieving goals.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A harbor indicates a place of sustenance and trade. It indicates relief and the end of worry.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A harbor is interpreted as goodness and security. Whoever sees himself in it is safe from his fear.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with the train and travel) A train station in a dream indicates waiting for travel or a change in condition. Crowding in it indicates many preoccupations.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A train station indicates the world and its stages. Arriving at it indicates the beginning of a new stage.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A train station is interpreted as worry and waiting. Whoever sees himself in it is in worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with the church and the mosque) A temple in a dream may indicate a place of worship or a place of heresy and misguidance, depending on the dreamer's condition and what happens in the temple.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A temple indicates a scholar or an ascetic man. Entering it may indicate guidance or misguidance.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A temple is interpreted as worry if it is for non-Muslims. If it is for Muslims, it is good.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Daytime in a dream indicates the appearance of truth, the uncovering of matters, and relief after hardship. It indicates religion and guidance.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Daytime indicates the king or the just ruler. Its brightness indicates his justice.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Daytime is interpreted as relief and joy. Whoever sees himself in the daytime, his worry will vanish.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Night in a dream indicates stillness and rest. It may indicate disbelief, misguidance, and worry. A moonlit night indicates joy.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Night indicates unemployment and disruption. For the worried, it is rest, and for the traveler, it is fatigue.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Night is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself in the night will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Dawn in a dream indicates relief, salvation, and the beginning of a new matter. It indicates guidance after misguidance.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Dawn indicates paying off debt and fulfilling a covenant. It indicates righteousness and piety.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Dawn is interpreted as relief and joy. Whoever sees the dawn break, God will relieve his worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Sunset in a dream indicates the end of a matter or the approach of one's end. It indicates the death of the sick or the dismissal of the ruler.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Sunset indicates the completion of work. It may indicate worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Sunset is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees the sun setting will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Time in a dream indicates the setting of matters and waiting for them. Knowing the time indicates managing matters.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Time indicates one's lifespan. Its passing indicates that time has run out.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Time is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself asking for the time is in worry and anxiety.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Colors in a dream have different meanings depending on the color and context. White is righteousness and religion, black is sovereignty and money or worry, green is religion and fertility, yellow is illness, and red is strife or joy.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Colors indicate people's conditions and their deeds. Every color has its own interpretation.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Colors are interpreted according to their meaning in wakefulness and the dreamer's condition. Each color has its interpretation.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Numbers in a dream may indicate the number of years, money, or children. Each number has its own significance derived from the Quran, Sunnah, or custom.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Numbers indicate calculated and destined matters. They may indicate victory or loss depending on the number.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Numbers are interpreted according to their meaning. One indicates God, two indicates partnership, and so on.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Letters in a dream indicate meanings and secrets. Each letter has its own significance according to its shape and meaning.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Letters indicate knowledge and speech. Disjointed letters may indicate scattered matters.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Letters are interpreted according to their meaning. The letter Alif indicates intimacy, Ba indicates blessing, and so on.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Seeing a dream within a dream may be a reminder of a matter or a warning about it. Interpreting a dream within a dream may be true or false.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A dream within a dream indicates a postponed matter or distant wishes.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A dream is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself dreaming will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The color red in a dream indicates strife and war, or joy and happiness, depending on the context.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The color red indicates fame, death, or illness.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The color red is interpreted as joy and adornment for a woman, and as worry for a man.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The color green in a dream indicates religion, worship, fertility, and goodness.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The color green indicates a good life and martyrdom.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The color green is interpreted as goodness, blessing, and righteousness in religion.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The color blue in a dream indicates worry, grief, and calamity.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The color blue indicates strife and enmity.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The color blue is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself wearing it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The color yellow in a dream indicates illness, weakness, and worry.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The color yellow indicates worship and asceticism, or jealousy and illness.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The color yellow is interpreted as illness. Whoever sees himself wearing it will fall ill.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The color black in a dream is sovereignty and money for one who is used to wearing it, and for one who is not, it is worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The color black indicates sovereignty and exaltation, or calamity and sadness.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The color black is interpreted as money and sovereignty for one whom it suits, and as worry for one whom it does not.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The color white in a dream indicates righteousness in religion and worldly life, and beauty and splendor.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The color white indicates repentance, purity, and good deeds.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The color white is interpreted as goodness, blessing, and prestige.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The agony of death in a dream indicates worry and hardship, or committing a great sin.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The agony of death indicates heedlessness and distance from God.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The agony of death is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself in it will be afflicted with severe worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Answering in a dream indicates the acceptance of a prayer or obedience. Answering a call indicates responding to a command.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Answering indicates the fulfillment of needs and achieving one's goal.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Answering is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself answering will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Ascending to heaven in a dream indicates gaining authority and exaltation with danger and arrogance. If he does not return, he dies. If he ascends with a ladder, he gains security and exaltation.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Ascending to heaven indicates drawing closer to God or the ruler. For the sick, it is death.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Ascending to heaven is interpreted as exaltation and prestige. Whoever sees himself ascending will attain exaltation.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Descending from heaven indicates recovery for the sick after despair. It may indicate God's anger if one descends to a bad place.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Descending from heaven indicates the loss of a position or worry. If one descends upon goodness, it is good.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Descending from heaven is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself descending will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Singing with an ugly voice in a dream indicates a losing trade or false speech that is not heard.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Singing with an ugly voice indicates worry, grief, and scandal.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Singing with an ugly voice is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself singing with it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Singing with a beautiful voice in a dream indicates a profitable trade or a position and a word that is heard.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Singing with a beautiful voice indicates joy, good tidings, and good news.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Singing with a beautiful voice is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself singing with it will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Urine in a dream is unlawful money. Whoever urinates in an unknown place will marry from its people. Whoever urinates in a well will spend lawful money. Whoever urinates blood has cohabited with a menstruating woman.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Urine indicates sustenance or a child. Whoever urinates in a mosque will be blessed with a scholarly child. Whoever urinates on merchandise will lose in it.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Urine is interpreted as money. Whoever sees himself urinating will spend money.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Feces in a dream are money and sustenance. If it is in its usual place, it is lawful money. If it is in an unusual place, it is unlawful money or worry. Whoever defecates on himself has committed a sin.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Feces indicates relief, the end of worry, and the fulfillment of a need. It indicates money on which zakat (alms) is paid.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Feces is interpreted as money. Whoever sees himself defecating will spend money.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Passing wind in a dream indicates ugly speech or worry and grief. If it has a sound, it is worry with scandal. If it is silent, it is a minor worry.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Passing wind indicates relief from distress. It may indicate a false word.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Passing wind is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself passing wind will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Seeing one's father in a dream indicates achieving one's goal and fulfilling objectives. If one sees him sick, it indicates the dreamer's illness, and if one sees him dead, it indicates weakness and feebleness.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The father in a dream is the cause of existence, and seeing him indicates attaining what the dreamer wishes. The death of the father indicates weakness in one's condition and a change in affairs.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The father is interpreted as goodness, benefit, and the fulfillment of hopes. Whoever sees his father in the best condition, it indicates joy and happiness for the dreamer.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Seeing one's mother in a dream is more significant in interpretation than the father, and it indicates compassion, mercy, and relief. Seeing her alive indicates approaching goodness, and seeing her dead may indicate worries or the dreamer's death.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The mother indicates the earth, a farm, or a fruitful tree. Seeing her indicates relief from worries. Her death indicates the corruption of the world and the loss of chivalry.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The mother is interpreted as compassion and mercy. Whoever sees her happy will attain goodness and joy. Whoever sees her sad will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A brother in a dream indicates sharing in wealth or livelihood. Seeing him indicates strength and severity. His illness indicates weakness, and his death indicates the death of an enemy or health.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A brother indicates support and help. Seeing him indicates joy and benefit.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A brother is interpreted as a partner or a friend. Whoever sees himself arguing with him will part with his partner.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A sister in a dream indicates sharing in goodness and sustenance. Seeing her indicates joy, happiness, and the arrival of an absent person.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A sister indicates intimacy and love. Her death indicates the death of an enemy or weakness.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A sister is interpreted as goodness and benefit. Whoever sees her will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A son in a dream indicates a weak enemy or worry. If he is young, it is worry; if he is grown, it is strength and support.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A son indicates sustenance and money. His death indicates salvation from an enemy.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A son is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees that he has a son will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A daughter in a dream indicates relief, abundance, and sustenance after hardship.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A daughter indicates a world approaching with goodness. Her death indicates despair of relief.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A daughter is interpreted as relief and joy. Whoever sees that he has a daughter will attain relief.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Seeing one's husband in a dream indicates the partner in life or work. Whatever happens to him reflects on his partner or work. If she sees him sick, it indicates her partner's illness or difficulty in her work.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The husband indicates what a person finds comfort in, be it work or status. Seeing him in a good state indicates a good state of affairs.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The husband is interpreted as goodness and benefit. Seeing him happy indicates joy for the female dreamer.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A wife in a dream indicates a partner, a friend, or an enemy, depending on her state in the dream. An unknown wife indicates the approach of one's end. Whoever marries a wife and she dies is striving for a matter that will not be completed.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A wife indicates authority, a partner, or an enemy. Seeing her beautiful indicates a fertile year. Seeing her ugly indicates a year of drought.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A wife is interpreted as joy and benefit. Whoever sees himself marrying will attain goodness and exaltation.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A grandfather in a dream indicates diligence, fatigue, and striving in matters. Seeing him alive indicates long life and good fortune.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A grandfather indicates luck and sustenance. Seeing him indicates blessing in life and work.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A grandfather is interpreted as goodness and benefit. Whoever sees his grandfather will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A grandmother in a dream indicates the world or asceticism in it. Seeing her alive indicates fertility and a good life.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A grandmother indicates the end of worries and relief. Seeing her indicates blessing.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A grandmother is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees her will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A paternal uncle in a dream indicates what a person relies on and leans on. Seeing him indicates strength and power.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A paternal uncle indicates exaltation and status. Whoever sees his paternal uncle will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A paternal uncle is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself speaking to him will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A paternal aunt in a dream indicates joy and happiness. Seeing her indicates goodness and benefit.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A paternal aunt indicates blessing and sustenance. Whoever sees her will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A paternal aunt is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees her will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A maternal uncle in a dream indicates comfort and reassurance. Seeing him indicates the fulfillment of wishes.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A maternal uncle indicates support and help. Whoever sees his maternal uncle will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A maternal uncle is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself speaking to him will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A maternal aunt in a dream is like a mother, and she indicates compassion, mercy, and goodness.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A maternal aunt indicates relief and joy. Whoever sees her, his worry will vanish.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A maternal aunt is interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees her will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with drinks and gatherings) Coffee in a dream may indicate evening gatherings and socializing, or an awakening from heedlessness. Drinking it may indicate worries or activity, depending on the dreamer's condition and the context.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) Coffee may indicate striving for a matter or receiving guests. Serving it indicates generosity or seeking a need.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) Coffee is interpreted as worry and grief, sometimes because of its color or bitterness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with drinks) Tea in a dream may indicate rest and relaxation or receiving guests. Drinking it may indicate the end of fatigue or the beginning of a relationship.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) Tea may indicate good news or a happy occasion.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) Tea is interpreted as goodness, benefit, and comfort.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Ghee in a dream indicates knowledge, the Quran, lawful money, fertility, and prosperity.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Ghee indicates abundant sustenance and benefit. Eating it indicates recovery.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Ghee is interpreted as lawful money. Whoever sees himself eating it will gain money.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Fried eggs in a dream indicate sustenance that comes quickly and easily.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Fried eggs indicate collected money or a child.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Fried eggs are interpreted as pleasant sustenance. Whoever sees himself eating them will gain sustenance.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A dining table in a dream is the world. A set table with food on it is present sustenance. Its removal indicates the end of one's lifespan or the loss of a blessing.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A dining table indicates victory over enemies and the fulfillment of needs. Eating from it is sustenance and spoils.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A dining table is interpreted as goodness, blessing, and abundant sustenance.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A spoon in a dream indicates a servant or a worker through whom sustenance flows.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A spoon indicates a man who strives to seek livelihood. Eating with it indicates gaining sustenance.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A spoon is interpreted as goodness and benefit. Whoever sees himself eating with it will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with its linguistic meaning and as a tool) A fork (eating utensil) in a dream may indicate a difficult man or a matter involving hardship. Eating with it may indicate gaining sustenance with fatigue or in an unusual way.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A fork may indicate worry and grief because of 'thorns' (shawk). It may also indicate a friend or helper who assists in matters.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A fork is interpreted as worry or dispute.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A plate in a dream indicates the wife, the servant, or the friend. What is in it indicates his/her condition. Breaking it indicates separation or death.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A plate indicates the world and livelihood. A clean plate indicates a good livelihood.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A plate is interpreted as a woman. Whoever sees himself eating from it will gain goodness from a woman.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A pot in a dream is the custodian of the house and its manager. If it is new and clean, it indicates the righteousness of the custodian. Cooking in it indicates gaining sustenance and benefit.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A pot indicates a scholar or a ruler. What is in it indicates his knowledge or justice.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A pot is interpreted as a noble man. Whoever sees himself cooking in it will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with a cup and goblet) A small cup (finjan) in a dream may indicate a woman or a servant. What is in it indicates his/her condition or what comes from it of good or evil.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A small cup may indicate little sustenance or a hidden secret. Breaking it indicates the exposure of a secret or a loss.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A small cup is interpreted as a woman or a servant. Drinking from it may indicate gaining a small benefit.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A mortar in a dream indicates a difficult man or a dispute and argument.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A mortar indicates a woman of bad character. Pounding in it indicates falling into worry.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A mortar is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself pounding in it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Rose water in a dream indicates good praise, a good reputation, and beneficial knowledge. Drinking it indicates recovery from illness.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Rose water indicates a righteous child or lawful money.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Rose water is interpreted as goodness and benefit. Whoever sees himself drinking it will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The miswak in a dream indicates following the Sunnah, purity, and good character. It indicates a man who reconciles people.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The miswak indicates a male child or lawful money. Using it indicates paying off debt and the end of worry.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The miswak is interpreted as goodness and blessing. Whoever sees himself using it, his affairs will be rectified.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The throat in a dream indicates the place of trust and secrets. Its narrowness indicates stinginess, and its pain indicates worry.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The throat indicates religion. Its soundness is soundness in religion, and its illness is illness in religion.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The throat is interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees his throat is wide, his wealth will increase.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The pharynx in a dream indicates the passage of sustenance and speech. Its blockage indicates difficulty in sustenance or death.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The pharynx indicates secrets and trust. What comes out of it indicates the disclosure of secrets.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The pharynx is interpreted as worry. Its pain indicates worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The larynx in a dream indicates the place of voice and speech. Its pain indicates worry or illness that prevents speech.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The larynx indicates strength and argument. Its soundness indicates the strength of the argument.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The larynx is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees pain in it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The intestines in a dream indicate a man's hidden wealth, his secrets, and his children. Their coming out indicates the disclosure of secrets or the death of children.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The intestines indicate family and relatives. Their soundness indicates their righteousness.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The intestines are interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees his intestines coming out, his wealth will be gone.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The liver in a dream indicates the child and the place of mercy and compassion. Its illness indicates the child's illness. Eating it indicates gaining wealth.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The liver indicates strength and courage. Whoever sees his liver is large, his heart is strong.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The liver is interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees himself eating it will gain wealth.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The kidneys in a dream are the two ministers or the closest relatives. Their soundness indicates their righteousness and strength.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The kidneys indicate wealth and richness. Whoever sees himself eating them will gain wealth.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The kidneys are interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees pain in them will suffer a decrease in his wealth.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The spleen in a dream is unlawful money. Its pain indicates illness or worry due to unlawful money.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The spleen indicates the place of anger. Its enlargement indicates frequent anger.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The spleen is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees pain in it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The lung in a dream is the place of life and breath. Its soundness indicates long life and health. Its illness indicates illness or the approach of one's end.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The lung indicates a servant or a child.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The lung is interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees it is healthy, his wealth will increase.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The brain in a dream is the intellect and stored wealth. Eating it indicates gaining the wealth of a leader or the death of that leader.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The brain indicates the wealth that a person relies on for his strength. Whoever sees his brain grow larger, his wealth and intellect will increase.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The brain is interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees himself eating it will gain wealth.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A person's skin in a dream is his covering, adornment, and religion. Its beauty indicates a good condition and being covered. Its flaying indicates scandal or poverty.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The skin indicates patience and endurance. Its thickness indicates strength.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The skin is interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees his skin is beautiful, his wealth will increase.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Veins in a dream indicate family and relatives. Their pulsing indicates life and strength.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Veins indicate a person's origins and livelihood. Cutting them indicates cutting family ties or difficulty in livelihood.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Veins are interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees his veins are prominent, his wealth will become apparent.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with veins) Arteries in a dream may indicate the sources of sustenance and main life passages. Their blockage indicates severe difficulty or danger to life.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) Arteries may indicate strong kinship or essential partners.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) Arteries are interpreted as essential wealth. Cutting them indicates a great loss.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Muscles in a dream indicate strength and power. Their strength indicates the man's strength, and their weakness indicates his weakness.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Muscles indicate the family and tribe by whom a man is strengthened.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Muscles are interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees his muscles are strong, his wealth will increase.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Beautiful white teeth in a dream indicate the strength, prestige, and good condition of the dreamer's household.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Whiteness of teeth indicates the generosity of the family or an increase in wealth.
