interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Whiteness of teeth is interpreted as good praise and a good reputation for the household.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A broken tooth in a dream indicates death, illness, or absence of the relative indicated by the tooth, or it indicates dispute and cutting ties.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A broken tooth indicates paying off a debt or a bad event happening to a relative.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A broken tooth is interpreted as worry and grief. Whoever sees his tooth break will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Extracting a tooth in a dream indicates the death or absence of the one indicated by the tooth. If it is without pain, it is easier.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Extracting a tooth indicates paying off a debt or cutting family ties.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Extracting a tooth is interpreted as worry, cutting family ties, or spending money unwillingly.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Cutting the nose in a dream indicates the dreamer's death or a calamity concerning the one indicated by the nose (like the father, son, or prestige).

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Cutting the nose indicates humiliation, disgrace, and great worry.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Cutting the nose is interpreted as worry and calamity. Whoever sees his nose cut will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Cutting the ear in a dream indicates the death of the wife or daughter, or corruption in religion.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Cutting the ear indicates hearing bad news or removal from a position.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Cutting the ear is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees his ear cut will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Cutting the right hand in a dream indicates a false oath, theft, or abandoning prayer. Cutting the left indicates the death of a brother or sister or parting with a partner.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Cutting the hand indicates inability to earn or cutting family ties.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Cutting the hand is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees his hand cut will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Cutting the foot in a dream indicates loss of wealth, difficulty in travel, or death of one's riding animal.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Cutting the foot indicates losing half of one's wealth or partner.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Cutting the foot is interpreted as worry and calamity concerning parents.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Intercourse in a dream indicates achieving one's goal and attaining position and exaltation. Intercourse with relatives indicates cutting family ties.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Intercourse indicates fulfilling a need and the end of worry. Intercourse with a dead person indicates achieving a despaired matter.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Intercourse is interpreted as goodness and benefit. Whoever sees himself having intercourse with his wife will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A wet dream in a dream indicates achieving what the dreamer wishes.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A wet dream indicates peace of mind and the end of worry.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A wet dream is interpreted as goodness and achieving one's goal.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Menstruation in a dream for a woman indicates committing a sin or negligence in religion. For a man, it indicates committing a forbidden act.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Menstruation indicates illness or separation. If the woman is pregnant, she will miscarry.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Menstruation is interpreted as worry and deficiency in religion.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The postpartum period in a dream indicates emerging from hardship, illness, and prison.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The postpartum period indicates relief and the end of worry.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The postpartum period is interpreted as relief and comfort.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Miscarriage (falling fetus) in a dream indicates worry, grief, and hardship that quickly disappears.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Miscarriage indicates bad words coming from the dreamer.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Miscarriage is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees his wife miscarrying will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Infertility in a dream indicates despairing of a matter or disruption of sustenance.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Infertility indicates poverty and unemployment.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Infertility is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself infertile will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Giving birth to twins in a dream indicates joy and relief. If they are males, it is worry followed by relief. If they are females, it is relief and abundance.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Twins indicate an increase in sustenance and goodness.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Twins are interpreted as goodness and blessing.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The hijab in a dream for a woman is covering and a righteous husband. Taking it off indicates separation from the husband or exposure.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The hijab indicates religion and piety. Wearing it indicates guidance.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The hijab is interpreted as covering. Whoever sees himself wearing it, God will cover his flaws.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The niqab in a dream for a woman indicates her modesty, religion, and husband. Uncovering it indicates lack of modesty or separation from the husband.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The niqab indicates covering and chastity. For a man, it indicates hiding a matter.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The niqab is interpreted as covering. Whoever sees himself wearing it will attain covering.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Praying while sitting in a dream without an excuse indicates the non-acceptance of the deed or negligence in it.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Praying while sitting for a sick person indicates the approach of his end or the prolongation of his illness.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Praying while sitting is interpreted as weakness and negligence.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Reciting Al-Fatiha in a dream indicates the opening of doors of goodness and sustenance and the fulfillment of needs.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Reciting Al-Fatiha indicates recovery from illnesses and salvation from worries.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Reciting Al-Fatiha is interpreted as goodness and blessing. Whoever sees himself reciting it will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Reciting Ayat Al-Kursi in a dream indicates protection from Satan, security from fear, and gaining knowledge.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Reciting Ayat Al-Kursi indicates recovery from illnesses and salvation from hardships.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Reciting Ayat Al-Kursi is interpreted as protection and security. Whoever sees himself reciting it, God will protect him.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Praying for the dead in a dream indicates the reward of the prayer reaching them and their need for it.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Praying for the dead indicates the righteousness and piety of the dreamer.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Praying for the dead is interpreted as good for the deceased and the one praying.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Praying for the sick in a dream indicates healing and well-being.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Praying for the sick indicates the righteousness and mercy of the dreamer.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Praying for the sick is interpreted as goodness and healing.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Istikhara prayer in a dream indicates seeking guidance from God in a matter and trusting in Him.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Istikhara prayer indicates confusion in a matter and seeking guidance.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Istikhara prayer is interpreted as goodness and guidance.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Prayer of Need in a dream indicates seeking the fulfillment of a need from God Almighty and resorting to Him.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Prayer of Need indicates the imminent fulfillment of the need and achieving the goal.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Prayer of Need is interpreted as the fulfillment of needs.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Eid prayer in a dream indicates joy, happiness, the end of worries, and paying off debts.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Eid prayer indicates the return of the absent, the recovery of the sick, and relief after hardship.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Eid prayer is interpreted as goodness and joy. Whoever sees himself praying it will attain joy.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Friday prayer in a dream indicates joy, happiness, an imminent journey, and gathering for goodness.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Friday prayer indicates the fulfillment of needs and achieving goals. Whoever misses it, his affairs will become difficult.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Friday prayer is interpreted as goodness and blessing. Whoever sees himself praying it will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A sermon in a dream indicates exaltation, prestige, and a word that is heard. Listening to it indicates admonition and guidance.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A sermon indicates enjoining good and forbidding evil. Whoever sees himself giving a sermon, his status will rise.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A sermon is interpreted as goodness and position. Whoever sees himself giving a sermon will gain a position.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: I'tikaf in a dream indicates adherence to obedience and devotion to God. It indicates righteousness in religion.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: I'tikaf indicates salvation from worries and security from fear.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: I'tikaf is interpreted as goodness and blessing. Whoever sees himself in i'tikaf, his affairs will be rectified.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Umrah in a dream indicates long life, increase in sustenance, and good deeds.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Umrah indicates paying off debt, the end of worry, and recovery of the sick.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Umrah is interpreted as goodness and blessing. Whoever sees himself performing Umrah will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Visiting the Prophet's grave (PBUH) in a dream indicates following his Sunnah, gaining his intercession, and relief from worries.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Visiting the Prophet's grave indicates the fulfillment of needs and salvation from hardships.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Visiting the Prophet's grave is interpreted as great goodness and blessing.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Zamzam water in a dream indicates recovery from illnesses, gaining knowledge, and lawful sustenance.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Zamzam water indicates the fulfillment of needs and achieving wishes. Drinking it indicates goodness and blessing.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Zamzam water is interpreted as goodness and healing. Whoever sees himself drinking it will attain goodness and healing.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The Black Stone in a dream indicates Hajj, repentance, or pledging allegiance to the leader. Kissing it indicates paying off debt and repentance.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The Black Stone indicates a scholar or a child. Touching it indicates following a scholar.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The Black Stone is interpreted as goodness and blessing. Whoever sees himself touching it will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Tawaf around the Kaaba in a dream indicates serving the ruler or the leader. It indicates righteousness in religion and fulfillment of needs.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Tawaf indicates fulfilling trusts and honoring covenants. For the sick, it is recovery, and for the fearful, it is security.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Tawaf is interpreted as goodness and blessing. Whoever sees himself performing Tawaf, his affairs will be rectified.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Sa'i between Safa and Marwa in a dream indicates striving to fulfill the need of a man and a woman or striving for reconciliation between them.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Sa'i indicates paying off debt and fulfilling a vow.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Sa'i is interpreted as goodness and blessing. Whoever sees himself performing Sa'i will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Standing at Arafat in a dream indicates maintaining family ties, reconciliation with adversaries, and acceptance of repentance.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Standing at Arafat indicates the fulfillment of needs and relief from worries.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Standing at Arafat is interpreted as great goodness and blessing.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Stoning the Jamarat in a dream indicates paying off debt, victory over enemies, and getting rid of worries.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Stoning the Jamarat indicates angering Satan and following the Sunnah.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Stoning the Jamarat is interpreted as goodness and triumph over enemies.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Sacrifice in a dream indicates salvation from hardships, fulfilling a vow, sustenance, and blessing.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Sacrifice indicates relief from distress, paying off debt, and recovery of the sick.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Sacrifice is interpreted as goodness and blessing. Whoever sees himself sacrificing will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The Hadi in a dream indicates sustenance, a child, and drawing closer to God through acts of obedience.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The Hadi indicates righteousness in religion and worldly life and fulfilling a vow.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The Hadi is interpreted as goodness and blessing. Whoever sees himself offering it will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The Pool in a dream indicates a scholar, a righteous wife, or a deed by which one draws closer to God. Drinking from it indicates knowledge and faith.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The Pool indicates salvation from hardships and following the Sunnah.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The Pool is interpreted as goodness and blessing. Whoever sees himself drinking from it will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Intercession in a dream indicates exaltation, prestige, and fulfillment of needs. Whoever sees himself interceding for someone will gain a position.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Intercession indicates salvation from worry and grief. Seeking it indicates need.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Intercession is interpreted as goodness and benefit. Whoever sees himself interceding will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Seeing Adam (AS) in a dream indicates committing a sin then repenting from it, or gaining a position, or Hajj, or meeting loved ones.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Seeing Adam indicates honoring parents or long life. Whoever speaks to him will gain knowledge.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Seeing Adam is interpreted as goodness and blessing. Whoever sees him will attain goodness and exaltation.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Seeing Noah (AS) in a dream indicates long life, salvation from enemies, and many trials.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Seeing Noah indicates relief after hardship and salvation from drowning.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Seeing Noah is interpreted as goodness and salvation. Whoever sees him will be saved from worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Seeing Abraham (AS) in a dream indicates goodness, blessing, sustenance, a righteous child, Hajj, and guidance.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Seeing Abraham indicates security from fear, salvation from hardships, and honoring parents.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Seeing Abraham is interpreted as great goodness and blessing. Whoever sees him will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Seeing Moses (AS) in a dream indicates victory over enemies and triumph over oppressors. It may indicate falling into hardship then salvation from it.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Seeing Moses indicates truthful speech and a strong argument. Whoever speaks to him will attain exaltation.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Seeing Moses is interpreted as goodness and victory. Whoever sees him will triumph over his enemy.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Seeing Jesus (AS) in a dream indicates blessing, goodness, travel, and medicine. He is a blessed man wherever he is.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Seeing Jesus indicates recovery from illnesses and salvation from worries. It may indicate a false accusation followed by exoneration.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Seeing Jesus is interpreted as goodness and blessing. Whoever sees him will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Seeing the Prophet (PBUH) in a dream is true, and it indicates great good tidings, relief, guidance, and victory. Seeing him in a place indicates goodness and blessing for the people of that place.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Seeing the Prophet indicates the fulfillment of needs, the end of worries, recovery from illnesses, and following the Sunnah.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Seeing the Prophet is interpreted as immense goodness that cannot be counted. Whoever sees him will attain the good of this world and the hereafter.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Seeing the Companions (RA) in a dream indicates following the Sunnah, intimacy, love, and strength in religion.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Seeing the Companions indicates goodness, blessing, and victory over enemies.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Seeing the Companions is interpreted as great goodness. Whoever sees them will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Seeing righteous saints in a dream indicates goodness, blessing, following the truth, and salvation from hardships.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Seeing the righteous indicates the dreamer's righteousness and the acceptance of his deeds.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Seeing the righteous is interpreted as goodness and blessing. Whoever sees them will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Iblis (Satan) in a dream is an enemy in religion and worldly life, he is the unjust ruler, the innovator, and the thief. Whoever sees Satan following him, an enemy is deceiving and tempting him.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Iblis indicates desire, heresy, and heedlessness. Whoever sees Satan touching him is consuming usury or will be afflicted with worry from women.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Iblis is interpreted as a cunning enemy. Whoever sees himself killing him will outwit his enemy and triumph over him.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The Dajjal in a dream indicates a lying, deceitful magician who leads people into strife. Seeing him indicates great strife and heresy.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The Dajjal indicates travel, worry, and grief. Whoever sees him will fall into strife.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The Dajjal is interpreted as worry and strife. Whoever sees him will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Green crops in a dream indicate good deeds, long life, and lawful sustenance.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Green crops indicate Islam and guidance. Walking in them indicates piety.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Green crops are interpreted as goodness and blessing. Whoever sees himself owning them will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Yellow crops in a dream indicate illness or the approach of one's end.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Yellow crops indicate worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Yellow crops are interpreted as illness. Whoever sees himself harvesting them will fall ill.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Colocynth in a dream is unlawful money or a man of bad character. Eating it indicates illness or worry.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Colocynth indicates ugly speech. Seeing it indicates worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Colocynth is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself eating it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Unripe dates in a dream are lawful sustenance whose time has not yet come. Eating them indicates goodness coming in the future.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Unripe dates indicate deferred money or hoped-for hope.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Unripe dates are interpreted as goodness. Whoever sees himself eating them will attain deferred goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Ajwa dates in a dream are blessed lawful money and healing from illnesses.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Ajwa dates indicate protection from poison and magic.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Ajwa dates are interpreted as goodness, blessing, and healing.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Raisins in a dream are beneficial lawful money and abundant sustenance.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Raisins indicate a man with collected wealth.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Raisins are interpreted as goodness and benefit. Whoever sees himself eating them will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with salt and the color black) Black salt may indicate money with doubtful sources or worry related to money.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate a man of bad character or strife caused by money.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as worry and grief because of money.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Rock candy in a dream indicates pure, good words free from impurities. It indicates healing.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Rock candy indicates a righteous child or beneficial knowledge.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Rock candy is interpreted as goodness and healing.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Breaking a cup in a dream indicates the death of a woman or separation from her.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Breaking a cup indicates the death of the head of the household or loss of money.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Breaking a cup is interpreted as worry and calamity concerning a woman.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A broken mirror in a dream indicates separation from the wife or worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Breaking a mirror indicates the death of the wife or a change in her condition for the worse.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Breaking a mirror is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself breaking it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Breaking a knife in a dream indicates weakness of argument or the death of a child.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Breaking a knife indicates inability and weakness.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Breaking a knife is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees his knife break will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Breaking a pen in a dream indicates the death of a child or the loss of authority or knowledge.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Breaking a pen indicates removal from a position or failure in a matter.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Breaking a pen is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees his pen break will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Breaking a key in a dream indicates difficulty in affairs and loss of help.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Breaking a key indicates despairing of a matter or loss of knowledge.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Breaking a key is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees his key break will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with large, aquatic animals) A hippopotamus may indicate a large man of might and power, or a dangerous ruler. Seeing it in water may indicate looming danger or a hidden enemy.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may symbolize a strong and rich man but slow-moving or lazy, or it indicates a matter involving heaviness and difficulty.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as a strong, large man, or an enemy coming from the direction of water. Being harmed by it indicates harm from a strong man.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A jackal in a dream indicates a weak, malicious man, or a woman of bad character. Its howl indicates bad news or a calamity.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A jackal indicates a weak, cowardly enemy. Whoever sees himself catching one will triumph over a weak enemy.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A jackal is interpreted as a man with no good in him. Seeing it indicates worry and grief.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with animals that jump and carry their young) A kangaroo may indicate rapid movement and travel, or motherhood and care for children. It may indicate a strong man who overcomes obstacles.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may symbolize progressing in matters quickly, or protection and care for family and children.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as moving from one state to another or sudden travel.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Goats in a dream indicate noble men of status. Many goats indicate spoils and sustenance. A kid indicates a male child.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A goat indicates a noble Arab man. Its milk is lawful money, and its hair is little money.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A goat is interpreted as goodness and benefit. Whoever sees himself owning goats will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with small predatory animals) A mongoose may indicate a cunning, agile man, or a nimble thief, or a small but harmful enemy.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate a man who spies for news or spreads slander.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as a small enemy or a treacherous servant.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The quail bird in a dream indicates good lawful sustenance that comes without effort (as in the story of the Children of Israel).

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Quail indicates goodness, benefit, and pleasant sustenance.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Quail is interpreted as goodness and sustenance. Whoever sees himself eating it will attain good sustenance.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with worms) An earthworm may indicate money coming from the earth (agriculture or property), or it indicates household members and striving for their affairs.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate weak people or little sustenance that comes with fatigue.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as money or servants. Seeing many of them indicates abundant money or servants.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A wasp in a dream indicates a foolish, harmful man, or a highway robber enemy. Its sting indicates harm from an enemy.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A wasp indicates a slandering man who corrupts relations between people. Killing it indicates triumph over an enemy.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A wasp is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees one stinging him will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with small fish) Shrimp in a dream may indicate little money or scattered sustenance coming from the direction of water.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate small worries or insignificant matters.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as little sustenance. Eating it indicates gaining meager sustenance.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with strong wind) A storm in a dream indicates great strife, a general affliction, or anger from the ruler. Escaping from it is salvation from hardship.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A storm indicates war, severe fear, or a general illness.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A storm is interpreted as torment and worry. Whoever sees it hitting him will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Planets in a dream are the nobles, scholars, and kings. Their falling indicates the death of a great person or strife. Their gathering indicates the gathering of nobles.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Planets indicate the companions and soldiers of the king. Seeing them during the day indicates scandals.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Planets are interpreted as kings and scholars. Whatever light or darkness is seen in them reflects on them.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A jewel in a dream indicates knowledge, the Quran, and a male child. A pure jewel indicates a sincere intention and a good deed.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A jewel indicates words of wisdom and good admonition. Whoever sees himself owning one will gain beneficial knowledge.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A jewel is interpreted as goodness and benefit. Whoever sees himself finding one will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with precious gems) A diamond in a dream may indicate the fleeting adornment of the world and vanity, or it indicates a beautiful, captivating woman, or abundant wealth.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A diamond may indicate precious knowledge or a righteous child, but its sparkle may indicate strife.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A diamond is interpreted as goodness, benefit, and adornment. Whoever sees one will attain joy and adornment.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A palm tree in a dream indicates a scholarly man or a noble Arab man, or it indicates a righteous wife, a blessed child, or long life. Cutting it indicates death or travel.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A palm tree indicates good words and good deeds. Climbing it indicates attaining exaltation. Its fruit (dates) is lawful sustenance.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A palm tree is interpreted as a generous man or a righteous woman. Whoever sees himself planting one will be blessed with a righteous child.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Truffles in a dream indicate collected money or women with no good in them. They may indicate eye disease.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Truffles indicate a lowly man or little sustenance.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Truffles are interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself eating them will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: An izar in a dream indicates a wife, authority, or covering. Wearing it indicates marriage or gaining authority.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: An izar indicates a partner or a friend. Whoever sees himself wearing one is partnering with someone.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: An izar is interpreted as a woman. Whoever sees himself buying one will marry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with a small house) A hut in a dream may indicate a modest wife, a simple livelihood, or little covering.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A hut may indicate poverty and need, or isolation and asceticism.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A hut is interpreted as worry and distress. Whoever sees himself in it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: An ablution place in a dream indicates a place for relieving oneself, or repentance and purification. Performing ablution in it indicates the end of worry and relief.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: An ablution place indicates a man who helps with purification and repentance.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: An ablution place is interpreted as relief. Whoever sees himself performing ablution in it, God will relieve his worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with a road and alley) A corridor in a dream indicates a transitional phase or a narrow path. If it is wide and bright, it is relief. If it is narrow and dark, it is worry and hardship.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A corridor indicates striving for a matter. Its end indicates the end of that matter.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A narrow corridor is interpreted as worry, and a wide one as relief.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with a knife and sword) A dagger in a dream indicates a male child, a strong argument, or a loyal friend. Stabbing with it indicates hurtful words.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A dagger indicates strength and power. Whoever sees himself carrying one will gain strength.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A dagger is interpreted as goodness and strength. Whoever sees himself stabbing an enemy with it will triumph over him.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A bell in a dream indicates news or a warning. Its sound indicates fame or scandal. If it is hanging, it indicates a postponed matter.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A bell indicates a hypocritical man or false speech. Hearing it indicates worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A bell is interpreted as news. Whoever sees himself hearing it will hear news.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Bowing in a dream indicates repentance and submission to God Almighty. Bowing to other than God indicates not fulfilling needs and humiliation.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Bowing indicates long life and achieving goals. Whoever sees himself bowing will achieve what he wishes.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Bowing is interpreted as goodness and blessing. Whoever sees himself bowing will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Fainting in a dream indicates worry, grief, and severe illness afflicting the dreamer.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Fainting indicates repentance and returning to God after heedlessness.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Fainting is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself fainting will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A skull in a dream indicates the leader of the people or collected money. Breaking it indicates the death of the leader.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A skull indicates the money that a person saves. Whoever sees himself eating a skull will gain money from a leader.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A skull is interpreted as money. Whoever sees himself owning skulls will gain money.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with leaping) Jumping in a dream indicates travel or a change in condition. Jumping to a high place indicates exaltation. To a low place indicates degradation.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) Jumping indicates strength, activity, and overcoming difficulties.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) Jumping is interpreted as travel or change in condition.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: An unknown stranger in a dream may indicate the Angel of Death if he is frightening, or indicate good tidings and goodness if he has a good appearance.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A stranger may indicate an enemy or a friend depending on his appearance and speech.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A stranger is interpreted as news. If good-looking, it is good news. If ugly, it is bad news.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Love in a dream indicates worry, grief, and strife in religion. Love for God and His Messenger indicates guidance and salvation.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Love indicates blindness and deafness to the truth. It may indicate intimacy and gathering.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Love is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself loving will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with distant and cold places) The Pole in a dream may indicate isolation, hardship, or a very long journey.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate a scholarly, ascetic, isolated man, or it indicates worry and grief due to extreme cold.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as worry and hardship.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A funeral gathering in a dream indicates joy and good tidings if there is no weeping or screaming. If there is, it is worry and calamity.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A funeral gathering indicates joy, happiness, and the end of worry.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A funeral gathering is interpreted as joy. Whoever sees himself in one will attain joy.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Smoke in a dream is terror, torment, and strife from the ruler. If it smells good, it is good after fear. If it comes from a cooking place, it is sustenance.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Smoke indicates terrifying news. It may indicate drought and hardship.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Smoke is interpreted as worry and fear. Whoever sees it coming out of his house, strife will occur in it.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Prostration in a dream indicates triumph, victory, long life, and repentance. Prostrating to other than God indicates needs not being met and humiliation.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Prostration indicates humility before God and drawing closer to Him. It indicates Hajj and salvation from dangers.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Prostration is interpreted as triumph and salvation. Whoever sees himself prostrating will get what he wishes.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Planets in a dream are the nobles, scholars, and kings. The falling of a planet indicates the death of a great person or strife.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A planet indicates a noble man. Moving planets indicate travel.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Planets are interpreted as kings and scholars. A bright planet indicates a beneficial scholar.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A meteor in a dream indicates slanderous talk, burning, or illness. It may indicate a man who follows the truth.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A meteor indicates a scholarly man who strikes with the truth. Its falling indicates the death of a scholar.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A meteor is interpreted as news. If it is bright, it is good news.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with planets and meteors) A comet in a dream may indicate a great event, strife, the appearance of heresy, or the death of a great man with followers.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate a warning of a major event, or indicate a man of impact and influence.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as worry and fear of a great impending event.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: An abandoned well in a dream indicates the disruption of travel, marriage, or sustenance. It indicates a woman of no benefit.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: An abandoned well indicates unemployment and poverty.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: An abandoned well is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees one will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A dry canal in a dream indicates the interruption of sustenance or the death of the one through whom sustenance flows.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A dry canal indicates unemployment and poverty.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A dry canal is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees one will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Dry clay in a dream indicates lasting money or a chronic illness.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Dry clay indicates steadfastness in religion or lasting worry.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Dry clay is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself eating it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with ashes and water) Wet ashes may indicate false speech that gets worse or worry and grief that intensifies.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate knowledge not acted upon, along with strife.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as severe worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Extinguished coal in a dream indicates a man who was dangerous but whose danger has passed, or unlawful money whose bad effect has gone.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Extinguished coal indicates the end of worry or strife.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Extinguished coal is interpreted as the end of worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with embers and cold) Cold embers may indicate strife that has subsided, unlawful money that has lost its value, or danger that has passed.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate worry that has gone or enmity that has ended.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as the disappearance of worry or danger.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with rust) Old rust may indicate old corruption in religion or a bad relationship that has persisted for a long time.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate an old heresy or persistent worry.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as persistent worry or an old hypocritical man.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A stopped mill in a dream indicates stagnation of affairs, disruption of travel, or dispute.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A stopped mill indicates unemployment and poverty.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A stopped mill is interpreted as disruption of sustenance.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Spoiled (sour) dough in a dream indicates unlawful money or loss in trade.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Spoiled dough indicates worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Spoiled dough is interpreted as worry and loss.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Moldy or spoiled bread in a dream indicates corruption in religion, hardship in livelihood, or unlawful money.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Moldy bread indicates knowledge that is not benefited from or a disobedient child.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Moldy bread is interpreted as worry and miserable living.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Spoiled or rotten meat in a dream indicates backbiting, slander, unlawful money, worry, and illness.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Spoiled meat indicates a calamity or severe illness.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Spoiled meat is interpreted as worry, illness, and loss.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Spoiled or sour milk (curdled) in a dream indicates unlawful money, sustenance with hardship and fatigue, or a corrupt nature.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Spoiled milk indicates worry, grief, and illness.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Spoiled milk is interpreted as unlawful money or worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with honey and cheating) Adulterated honey may indicate useless knowledge, hypocrisy in good deeds, or lawful money mixed with unlawful.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate worry and envy because of money or knowledge.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as worry or suspicious money.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Spoiled dates in a dream indicate unlawful money, ugly speech, or illness.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Spoiled dates indicate worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Spoiled dates are interpreted as worry and hearing bad words.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Rotten fruit in a dream indicates unlawful money, illness, or a corrupt deed.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Rotten fruit indicates worry, grief, and loss.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Rotten fruit is interpreted as worry and unlawful money.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Oil that has changed color or smell (murky) in a dream indicates worry, illness, unlawful money, or knowledge that is not benefited from.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Murky oil indicates breaking a covenant or betraying a trust.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Altered oil is interpreted as worry and illness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Murky or turbid water in a dream indicates worry, grief, illness, hardship, and difficulty in living. Drinking it indicates falling into strife or illness.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Murky water indicates unlawful money or a miserable life. Swimming in it indicates wading into strife.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Murky water is interpreted as worry, grief, and illness. Whoever sees himself drinking it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A patched garment in a dream indicates poverty and need, or trying to fix a corrupt matter.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A patched garment indicates a poor man striving to seek livelihood. It may indicate repentance.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A patched garment is interpreted as poverty and worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A torn shoe in a dream indicates difficulty in travel or worry related to the wife or partner.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A torn shoe indicates separation from a partner or woman.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A torn shoe is interpreted as worry and grief related to a woman.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Losing a ring in a dream indicates the loss of kingship or authority, or divorce from the wife, or death of a child.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Losing a ring indicates losing something dear or loss of money.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Losing a ring is interpreted as worry and calamity.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Breaking a bracelet in a dream indicates the end of worry if it was gold for a man, or it indicates separation or loss.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Breaking a bracelet indicates separation from a brother, child, or friend.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Breaking a bracelet is interpreted as worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with contract and cheating) A forged contract in a dream may indicate a false covenant, a fake trust, false knowledge, or an unblessed marriage.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate worry and grief due to deception and cheating.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as worry and deception.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: An abandoned palace in a dream indicates the loss of blessings or the death of a great man.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: An abandoned palace indicates a fleeting world or an abandoned good deed.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: An abandoned palace is interpreted as worry and desolation.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A house burning in a dream indicates great strife and a calamity befalling its inhabitants.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A house burning indicates the death of its owner or a severe dispute occurring among its inhabitants.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A house burning is interpreted as worry and calamity.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Cutting a tree in a dream indicates the death of a sick person, cutting family ties, or travel.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Cutting a tree indicates the death of a generous man or a righteous woman, depending on the type of tree.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Cutting a tree is interpreted as worry and calamity concerning the one it represents.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Breaking a branch in a dream indicates the death of a child, brother, or relative.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Breaking a branch indicates separation from a partner or friend.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Breaking a branch is interpreted as worry and calamity concerning a child.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Falling leaves in a dream indicate loss of money or the approach of one's end.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Falling leaves indicate poverty and worry.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Falling leaves are interpreted as worry and loss.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Cutting the root of a tree in a dream indicates abandoning religion, moving from a country, or cutting family ties.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Cutting the root indicates the severing of one's origin or sustenance.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Cutting the root is interpreted as worry and calamity concerning one's origin and lineage.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Crops burning in a dream indicate drought and barrenness, or strife afflicting the people of that place.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Crops burning indicate loss of money or corruption of work.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Crops burning are interpreted as worry and calamity.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: An abandoned garden in a dream indicates an abandoned woman or a fleeting world.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: An abandoned garden indicates abandoning good deeds or abandoning one's wife.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: An abandoned garden is interpreted as worry and desolation.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A dry spring in a dream indicates the interruption of goodness or the death of a generous man.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A dry spring indicates poverty or the death of a child.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A dry spring is interpreted as worry and interruption of sustenance.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with the sea and dryness) A dead or lifeless sea may indicate a weak king with no benefit, or a world with no good in it, or knowledge not acted upon.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate strife, unemployment, or drought.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as worry and hardship.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A shipwreck (sinking) in a dream indicates calamity, destruction, and strife.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A shipwreck indicates the death of the mother, father, or wife, or loss in trade.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A shipwreck is interpreted as worry and calamity.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with boat and hole) A leaky boat indicates danger in travel or a matter with unsafe consequences, or worry coming from the wife or child.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It indicates the imminent occurrence of a calamity or loss.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as worry and danger.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with car and breakdown) A broken-down car in a dream indicates disruption of affairs and cessation of striving in a matter.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It indicates worries and problems obstructing the dreamer's path.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as worry and stagnation of affairs.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with airplane and fire) A burning airplane in a dream indicates a disastrous failure in a project or position, or great strife, or a huge loss.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It indicates a major calamity or scandal.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as worry and calamity.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with train and stopping) A stopped train in a dream indicates stagnation of affairs, disruption of travel, or a long wait for something.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It indicates postponement of a matter or the end of a phase.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as worry and waiting.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with bicycle and breaking) Breaking a bicycle in a dream indicates stumbling in one's endeavors or failure in a simple matter.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It indicates minor worries and problems.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as worry and stumbling.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The collapse of a bridge in a dream indicates the death of a man who connects people or the corruption of a matter the dreamer relied upon.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The collapse of a bridge indicates the death of a ruler or scholar, or the severing of ties between people.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The collapse of a bridge is interpreted as worry and calamity.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The collapse of stairs in a dream indicates a decline in position or corruption in religion.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The collapse of stairs indicates the death of a servant or difficulty in travel.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The collapse of stairs is interpreted as worry and calamity.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A broken door in a dream indicates the death of the head of the house, divorce of the wife, or a great calamity.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A broken door indicates worry and grief entering the household.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
