interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A laughing sister indicates goodness and benefit.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A laughing sister is interpreted as goodness and joy.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A laughing child in a dream indicates good news and imminent relief.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A laughing child indicates the end of worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A laughing child is interpreted as goodness and joy.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A crying child in a dream indicates worry, grief, and fatigue.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A crying child indicates hard-heartedness or the occurrence of injustice.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A crying child is interpreted as worry and strife.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Arguing with one's father in a dream indicates disobedience or opposing his command.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Arguing with one's father indicates worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Arguing with one's father is interpreted as worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Arguing with one's mother in a dream indicates committing a sin or negligence towards her.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Arguing with one's mother indicates severe worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Arguing with one's mother is interpreted as worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Arguing with one's brother in a dream indicates cutting family ties or disagreement in partnership.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Arguing with one's brother indicates worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Arguing with one's brother is interpreted as worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Arguing with one's husband in a dream indicates marital disagreements or instability.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Arguing with one's husband indicates worry and grief for the woman.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Arguing with one's husband is interpreted as worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Arguing with one's wife in a dream indicates worries and problems in the house or loss.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Arguing with one's wife indicates worry and grief for the man.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Arguing with one's wife is interpreted as worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Arguing with a friend in a dream indicates separation or a misunderstanding that could lead to enmity.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Arguing with a friend indicates worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Arguing with a friend is interpreted as worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Arguing with a stranger in a dream indicates falling into dispute or strife.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Arguing with a stranger indicates worry and grief coming from an unexpected source.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Arguing with a stranger is interpreted as worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Eating dirt in a dream indicates extreme poverty and need, or death.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Eating dirt indicates gaining wealth proportionate to the amount eaten.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Eating dirt is interpreted as wealth. Whoever sees himself eating it will gain wealth.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Eating stone in a dream indicates striving for a very difficult matter or disputing with a hard-hearted man.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Eating stone indicates gaining wealth with extreme difficulty.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Eating stone is interpreted as worry and fatigue.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Eating glass in a dream indicates bearing worries and troubles related to women or exposing secrets.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Eating glass indicates hurtful speech or strife.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Eating glass is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself eating it will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Eating paper in a dream indicates seeking and memorizing knowledge, or gaining wealth proportionate to what is written on it, if written.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Eating paper indicates memorizing knowledge or concealing testimony.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Eating paper is interpreted as wealth or knowledge. Whoever sees himself eating it will gain wealth or knowledge.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Eating coal in a dream indicates consuming unlawful money from a ruler or a dangerous man.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Eating coal indicates falling into worry or giving false testimony.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Eating coal is interpreted as unlawful money or worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Eating ashes in a dream indicates false speech, unlawful money, or striving for a useless matter.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Eating ashes indicates knowledge not acted upon, or worry and regret.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Eating ashes is interpreted as worry and grief.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Eating clay in a dream indicates backbiting, slander, consuming the deceased's money, or unlawful money.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Eating clay indicates illness or worry.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Eating clay is interpreted as worry and illness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Drinking human blood in a dream indicates gaining wealth and benefit from that person, or salvation from their evil if they are an enemy.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Drinking blood indicates unlawful money or sin.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Drinking blood is interpreted as unlawful money or committing a sin.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Drinking urine in a dream indicates unlawful money or falling into doubt.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Drinking human urine indicates gaining suspicious money. Drinking animal urine indicates benefit.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Drinking urine is interpreted as unlawful money or worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Being drunk from wine in a dream indicates fear, ignorance, loss of blessings, and gaining unlawful money.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Drunkenness indicates unemployment and heedlessness. It may indicate security from fear.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Drunkenness is interpreted as worry and committing a sin.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Drinking poison in a dream, if it does not harm the dreamer, indicates gaining wealth or long life.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Drinking poison and not dying from it indicates piety and devotion, or salvation from worry.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Drinking poison and not dying is interpreted as salvation from worry or wealth.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Drinking bitter medicine in a dream indicates recovery from illness if sick, or indicates poverty and need if healthy.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Drinking bitter medicine indicates repentance or advice that one dislikes.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Drinking bitter medicine is interpreted as healing or worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Drinking salty seawater in a dream indicates gaining wealth from a ruler with worry and fatigue.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Drinking seawater indicates vast knowledge or abundant wealth.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Drinking seawater is interpreted as gaining wealth from the king.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Walking on air in a dream indicates arrogance and falsehood if the dreamer is not righteous. If righteous, it indicates exaltation and a blessed journey.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Walking in the air indicates travel, fame, or righteousness in religion.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Walking in the air is interpreted as travel or exaltation.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Walking on fire in a dream indicates committing sins and major offenses or wading into great strife.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Walking on fire indicates victory over enemies or striving for a dangerous matter.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Walking on fire is interpreted as worry and strife.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Walking on thorns in a dream indicates falling into hardship, debt, or mixing with evil people.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Walking on thorns indicates worry, grief, and fatigue in seeking livelihood.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Walking on thorns is interpreted as worry and fatigue.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Walking backwards in a dream indicates retreating from a matter, corruption in religion, and change of condition for the worse.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Walking backwards indicates regret over a past matter or abandoning work.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Walking backwards is interpreted as worry and change of condition for the worse.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with running) Walking quickly in a dream indicates quick fulfillment of needs and salvation from a fearful matter.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It indicates serious striving in an important matter.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as quick fulfillment of needs.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Walking slowly in a dream indicates weakness, cowardice, or illness.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Walking slowly indicates hesitation in a matter or fear of it.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Walking slowly is interpreted as worry and weakness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Dancing in the mosque indicates mocking religion and falling into heresy.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Dancing in the mosque indicates calamity and worry.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Dancing in the mosque is interpreted as worry and misguidance.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Dancing in the market indicates scandal and loss of modesty.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Dancing in the market indicates worry, grief, and loss.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Dancing in the market is interpreted as worry and scandal.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Dancing alone in a closed place is less worrying than dancing in front of people.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Dancing alone indicates minor worry or short-lived joy.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Dancing alone is interpreted as worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Screaming in the market indicates strife or loss in trade.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Screaming in the market indicates worry, grief, and scandal.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Screaming in the market is interpreted as worry and loss.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Screaming in the mosque indicates heresy or a calamity afflicting religious people.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Screaming in the mosque indicates worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Screaming in the mosque is interpreted as worry and heresy.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Screaming over the dead indicates following their way if they were righteous, or indicates calamity and worry if accompanied by wailing and slapping.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Screaming over the dead indicates worry and sadness.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Screaming over the dead is interpreted as worry and calamity.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Singing in the bathroom indicates ugly speech and immorality.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Singing in the bathroom indicates worry and grief.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Singing in the bathroom is interpreted as worry and committing a sin.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Singing in the mosque indicates mocking religion and misguidance.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Singing in the mosque indicates strife and heresy.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Singing in the mosque is interpreted as worry and misguidance.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Reciting the Quran backwards indicates abandoning religion, following desires, and misguidance.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Reciting the Quran backwards indicates committing heresy or speaking falsehood.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Reciting the Quran backwards is interpreted as misguidance and worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Reciting the Quran without purity indicates disrespecting religion or non-acceptance of deeds.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: It may indicate memorizing the Quran by heart or knowing it.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: It is interpreted as disrespecting religion.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Praying without ablution indicates non-acceptance of deeds or striving for a false matter that will not be completed.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Praying without ablution indicates illness or loss in trade.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Praying without ablution is interpreted as worry and loss.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Praying facing away from the Qibla indicates committing a great sin, misguidance in religion, or abandoning the Sunnah.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Praying facing away from the Qibla indicates Hajj if it is during the Hajj months, or indicates confusion in religion.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Praying facing away from the Qibla is interpreted as committing a major mistake or misguidance.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Praying in an impure place indicates corruption in religion and committing abominations.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Praying in an impure place indicates worry and grief or unlawful money.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Praying in an impure place is interpreted as worry and corruption.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Giving the Adhan at the wrong time indicates strife, the appearance of a strange matter, or heresy.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Giving the Adhan at the wrong time indicates slander or spying.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Giving the Adhan at the wrong time is interpreted as worry and strife.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Giving the Adhan in the bathroom indicates disrespecting religion or severe illness.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Giving the Adhan in the bathroom indicates fever or ugly speech.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Giving the Adhan in the bathroom is interpreted as worry and illness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Performing Hajj outside its months indicates loss in trade or corruption in religion.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Performing Hajj at the wrong time indicates striving for a false matter that will not be completed.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Performing Hajj at the wrong time is interpreted as worry and loss.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Performing Tawaf in the reverse direction indicates committing heresy or opposing the Sunnah.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Performing Tawaf in the reverse direction indicates misguidance in religion.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Performing Tawaf in the reverse direction is interpreted as misguidance and worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with standing and solitude) Standing at Arafat alone may indicate an answered prayer in seclusion or sincere repentance.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate withdrawing from people for worship or worry and loneliness.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as good if for worship, and as worry if for loneliness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Stoning the Jamarat with large pebbles may indicate paying off a large debt or overcoming a strong enemy.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate exaggeration in a matter or exceeding the limit.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as paying off debt or victory.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Sacrificing a defective animal indicates non-acceptance of deeds, deficiency in religion, or unlawful money.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Sacrificing a defective animal indicates worry and grief or not fulfilling a vow.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Sacrificing a defective animal is interpreted as worry and non-acceptance of deeds.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with eating raw meat) Eating raw sacrificial meat indicates backbiting family and relatives or unlawful money.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It indicates worry, grief, and illness.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as worry and backbiting.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Wearing dirty Ihram indicates committing a sin, corruption in intention, or non-acceptance of Hajj or Umrah.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Wearing dirty Ihram indicates worry, grief, and illness.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Wearing dirty Ihram is interpreted as worry and sin.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Cutting or shaving hair before exiting Ihram indicates not completing the rituals or committing a prohibition.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: It indicates opposing the Sunnah or non-acceptance of deeds.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: It is interpreted as worry and negligence in worship.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Stealing from the Kaaba indicates committing a great sin or betraying the ruler.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Stealing from the Kaaba indicates falling into heresy or great worry.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Stealing from the Kaaba is interpreted as worry and committing a sin.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Touching the Black Stone indicates following a scholar or pledging allegiance to a leader. Not kissing it may indicate incompleteness of the matter.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: It may indicate following the Sunnah without reaching its perfection.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: It is interpreted as goodness but نقص (deficiency/incompleteness) in its completion.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with Zamzam water and murky water) Drinking murky Zamzam water may indicate attaining good mixed with worry or illness, or knowledge containing doubt.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate lack of purity in intention when seeking goodness or healing.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as worry and illness despite the presence of underlying goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The Kaaba burning with fire indicates a great strife afflicting Islam or the death of the Caliph or Imam.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The Kaaba burning indicates abandoning prayer or committing a major sin.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The Kaaba burning is interpreted as a great calamity and worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The demolition of the Kaaba or the falling of one of its walls indicates the death of the Caliph or Imam or the occurrence of great strife.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The demolition of the Kaaba indicates the death of a great scholar or the spread of heresies.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The demolition of the Kaaba is interpreted as a great calamity in religion.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Seeing Al-Aqsa Mosque in a dream indicates blessing, sanctity, and inheritance. Praying in it indicates piety and devotion.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Seeing Al-Aqsa Mosque indicates a blessed journey or Hajj.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Seeing Al-Aqsa Mosque is interpreted as goodness, blessing, and benefit.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Seeing the city of Jerusalem in a dream indicates righteousness, piety, worship, and jihad.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Seeing Jerusalem indicates the end of worries and relief.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Seeing Jerusalem is interpreted as goodness, blessing, and victory.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with walls and fortresses) Seeing the Great Wall of China may indicate fortification, strength, and power, or indicate a great matter requiring significant effort to accomplish.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate long life, a distant journey, or a huge project.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as strength, power, and protection.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with great structures and tombs) Seeing the Pyramids may indicate kingship and authority, or indicate ancient secrets and mysteries, or indicate death and the grave.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate ancient knowledge and wisdom, or indicate injustice and tyranny.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as worry and grief due to its association with tombs and unjust kings.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with tall buildings and iron) Seeing the Eiffel Tower may indicate exaltation, fame, high ambition, or indicate travel to distant lands.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate a high position or a large project.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as exaltation, prestige, and fame.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with statue and liberty) Seeing the Statue of Liberty may indicate salvation from slavery or prison, or indicate travel to Western countries, or it may indicate strife and misguidance (because it is a statue).

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate liberation from restrictions or the beginning of a new life.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as relief and salvation, or as worry and strife.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with house, white color, and authority) Seeing the White House may indicate a strong ruler or the center of government and decision-making. Entering it indicates getting closer to the ruler or gaining a position.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate power, prestige, and authority.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as prestige, authority, and exaltation.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A khuff in a dream indicates a servant or protection for wealth. A new khuff indicates a new servant or preserved wealth. Its tightness indicates worry and debt.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A khuff indicates a woman, travel, or a riding animal. Wearing it indicates fortifying wealth or a journey with protection.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A khuff is interpreted as a servant or protection. Whoever sees himself wearing a new khuff will gain a servant or wealth.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A sandal in a dream indicates a wife, brother, partner, travel, or riding animal. Wearing it indicates embarking on one of these matters. Taking it off is security and authority. Walking with one sandal is separation.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A sandal indicates protection, strength, and power. It indicates a woman or travel. Losing it indicates worry and separation.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A sandal is interpreted as a woman or a servant. Whatever good or bad is seen in it reflects on them.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A qabqab in a dream indicates travel, a wife, or a servant. Its sound indicates dispute and talk.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A qabqab indicates a hypocritical man or a sharp-tongued woman.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A qabqab is interpreted as worry. Whoever sees himself wearing one will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A handkerchief in a dream indicates a servant, a child, or money. A clean handkerchief indicates good praise. A dirty one indicates ugly praise.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A handkerchief indicates a woman or a maidservant. Taking it indicates gaining benefit from a woman.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A handkerchief is interpreted as joy and benefit. Whoever sees himself holding one will attain joy.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with cap and turban) A tarboosh may indicate exaltation and prestige, or a husband or leader. Its beauty indicates a good situation.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate travel or authority. Wearing it indicates achieving one's goal.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A tarboosh is interpreted as prestige and position. Whoever sees himself wearing one, his status will rise.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with cap) A taqiyah in a dream indicates a man's leader, his authority, or his wife. Its newness and beauty indicate the leader's exaltation or the wife's beauty.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A taqiyah indicates travel, marriage, or authority. Wearing it indicates achieving one's goal.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A taqiyah is interpreted as prestige and position. A white one indicates religion and righteousness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with sash and clothing) A shawl in a dream may indicate adornment and prestige, or covering and protection. It may indicate wealth or position.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A shawl indicates honor and exaltation, or the husband for a woman.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) A shawl is interpreted as goodness, covering, and position.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with loose clothing) An abaya in a dream indicates covering, chastity, prestige, and dignity. Wearing it indicates righteousness in religion and worldly life.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) An abaya indicates the husband, father, or protection. For a woman, it is covering and adornment.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) An abaya is interpreted as goodness, covering, and prestige.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A burnous in a dream indicates leadership and kingship. Wearing it indicates gaining authority or marriage.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A burnous indicates a noble man of position. It indicates Hajj or Umrah.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A burnous is interpreted as goodness and prestige. Whoever sees himself wearing one will attain goodness and prestige.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A rida' in a dream is a man's deed and his religion. A beautiful rida' indicates a good deed. A black rida' indicates sovereignty.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A rida' indicates a wife or covering. Wearing it indicates marriage.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A rida' is interpreted as prestige and position. Whoever sees himself wearing one will gain prestige.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Fur in a dream is wealth and sustenance, especially in winter. Wearing it indicates wealth and prestige. Fur of predators is unlawful money from an unjust ruler.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Fur indicates a rich man or authority.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Fur is interpreted as wealth and benefit. Whoever sees himself wearing it will gain wealth.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Dibaj in a dream is authority, exaltation, and glory. Wearing it indicates gaining a position or marrying a noble woman.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Dibaj indicates joy and happiness. For the deceased, it is the bliss of Paradise.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Dibaj is interpreted as goodness and prestige. Whoever sees himself wearing it will attain goodness and prestige.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Khazz in a dream is lasting lawful money. Wearing it indicates gaining authority and exaltation.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Khazz indicates a noble man of wealth.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Khazz is interpreted as wealth and prestige. Whoever sees himself wearing it will gain wealth and prestige.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Qazz (raw silk) in a dream is unlawful or dubious money. Working with it indicates striving for a dubious matter.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Qazz indicates collected money that comes with fatigue.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Qazz is interpreted as worry and unlawful money.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A sickle in a dream indicates death, war, or harvest. If in its season, it is good; if out of season, it is evil.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A sickle indicates a man decisive in matters. It may indicate a child.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A sickle is interpreted as good if during harvest time, and as evil if out of season.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A plough in a dream indicates a man striving to seek livelihood. Ploughing with it indicates marriage or striving for a beneficial matter.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A plough indicates a child or a partner. Working with it indicates goodness and sustenance.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A plough is interpreted as goodness and striving for sustenance.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A winnowing fork in a dream indicates a man who separates truth from falsehood, or indicates scattering wealth.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A winnowing fork indicates strife and division among people.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A winnowing fork is interpreted as worry and division.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A pickaxe in a dream indicates a strong servant or a man relied upon in difficult matters.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A pickaxe indicates strength and power. Digging with it indicates striving in a difficult matter.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A pickaxe is interpreted as goodness and strength.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A shovel in a dream indicates a servant or worker striving to gather money.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A shovel indicates a man who gathers money. Shoveling with it indicates striving to seek livelihood.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A shovel is interpreted as wealth and benefit.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A saddle on a mount in a dream indicates a wife, authority, or travel. Placing it indicates marriage or gaining authority. Its falling indicates divorce or dismissal.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A saddle indicates a noble woman. Riding without one indicates humiliation.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A saddle is interpreted as a woman or a position. Whoever sees himself riding with a saddle will attain goodness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A bridle in a dream indicates religion and piety that restrain its owner from sins. It indicates authority and wealth.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A bridle indicates a man who manages affairs. Whoever sees himself leading an animal with a bridle is leading a man.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A bridle is interpreted as goodness and position.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A stirrup in a dream indicates wealth and steadfastness in a matter.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A stirrup indicates a servant or helper.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A stirrup is interpreted as goodness and steadfastness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A horseshoe in a dream indicates wealth, protection, and travel.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A horseshoe indicates a woman or a servant.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A horseshoe is interpreted as goodness and benefit.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A stable in a dream indicates a gathering place for men or soldiers. It indicates strength and power.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A stable indicates a wife or authority.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A stable is interpreted as goodness and benefit.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Fodder in a dream is sustenance for animals, and may indicate sustenance for the dreamer that comes with fatigue.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Fodder indicates wealth and sustenance.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Fodder is interpreted as goodness and sustenance.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Straw in a dream is abundant collected wealth, fertility, and ample sustenance.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Straw indicates wealth that is not benefited from.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Straw is interpreted as abundant wealth.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Thorns in a dream indicate evil, difficult men, or strife, debt, and worry. Them entering the body indicates falling into strife or debt.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Thorns indicate harm, worry, and grief. Removing them indicates the end of worry.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Thorns are interpreted as worry. Whoever sees them pricking him will be afflicted with worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with wheat and the color black) Buckwheat may indicate suspicious money or worry coming because of money.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate a man of wealth and sovereignty but corrupt.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as suspicious money or worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Lupine in a dream indicates wealth after fatigue. Eating it indicates recovery from illnesses.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Lupine indicates worry and grief if dry; if green, it is sustenance and healing.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Lupine is interpreted as worry if dry, and as goodness if green.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Black pepper in a dream is unlawful money. Eating it indicates worry, grief, and severe dispute.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Black pepper indicates a slandering man of bad character. Seeing it indicates hearing ugly speech.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Black pepper is interpreted as severe worry. Whoever sees himself eating it will be afflicted with severe worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with pepper and the color white) White pepper may indicate money with doubt but less harmful than black, or indicate hidden dispute.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate speech with some badness but not obscene.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as light worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: White truffles in a dream indicate beautiful, chaste women, or lawful money.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: White truffles indicate good sustenance.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: White truffles are interpreted as goodness and benefit.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Black truffles in a dream indicate women with no good in them, or little money.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Black truffles indicate a lowly man or worry.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Black truffles are interpreted as worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with plants and vegetables) Asparagus in a dream may indicate fleeting sustenance or temporary benefit.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate health and well-being or a child.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as goodness and temporary benefit.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with thorny plants) An artichoke in a dream may indicate sustenance that comes with fatigue and hardship, or a difficult man.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate worries and troubles that the dreamer hides.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as worry and fatigue.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with root vegetables and the color red) Beetroot may indicate buried money, strife, or blood illness.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate worry and grief or disagreements.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as worry and illness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Pumpkin in a dream indicates a scholarly man or a beneficial doctor. It is healing from illnesses and an increase in knowledge and wisdom. Its tree indicates a blessed man of high status.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Pumpkin indicates guidance, following the Sunnah, and closeness to God. Eating it indicates knowledge, wisdom, and healing.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Pumpkin is interpreted as goodness, blessing, and healing. Whoever sees himself eating it will attain goodness and benefit.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with red fruit) Strawberries in a dream may indicate little, fleeting sustenance, or temporary joy and happiness, or a beautiful woman.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) They may indicate good news or a happy occasion.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) They are interpreted as goodness and temporary joy.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with thorny and sweet fruit) Pineapple may indicate sustenance that comes after fatigue and hardship, or a rich, difficult man.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate collected money or beneficial knowledge.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as goodness and benefit that comes with fatigue.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with sweet fruit) Mango in a dream may indicate good lawful sustenance, benefit, and joy.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate good news coming from afar or a blessed marriage.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as goodness, sustenance, and joy.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with fruit) Guava in a dream may indicate lawful sustenance or healing for the sick.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate a righteous woman or good offspring.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as goodness, benefit, and healing.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with sweet white fruit) Soursop in a dream may indicate good lawful sustenance that comes easily, or indicate righteousness in religion and purity of heart.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate beneficial knowledge or good words.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as goodness and pleasant sustenance.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with tropical fruit) Papaya in a dream may indicate sustenance coming from travel or distant lands, or indicate a strange matter.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate healing or health and well-being.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as goodness and benefit coming from afar.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with fruit) Kiwi in a dream may indicate little but blessed sustenance, or indicate healing.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate a new matter or a successful beginning.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as goodness and benefit.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with fatty fruit) Avocado in a dream may indicate abundant wealth and blessed sustenance, or indicate health and well-being.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate a rich, generous man or a righteous woman.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as goodness, wealth, and benefit.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with figs and thorns) Prickly pear may indicate sustenance that comes after fatigue, hardship, and harm, or a beneficial but difficult man.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate worries and troubles that the dreamer hides and endures patiently.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as wealth that comes with fatigue and worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Sycamore fig in a dream indicates blessed collected money. Its tree indicates a steadfast, beneficial man for his family.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Sycamore fig indicates a man of wealth and blessing.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Sycamore fig is interpreted as goodness and wealth.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Carob in a dream indicates little money or ruin and worry. Its tree indicates a man with no good in him.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Carob indicates evil and hardship.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Carob is interpreted as worry and grief.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Nabq (fruit of the Sidr tree) in a dream indicates sustenance from a noble man proportionate to what one gets. Its tree (Sidr) indicates a generous, noble man.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Nabq indicates lawful money. Green nabq indicates righteousness in religion.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Nabq is interpreted as goodness and sustenance.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The laurel tree in a dream indicates a man steadfast in his words or a wealthy woman. Its leaves indicate lasting money.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Laurel indicates knowledge and wisdom or healing.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Laurel is interpreted as goodness and lasting benefit.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The willow tree in a dream indicates a man of amusement and entertainment, or indicates worry, sadness, and mourning.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Willow indicates a man with no religion or a wailing woman.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Willow is interpreted as worry and sadness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The athel tree in a dream indicates a large, steadfast man in his words, who is from the Bedouins.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Athel indicates strength and steadfastness.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Athel is interpreted as goodness and strength.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The cypress tree in a dream indicates a man of high status and long life or a beautiful woman. It may indicate worry and sadness as it is a tree of cemeteries.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Cypress indicates household members and children. It indicates steadfastness and uprightness.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Cypress is interpreted as goodness and long life, or worry and sadness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The pine tree in a dream indicates a noble, steadfast, rich man. Its fruit indicates lawful money that comes with fatigue.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Pine indicates a deaf man who does not listen to the truth.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Pine is interpreted as goodness and wealth.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The cedar tree in a dream indicates a noble, strong, powerful man of long life.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The cedar tree indicates a king or a man of authority.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The cedar tree is interpreted as goodness, strength, and long life.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with good trees) The linden tree may indicate a beneficial man, a righteous woman, or healing and comfort.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate calmness, tranquility, and healing.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as goodness, benefit, and healing.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The oak tree in a dream indicates a large, strong man of wealth. Its fruit is lawful money.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Oak indicates an elderly man.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Oak is interpreted as goodness and wealth.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with trees) The maple tree may indicate a beneficial man, travel, or a change in condition.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate money or benefit coming from afar.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as goodness and benefit.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The plane tree in a dream indicates a large, infertile man with no benefit.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: The plane tree indicates a man of prestige and power but little benefit.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: The plane tree is interpreted as a man with no good in him.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The poplar tree in a dream indicates a man or woman of good appearance but bad character.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Poplar indicates a hypocritical man or a bad woman.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Poplar is interpreted as hypocrisy and worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The talh tree (banana or thorny acacia) in a dream indicates a generous man from the Bedouins with wealth and goodness. It may indicate worry because of its thorns.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Talh indicates a man of determination and resolve.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Talh is interpreted as goodness and benefit, or worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The Sidr tree in a dream indicates a generous, noble man of religion and character. Its fruit (Nabq) indicates sustenance.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Sidr indicates a man of high status and position.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Sidr is interpreted as goodness and exaltation.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The samur tree in a dream indicates a strong, powerful Arab man.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Samur indicates strength and steadfastness.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Samur is interpreted as goodness and strength.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The tamarisk tree in a dream indicates a man with no religion.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Tamarisk indicates worry, grief, and poverty.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Tamarisk is interpreted as worry and poverty.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The oleander tree in a dream indicates a hypocritical man of bad character, or a matter containing deadly poison.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Oleander indicates worry, grief, and illness.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Oleander is interpreted as worry and illness.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The boxthorn tree in a dream indicates a harmful man of bad character, or strife and evil.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Boxthorn indicates a slandering man who corrupts relations between people.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Boxthorn is interpreted as worry and evil.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: The balsam tree in a dream indicates a man of good praise and reputation. Its oil indicates healing.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Balsam indicates health and well-being.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Balsam is interpreted as goodness and healing.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with myrtle and wild) Wild myrtle may indicate a man faithful to his covenant but isolated or of little benefit.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate steadfastness in a matter away from people.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as steadfastness and isolation.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with pomegranate and wild) Wild pomegranate may indicate little money or a distant woman.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate little worry.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as little money or worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with fig and wild) Wild fig may indicate money coming from a distant place or a beneficial stranger.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate unexpected sustenance.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as wealth and benefit.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with olive and wild) Wild olive may indicate a blessed, isolated man or little blessed money.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate little beneficial knowledge or guidance.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as goodness and blessing.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with grape and wild) Wild grape may indicate little sustenance or minor worry.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate little benefit or short-lived joy.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as little money or worry.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: (By analogy with rose and wild) Wild rose may indicate a child or little money, or short-lived joy.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It may indicate a distant woman or a noble, isolated man.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: (By analogy) It is interpreted as temporary joy.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A wild dog in a dream is an enemy with greater enmity than a domestic dog, a man lacking chivalry.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A wild dog indicates a lowly man from the Bedouins.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A wild dog is interpreted as a strong enemy.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: A wild donkey in a dream is an ignorant, opposing man with no religion. Riding it indicates committing a sin.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: A wild donkey indicates an immoral man. Hunting it indicates gaining spoils.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: A wild donkey is interpreted as an ignorant man. Whoever sees himself eating its meat will gain wealth.

interpretations.source: The Great Interpretation of Dreams (Ibn Sirin)
interpretations.text: Wild cows in a dream indicate beautiful women of status and honor. Hunting them indicates gaining wealth from a beautiful woman.

interpretations.source: Perfuming Humanity in the Expression of Dreams (Al-Nabulsi)
interpretations.text: Wild cows indicate spoils and abundant sustenance.

interpretations.source: Signs in the Science of Expressions (Ibn Shaheen)
interpretations.text: Wild cows are interpreted as women. Whoever sees himself hunting them will marry.
